P4 Theater
2024-05-12
Theory and method
Human Surrender
P4 Theater: A Generative University, a Winding Maze, a Hard Drive Engraving Life
P4 Theater's self-definition as a generative university, winding maze, and hard drive of lived practice and experimental theater.
Peeper｜Player｜NPC｜Architecture
Part One About Dreams
architect
seeds, sketches, construction, splitting
Part Two About Practice
NPC
Summon, game, war, death
Part Three About Methods
player
see, evolve, photograph, refer to oneself
Part 4 About the Movie
voyeur
Me, you and him, alienation, cruel drama, Human Surrender
It's about "Architects", "NPCs", "Players" and "Peepers"
A quartet performing together, an adventure towards death
ps: You can click on the underlined parts of the article and the pictures to jump to new links.
About dreams
01 seeds
The birth of P4 Theater was a complete accident. In the future that I had longed for since childhood, I never thought that it would have any connection with drama. I have always wondered what made my destiny turn here. Looking back now, there may be two reasons. In 2013, just a year after I graduated from my undergraduate degree, when my first girlfriend and I successfully started a business together and started to become famous and make money, she finally told me about all the "atrocities" I had committed against her during the three years we had been together, and she confidently took possession of the works and brands we created together as her own. Such a "drama" complex broke my brain. I started to cry when watching movies, automatically wrote poems, sang on the rooftop, began to understand emotions, became vulnerable, and learned to listen.
Also, half a year after I suffered a shock and lost 60 pounds, I ran into a classmate who was studying painting in high school in the pre-examination class in Nanluo Ancient Lane. Later I learned that she had retaken the college entrance examination for one year and was admitted to the Central Academy of Drama, where she studied stage art and was later recommended to graduate school. When I saw her again five years later, I was surprised that she had the same long, shiny black braids as when I first saw her. Later, I fell in love with her. She took me to watch many plays for free in theaters in Beijing and told me what drama she thought was. She was very innocent and sometimes bitter. Later, she got her PhD and went to New York. She and I broke up in 18 years.
In fact, there should be another reason. Zhang Shaohua, my classmate for four years as an undergraduate, we studied photography together. He is emotionally delicate and sincere. It was he who spent more than half a year in 2015 transforming the large factory building of Sculpture Station into a theater. After my brain split, I worked with him to study how photography captures the spirit, what a portrait is, how to infuse a person's true temperament into a flat surface and solidify it. The final conclusion is: drama must be passed through drama.
Theater makes me feel alive and stops me from feeling dead. I was born in an oil field compound in rural Jiangsu, and lived almost isolated from the world until the fourth grade of elementary school. In a utopia with about a thousand people, I didn't know the meaning of traffic lights. I always get lost in the river ditches in the fields waiting for the dragonflies to take off or hide in the towering reeds to listen to the sound of crickets chirping. Drama makes me feel like I am still in nature. The mysterious, unknown, touching, strange and terrifying all rush towards me, encountering them or leaving you.
02 Sketch
P4 Theater was an idea that I, Zhang Shaohua, and Zhang Aoshuang came up with together at that time, transforming the studio that was originally going to be renovated into a theater to activate a new possibility. First, we use dramatic elements such as stage, lighting, and curtains to create a special scene. Then we use some psychological suggestion methods to make the subjects relax and lose their mind. Finally, we use photography to capture and record them and seal them. Present (present), photosynthesis (photosynthesis), psychology (psychology), and permanent (eternity) are the methods used by p4 and the origin of the name; and the p and 4 in the logo embody two subjects that rotate at high speed and collide with each other, like lightning and flint igniting life. What P4 Theater wants to do is to study, observe, record and reconnect these subjects, and present their intersubjectivity more deeply through drama. This is the mission of p4.
Today, nine years later, I can't help but feel sad when I look back at the accident and the unspoken guidance at the beginning. Things have changed. The dreams and ambitions I had at that time have long gone with the wind, and the awesomeness I boasted has turned into butterflies, hoping to be realized in my dreams. Over the years at p4, I have designed and participated in the design of about a dozen gameplays, rules and models to organize and promote drama production, including: Real Image, p4U plan, p4X challenge, 3P group, Purple Action, Beifeng Drama Club, Love Drama, Happy Kingdom, Personal Ambition, etc.
I'm often confused about explaining to others the things I do, drama? photography? Art? psychoanalysis? In fact, neither is accurate. I prefer it to be a real social practice, a spiritual movement closely connected with social life. Collect people's suffering, anxiety and confusion, so that people can sympathize with each other again, soothe their pain and regain their strength. This is the original intention of P4 Theater, to let drama and art enter the life related to oneself, rather than entering the golden hall or the modern art museum that can only be viewed.
Over the years, I have continued to use the word "underground" to describe the activities we engage in, which makes me feel very funny and also helpless. But the underground is also an attitude, representing life and giving birth to hope. P4 Theater was forced to move out of the sculpture stand in mid-2021 due to various factors such as the epidemic, demolition, emotional disputes, business philosophy, and financial pressure. The large space of 200 square meters with a height of eight meters and can accommodate hundreds of people can no longer be used by p4. I moved into a small office on Wanghua Road alone with P4 Theater brand and two public accounts, which was later called 510.
03 Construction
510 occupies a total area of 16 square meters, 4 meters long, 3 meters wide, and 3 meters high. It is located in the center of the fifth floor of the building. It is an extremely standard cuboid. I bought black curtains and floor glue to surround three-quarters of it as a stage, and the remaining space is used as a backstage to store equipment and props. I bought some portable flashlights and spotlights as stage lighting, and a simple super mini theater emerged again. This move squeezed the creative space to an incredible extent. The huge city of Beijing made acting as tense and exciting as an escape room. Under the pressure of a special environment, everyone who came had to squeeze together, so that connection had to happen. Such an accident gave p4 a long-lost vitality, making trust, cowardice, narcissism, courage, paranoia, disputes, and hormones even bigger, allowing the camera to get closer, and allowing all fluctuations to be observed and felt.
On New Year's Day in 2022, 510's first play "Iceberg" was officially premiered, with 15 audiences and 8 crew members crammed into 16 square meters, which made everything possible. It turns out that a place the size of a living room can also be used for acting. This incident inspired many people, especially during "that period." 510 has become an incubator. More and more people are coming, and more and more people are leaving here. This is the happiest thing. "Performance is not difficult," "Everyone can do their own play," "Performance can be done anywhere," "It is better to do poorly in theater than not at all," "Performance is as important as life," "Don't work, just theater." These words spread out from 510, and the authority of theater was dispelled faster than Beuys said, "Everyone is an artist."
Theater troupes that came out of 510 include: Drama Toilet, Glass Theater, Wormhole Theater, 101 Theater, Non-theatrical Activities, Happy Kingdom, Broken Moon Theater, Incidental Process, Four Eyes, Meow Meow Theater, Beifeng Theater, Mouth Death Theater, Purple Action, etc. Today, they are still continuing to create, performing plays, organizing activities, holding workshops, and making movies. Their indomitable spirit also influences and inspires me to continue to persevere for my ideals. Drama activities are a form of spiritual communication and resonance, which are full of dangers and challenges. When the initiator blows the horn, it also represents responsibility. Everyone goes on the journey with admiration and cannot return without success.
p4 has been trying a new concept in these years, which is a natural, harmonious and sincere co-creation model that breaks the traditional director-centered drama creation model. Equal and active participation is a must. Each member of the troupe can express his or her own views and opinions on creation, rather than waiting for instructions from the leader. When you feel dissatisfied and complaining, you can express them directly instead of accumulating, suppressing, and wronging yourself. Creativity emerges in such an atmosphere. In an open field, you can find your own place, and let the collective unconscious lead everyone into the deep sea to salvage the long-lost truth. The creative process will be recorded in detail, and the changes of everyone in the group can be easily seen. There is no so-called center, and there is no need to deliberately elevate anyone. The final production results must also be jointly owned, which is the crystallization of collective wisdom. Because the relationship between people in the creative process is not a commercial employment relationship, it is even more important to respect everyone and avoid a strong domination relationship as much as possible, although this will happen inadvertently and is difficult to resist.
04 Split
In the movie "The Matrix", the protagonist Neo finally meets the architect, the designer of the matrix, at a critical moment. The more difficult decision than the red pill and the blue pill is which door to go to, love or the city of Zion? Saving Trinity will lead to the collapse of the matrix and the destruction of mankind; otherwise, he will resolutely become a "savior" and lead the new people to rebuild the future of mankind. Sacrifice and love are eternal propositions in dramas. It whets the appetite of the audience, displays cruelty nakedly in front of people, and forces everyone to make a frightening choice.
Everyone longs for a savior, everyone fantasizes about becoming a savior, and everyone does not believe in a savior.
Everyone longs to break out of the cycle, whether they are born guilty and want to go to heaven, or whether they have no desire or desire to break out of reincarnation. People hate repetition, yearn for freedom, and people long for change. The alienation of modern industrial society reduces people to passive consumers and obedient workers. Precise control and oppression deprive us of any creativity, and even paralyze us by pretending to be needs and desires. The slaves with their hands trapped could only giggle at the projection on the wall to resolve their helpless situation.
p4 Put Ye Gong Haolong on the stage, catering, fantasy, criticism, and inducement can happen at any time. The theater reopens a new copy for us, and it can be pulled up by a mule or a horse. Parallel universes, arbitrary doors, time travel, and soul transfer can all break our rigid consciousness, experience a future that has never happened, and turn fantasy directly into reality. Division is a force of life, allowing us to reproduce naturally, transform those rigid frameworks, and allow freedom to come. Face your deepest fears head-on into the infinite abyss, roll up your sleeves and start taking action.
About practice
05 Summon
The world and I, my world, my free-running territory. But the impulse in my heart is always suppressed and entangled in the trivial complexity and endless busyness. Action, only action, can shut up those nonsense. P4 Theater is a container, radar, probe and trampoline. It collects desires and sighs that have nowhere to be released. It senses the pain and foam of the times. It condenses the cannon fodder and residue of annihilation. It is real and is a heterogeneity that cannot be eradicated or flattened.
There are so many people who come here here with great admiration. They come here again with the fire in their hands, longing for the hope of rebirth. Use possibilities to nourish, use drama to irrigate, grow the broken prosthetic limbs, cultivate and activate the seeds of unlimited potential. Support, care for and encourage each other, build new connections, relationships start from the heart.
p4 Slowly string each individual and each story into a necklace bit by bit. I once wrote a recruitment copy for "Real Image", turning my secret into his history, putting everyone's story on the stage, and recording the moment condensed on the face. "p4U" is even more ambitious, gathering a bunch of strangers in a month to put on a vigorous show for ourselves, exhausting our enthusiasm, exploding in an instant like fireworks, leaving no regrets.
Over the years, tens of thousands of people have come to P4 Theater. Some people took a peek out of curiosity and quickly left quietly, while others wrote their actions into stories to be remembered by others. Countless love, hate, and resentment were staged on the stage, woven in and out of the play. Life has worn away too many memories, so use the lubricant of drama to smooth them out. The rusty castle may move again and open new doors.
06 games
Do it again, I always want to do it again because I am unwilling to give in. The cost of trial and error is always increasing, and the countdown continues with no end. Death, experiencing death, dying constantly, death is the greatest invention, which declares the power of life.
p4 The play produced is a ticking time bomb because it is only performed once and the performance is the end and farewell. "Purple Action" is one of many invented forms, it is about experiencing the festival of death, a feast of collective sacrifice. In the setting, someone in a group of people must be killed in order for the group to survive. If "I" are not the judge, I will definitely be sacrificed by others. I, the weak and the strong, still sympathize with the world. Human nature becomes complicated amid various rules. To survive in the duel or to be destroyed in the abstention, I shall raise my arms and shout, or bear the pain and give up. In the theater, a lifetime of history will be traversed, and resentment and regret will be delayed in every second. I will die and be killed by them.
Absurd games may be more serious issues, and people will cast a sharper gaze on others and themselves in their assumptions. Wearing a mask, the theater will completely release the aggression that is usually suppressed, and you can roam freely within the rules. The absurdity and meaning of life are often confused, and people long for something to loosen themselves up and support themselves. Flip, keep flipping, so that reality can be as free as a dream.
With the mapped world, fictitious scenes, and cut scenes, the drama can enter the scene in one second and connect to another universe. Imagination allows me to perform without VR and without physical objects. Extracting my character is like calling on all my parameters, and what is left? What controls me is like what I am controlling. There is something else that cannot be controlled. I can't find it, or I can detect it when I look back.
07 war
The war never ends, and it gets better in 510. 510 is never a place, it is a cage, Cocoon House, a mirror, a dressing room, a toilet, a swimming pool, Five Finger Mountain, the Tomb of the Living Dead, Robinson Island, the Raft of the Medusa, a black phone booth.
The closed space and hallucinogenic blessing can project everything about the subject, and with it comes the conquest of the object. There are always two worlds, one related to you and one unrelated to you. Everyone shuttles between the two either actively or passively. People always want to change the world, but they are always changed by the world, so they fantasize about escaping into the Peach Blossom Land and getting into the embrace of a gentle land. The confrontation comes suddenly, it is a wanton act, it is a stress reflex, pushing out one's dissatisfaction, wandering in inferiority and pride. War is a struggle between the inside and the outside, and theater is a place where we can enter our hearts and release our fantasies. Only when we see ourselves and take off our disguises can we reconcile with ourselves.
The organization of every drama in p4 inevitably faces disputes, because there are no top-down requirements, and everyone is not subject to director-centered management. Creativity will inevitably arise from contradictions. When some people think it is good, others will think it is bad, but everyone must be responsible for the final collective result. This is a struggle between aesthetics and values, and self-organizing utopia must go through hardships. When we enter the drama, we suddenly become passengers on the raft of Medusa. Whether we abandon the ship and flee, or we struggle to cry out for the strength to gather together. This is a time that tests everyone, and it is also a time when hope is about to come.
Love and hate are equivalent, both are projections, towards others and towards oneself. I often think back to my days in the theater, being too serious and too cunning. I couldn't tell whether I was acting or being too real. Looking back on my subconscious reactions and answers, I still find them exciting and novel. It was an aura with some primitive animality. He could tear my face apart and say unbelievable words. It is a smell that has never been exuded in me, a kind of unbridled vitality. The theater, this container, allows me to be reborn and gives me strength. But it also scares me and makes me your enemy. I'm afraid of hurting others, especially when I don't know it. When the beast roars wantonly, no one knows this power. We pray for the success of the show, and we will make sacrifices to do so, and the foundation of trust will always be shattered in bizarre ways. I don't want to let you hurt, but I have to let my desire be released. Love and hate sway in destiny, and ignorance and cruelty will never be revealed.
08 demise
Bubbles burst, as do every play, every rehearsal, every love, and every dream. What has passed away will come again. Let's see if you have changed your appearance when we meet again. Theater carries memories and reverberates, releasing emotions and hovering in the space.
Existence, a kind of existence, is before life and after death. Because of existence, it must happen, experience in traces, and perish after brilliance. I fight against fate, race against time, fight for my last breath, and prove my despair. All will eventually perish, yes, for the sake of perdition.
Errors can only be known after being proven, and failures can only be understood after trying. We always complain about things that are counterproductive, but how can there be anything that is always right? Fortunately, we can at least accept the complete failure. In the experiment, we can deduce the imaginary possibilities again and again in rehearsals, and move towards certainty or...
Disappearance is a kind of magic. In suspense and magic, we often have strong curiosity about the things that disappear because of the distance and because they cannot be controlled and pondered. Death is the same. It comes suddenly, intensely, and quietly. In the blink of an eye, it goes out, like a weakened spotlight, and everything is faded into darkness. The light of the past has become fragments of memory, roaming and floating in the air, waiting to capture traces in the future.
About methods
09 See the current situation
The origin of P4 Theater comes from the persistence of looking, the curiosity about the unknown, and the expectation of what has not happened. p4 All activities come from recruitment, sending messages on the Internet, waiting for the arrival and response of each subject. To me, looking is always mysterious. We can feel the echo of life from a pair of eyes, accompanied by expectations, longing for resonance, encountering in looking, and confirming in looking.
The light passes through the pupil and is captured by the retina through various refraction, reflection, and diffraction. The electrical signal activates the neurons in the brain and converts it into information. People always find ways to complete the situation and fill in the gaps with imagination, which makes us feel at ease and no longer anxious. But in reality, there are always those scary and surprising things that scare us. Temptation and stimulation allow us to refresh our new understanding in the relationship between seeing and being seen.
Looking dominates individual cognition, and the illusion full of ideology fully exposes the cruelty of the power structure. Only by re-examining looking can we take the first step towards liberation. In the practice of p4, we have never used any "professionalism" to restrict anyone's expression. We especially welcome "amateurs" to participate in drama creation and use their freshest feelings to freely release.
Seeing is an extremely powerful energy that can penetrate, save, destroy, and heal, depending on how it is used. In a dark theater, people are more eager for this kind of inner understanding and connection, where lights touch, eyes meet, and souls resonate. Looking should not be about inspection, evaluation, questioning, and judgment, but about sublimated love, with an affirmation of the courage of existence. Staring into the abyss of despair or being burned by prejudice is where "seeing" often gets lost. For example, King Oedipus finally blinded his eyes and ran in the wilderness, begging for forgiveness or escaping from reality, but only by growing a "third eye" can he see the inner truth.
10 evolution
The essence of drama lies in the relationship between spectators and performers. The biggest difference from arts such as film and painting is that drama requires actors and audiences to participate together in the same time and space to form a tension of "presence". This encounter means that every play is unique and unrepeatable, it becomes an absolute event.
The preciousness of performance lies in its sacredness, which penetrates the inner group subconscious and spiritual power, breaking away from the daily identity and entering a new time and space to cleanse the soul. The performance drags the people present into a new narrative to create reality rather than represent it. Performance must be complex, changeable and unpredictable, evolution, evolution, deduction, demonstration, exercise, speech... Performance represents change, flowing like water, spreading, diffusing, distributing, spreading, transforming everything that once existed.
Performance is a complex operation, like the entangled collision of quantum computing. Every participant in the virtual narrative time and space is undergoing emotional evolution or self-reflection driven by the dramatic plot, and it will not collapse into a definite result until the final moment. Multiple possibilities and non-replicability allow this entanglement to reveal the overall relationship with the world, and the boundary between subject and object is fundamentally blurred. This is the charm of acting, which produces cognitive and emotional experiences that transcend individual limitations, injecting paradigms such as uncertainty, diversity, interactivity, process, and integrity into our lives, and seeking the meaning of life.
When entering P4 Theater field, a performance will naturally occur, and a kind of free expression will collide and communicate with others everywhere. There is no fixed script, no established characters, and no "fourth wall". Everything is constantly being created and developed. Each participant is an actor, an audience, and a creator, interpreting and shaping the new world and themselves in their own way. Acting should not be a skill, but an attitude towards life and a way of existence. Participants explore themselves, understand others, reconstruct the world, and write their own life scripts through constant role reversal and impromptu interaction.
11 taken
Watching, acting, and filming are called the trinity of P4 Theater. They are intertwined and constitute the most important method in p4 practice. As an act, shooting always has this decisive flavor, making sounds and solidifying memories. As an abstract verb, shooting represents decision-making and rhythm, as well as tension and imprinting. It is also a kind of courage and confidence without hesitation. One way "shooting" feeds back cognition to action is the second-order feedback of seeing. It responds to the current situation simply, promptly and quickly with its own actions, instantly transmitting personal perceptions and judgments to the scene.
This kind of power of escape throws away all gravity and lives again in a way that has never happened before. Photographing can be a kind of recording, a kind of organization, a kind of archiving memories, but it is also an impulse to preserve. It comes from the beating of fingertips, quickly capturing perceived information and transforming it into historical evidence. Just like when a mosquito has just landed on your skin and is eager to insert its needle, the timing of shooting is extremely important.
In the shooting, the subject can find a perspective that is neither observation nor deduction, as if he is hovering above the event and participating in it in a unique way. This perspective goes beyond pure spectatorship and complete involvement, but finds a delicate balance between the two. Photography is like a suspended perspective, a flexible viewpoint, which allows us to switch freely between participation and detachment, and to flexibly move between subjectivity and objectivity. Through photography, we can find a fulcrum at the center of the event, gain profound insight into reality or boldly imagine. Photography provides a unique intervention method to actively capture, select and express, using one's own body, one's own language, and one's own way to create one's own meaning, to influence the direction of events, and to shape the face of history.
In a deeper sense, shooting embodies a unique subjectivity. In the traditional binary opposition, the subject is either a detached spectator or a fully engaged participant. Photography provides a new possibility, a subject position that wanders between the two. This kind of subject is neither an abstractor who is separated from reality (a pure theorist separated from practice), nor a thorough one who submerges himself (a person who is fully involved in losing himself), but a practitioner who finds his own position in specific situations. They participate in unique ways and express themselves in unique ways. The establishment of this subjectivity is the important pursuit of P4 Theater and the core of the shooting method.
12 self-referential
Self-reference, chaos, emergence, and recursion are propositions that I have been studying since I was in college. These theories and described phenomena fascinate me and make me marvel at the relationship between the mysteries of the universe and me. Drama is the smallest unit I use to practice, and use it to unfold the secrets between you and me, revealing a non-linear, dynamic, open and complex world at the macro or micro level, in the past or the future, in virtuality or reality.
These concepts triggered my rethinking of theater practice. Small perturbations may bring about huge changes. Behind the seeming disorder there is often a deep order hidden. Local interactions can emerge as a whole pattern. There are cyclic feedbacks and self-similarities between structures at different levels. These perspectives provide us with a new way to understand nature and society. In the "big laboratory" of P4 Theater, originally separate dimensions such as individual and collective, local and whole, order and disorder, circulation and feedback are integrated into the same flowing field, generating a complex and dynamic network of meaning. Introducing the concept of complexity science into drama means breaking traditional frameworks such as linear narrative, causal logic, and hierarchical structure, and instead emphasizing new creative principles such as openness, interactivity, emergence, and self-organization. This kind of "complexity drama" is no longer a simple representation of reality, but the creation of a unique world that is parallel, intertwined, and reflective of reality; it is no longer a one-way transmission of established information; it is an invitation for viewers to participate in the generation of meaning; it is no longer a preset structure and direction, but an exploration of unknown possibilities in dynamic evolution.
Drama is like a mirror that reflects our hearts. Struggling to discover the meaning of life in difficult situations is the soul of P4 Theater. Mirror-like self-reflection is not only a kind of self-deconstruction and breakthrough, but also a kind of self-reshaping and sublimation. In the intertextuality of "role" and "self", in the interweaving of "performance" and "life", in the seemingly disordered and fractured mirror experience, we break free from the prison of self-representation and reconstruct ourselves with a new vision and attitude. This process is destined to be accompanied by pain like disintegration and absurd and rootless loss. But it is in this "positive nothingness" and "creative destruction" that a new self can emerge from the cocoon, and a transcendent life consciousness can be manifested.
Understand P4 Theater as a plural "generative space", in which the self is both the goal and the process; both the subject and the object; both the creator and the created. Here, binary oppositions such as individual and collective, self and others, internal and external, past and future, etc. are dissolved, showing the composite nature and process of life. P4 TheaterThe pursuit of self-referentiality is precisely to return life to its most original appearance-an open, non-linear, emergent creative process. And through experiential understanding of this process, we may finally understand that self is not an entity, but a occurrence; life is not an existence, but a becoming. In the cycle of self-reference, life transcends itself and reaches eternity.
Perhaps we can also do an interesting thought experiment: If the self-referential P4 Theater is a mirror of life, then can we also find various metaphors that reflect and refer to P4 Theater in real life? Life is like a play, and play is like life. When we look at the world from a meta perspective, are "p4 dramas" being staged in every bit of daily life? Or quiet, or noisy; or joyful, or miserable; or absurd, or sacred... Are the thousands of seemingly scattered and disorderly fragments of life, by chance, generating some kind of secret map and rhythm, pointing to the ultimate meaning of life? Life reflects into drama, and drama reflects life.
About the movie
13 me you him
p4 After nine years of operation, what I feel most deeply is a different kind of memory, which has nothing to do with status, wealth, appearance, race, gender, and especially power relations. It directly strips away the symbolic nakedness in society. There are bosses, Ph.D.s, and CEOs at the top, and bastards, unemployed, and high school students at the bottom, but these are all labels given by others. People tend to feel more relaxed when they are strangers. The theater is a place to meet you again, escape from society and enter a new world. The fantasy of being with you is romantic.
p4 has two public accounts, one is P4 Theater, and the other is P4 Theater and you. One is for sharing recruitment information, and the other is responsible for sharing everyone's stories. The cries and appeals in the article allow everyone to meet. This is a wonderful fate, where we can reunite to find the true state of life, and choose a new path in the face of ultimate meaning and ethical dilemmas. How will people be constituted when all political and social attributes are stripped away, without identity, dignity, and meaning? It is a story about redefining life in a gray gap.
But this kind of naked encounter will always make you feel helpless, passive and even absurd again under the gaze of the "big other". Even if we take off the disguise in the theater, we still cannot completely escape the influence of social construction when we return to daily life. The "big other" is everywhere. It represents an unreachable ultimate factor that determines the fate of the subject. It means not only external laws such as fate, law, and morality, but also the fundamental lack that the subject must bear.
Life is always full of confrontation, struggle and games. The movie "Red Hot Chili Peppers" is a good interpretation of how daily life can be transformed in a fantasy space. The protagonist Atsuko Chiba uses DC Mini to peek into the dreams of others, constantly splitting into various images to deal with the control and pursuit of the Big Other. The theater space is the same as a dream, projecting strange and grotesque images into each other, revealing all the desires, fears and secrets deep in the heart. The subconscious will permeate every corner of the drama, and everything that is stable will loosen into a new order, forming new strategies under the dissolving symbols and withered alienation. Control and counter-control go hand in hand, and the subject also inscribes its own miracle in this oscillation, wandering and swinging.
14 Alienation
Alienation is a superb technique that needs to be practiced repeatedly in the theater. Like a superb spy, he can sneak into the enemy's interior but deal with it quietly, and he can handle the high pressure of tension and excitement with ease. This is an extremely complex combination of positive and negative, capturing information in a timely manner in a live environment, fighting with sounds, and competing with the heart. The high frequency of alienation occurs in every second of P4 Theater, constantly changing into new and strange forms through repeated transformation and separation. There is never a right performance, and there should never be a fixed paradigm to guide it. Hypocritical imitation and fiddling, treating the audience as fools to admonish them is a delusion, and using pity and fear to "purify" people's souls is just a self-deceiving joke. Drama is a shaky bridge. Audiences, actors, and characters all have to constantly stir on the bridge. No one is safe, the rope will break, and anything you once thought was solid will make you sober again, in a dialectical situation, on a stage full of dangers.
The plays produced by p4 are all triggered by the most real dilemmas and anxieties of the promoters. They question the world with a must-do attitude, which echoes in every line they write. When the recruited crew members began to rehearse, they were centered around the division and reconstruction of actors, characters and directors, advancing through constant questioning, trying, and reflecting on each other, and finding resonance in the constant collision of intersubjectivity. The performance that the audience sees is the last version of The Last Rehearsal. There is no fixed paradigm or standard of perfection. The process is the thinking and experience brought to the actors and the audience. This is the dramatic power that p4 pursues.
In the creative process of p4, alienation is everywhere. Between actors and characters, between characters and characters, between stage and reality, there will always be sudden interruptions or jumps in topics to remind them of the ridiculousness of the illusion of continuity itself, to break each other's thinking patterns, to separate them from the original narrative, and to generate new associations and insights. This "push" effect is like a shuttle, piercing each other's defense mechanisms back and forth, allowing us to touch the depths of our subconscious. In the process of constant transformation, separation, reconstruction, and wandering between reality and reality, a new three-dimensional relationship is formed between the stage, the audience, and reality. Drama is no longer a closed aesthetic object, but a dynamic process of interaction with reality.
"Alienation" is not just a purely aesthetic category, but has become an ethical stance and a way of social participation. Through constant withdrawal and intervention, the audience is invited to enter an open dialogue space and have a dialogue with the characters, actors and even themselves. Drama is no longer a fictional art, but a motor that changes itself into reality.
15 cruel drama
Cruelty occurs in a moment beyond experience. It smashes the common knowledge in life to pieces, so that the truth that has been imprisoned for many years can be released. Artaud peeled off all the skin of the drama, leaving only the mysterious and transcendent power like religious rituals. He abandoned the plot or characters and only retained the poetic, abstract, multi-dimensional form and language of the drama itself. This is the intensity I have been pursuing, and it is also the innermost motivation to do p4, to spread my inner intuition throughout the present.
It is no longer an imitation of reality, but presents the long-lost poetic space on its own. In this world, all elements such as language, body, space, and light are liberated and recombined to create new expressions, allowing drama to be completely reborn and bursting with the power of freedom. "Cruelty" here does not mean bloody or violent, but an uncompromising and extreme pursuit. It forces the drama to face the cruel nature of existence, reveals the dark and fragile aspects of human nature, and touches the deep fears and desires of the soul. Cruelty is a baptism of life that must be experienced. In the theater ceremony, all the senses and the authentic movements of the body are mobilized, rather than being moved by psychological empathy.
p4 I have been striving for this goal, pursuing an experience that transcends language and words and reaches people's hearts. By creating a state close to selfless breathing on the verge of death, actors and audiences can enter the torrent of life together. Between powerlessness and resistance, he uses a gesture of complete determination to attack the growing barriers between people, looking for the voice that is almost inaudible, the cry from the deep heart, and releasing the desires and impulses that rational dialogue cannot stop. The theater carries all suffering and allows the sublime to descend and feel its awe and the truth of life. Collective rituals connect and connect the lowest level memories of every life and protect our spiritual home. The ritual of collective participation is not to reproduce life, but to create life. This kind of creation is not external imitation, but internal awakening.
For p4, life is drama. A good drama must be the violent roar and tenacious struggle of life. Participants who become actors must also sacrifice, turning their most precious intuition and inner pain into sharp thorns, shooting into every pair of eyes, burning themselves in the fire of the moment. The edges will shrink to a point, frantically clearing away all lazy and stagnant structures, tearing apart the daily routine with a spell-like determination and drawing the audience into the whirlpool of spectacle. This is another more essential kind of drama, without the need for complicated decorations and additions. Everything starts from the space wrapped by the performance, using powerful illusions to dissolve the illusions and place them in a more intense venue. The crises of the times are always hidden in the corners of neglect, and the humbleness and nobility of life struggle with each other to find the meaning of existence in emergencies.
16 Human Surrender
"Human Surrender" is a word that suddenly popped up in my mind in 2023. I was eager to make a thorough summary of p4's creations over the years, so I wanted to make a movie to end p4. So I created a new form, yes, I called it Human Surrender. This is an extremely difficult concept to explain. It is a mixture of various media, training, methods, materials, and events. But this is what I have left after doing P4 Theater for so many years. It is the result of countless days and nights of research and collision with many art creators who came to p4.
Co-creation is the meaning I have always pursued. This process of collective creation itself contains the meaning of "surrender" - letting go of personal prejudices and bigotry with an open and humble mind, listening to the voices of others, accepting the existence of differences, and achieving self-breakthrough and improvement through collision and integration. There is nothing more beautiful than the shell of self disintegrating in co-creation. P4 Theater is like a dream, a container, a place where everyone can see everyone. I use photography, drama, and psychology to gather with everyone to observe, express, and record. Here we use objective camera records, concrete and tense drama practices, quarrels with equal and sincere projections, and sincere efforts to gain mutual respect. Let the trajectory of our actions write our own history and rewrite a new destiny.
Love is ignited under our mutual gaze, and works will always be produced in sincere interaction. The tightly attached camera will capture all the details of the face. I put the camera into the theater and implanted another kind of "presence" into the viewing relationship to capture, observe, and experience a subtle change between reality and fiction. The movie "Human Surrender" integrates what I want to say. It can be said that it is a meta-movie, a film produced by p4's many years of dedication and practice through me, through the people who came here, through the events we intertwined together, and through the collision between our works and this society.
Human Surrender has three levels of meaning, from individual, to group, to the mapping of the whole to form a meta-narrative structure. "Surrender" is a kind of elimination of centrism. Of course, "Human Surrender" is still a failed self-summary in the end, failing in the current predicament, but this does not hinder the enlightenment this dream gave me. In dreams, we are locked by something, a kind of despair clinging to life, unable to move. In an intimate relationship, people are given greater freedom. Everyone is afraid of contact with each other, and harm becomes protection. Fascinated by the nuances of intersubjectivity, I recruited actors and set off on this adventure. This is a crusade for love. I merge fantasy with reality, use fiction to leverage reality, and then inject fantasy into realistic pictures, allowing strange fluctuations to wander in the time and space of the film. Jianli participates frequently in rehearsals and filming. The actors are directors, photographers, and screenwriters. Everyone in the crew is a camera holder, allowing each other's perspectives to merge into a common perception, and together we can regain hope and call for the future.
The author of this article, He Fa, graduated from the Photography Department of the Central Academy of Fine Arts in 1990. He then went to the California University of the Arts for further studies and received a Master of Fine Arts degree. Over the years, he has focused on artistic creation that combines photography, social practice and drama. During this period, he put the camera into the theater, allowing another kind of "presence" to be implanted into the viewing relationship to capture, observe, and experience a subtle change between reality and fiction. The trinity of film, drama and recording allows He Fa to explore a new method to present more potentials of intersubjectivity. It will be a ghostly lens that shuttles between me and you, meeting his eyes from time to time. This is a simultaneous summons, sensing clues of the future. The shooting of a movie itself is an event, and accidents and loss of control are rare hopes in life. Sacred experience and naked life will be summoned in drama and etched into history.

P4 Theater
2024-05-08
Recruitment and conversion
Shi Jiating's Solo Exhibition｜"Reproductive" - Abandoned Tangshan Boy
Over the years of working as P4 Theater, I have come into contact with many young people, most of whom have just graduated from school or are still in...
"Negrant Reproduction"
Personal struggle and redemption under the trauma of the times
Over the years of working as P4 Theater, I have come into contact with many young people, most of whom have just graduated from school or are still in school. Shi Jia Ting is a particularly special one. Listening to his story makes me feel uncomfortable from the bottom of my heart. An invisible oppression is spreading wantonly around him. He is sensitive but can't find the direction at all.
Shi Jiating's new exhibition "Non-Birth and Reproduction" is a profound analysis of personal experience and the dilemma of the times. He used the metaphor of "shitty family" to express the confusion, anxiety and struggle of a generation of young people in an era of rapid change. This struggle is personal, but it also reflects the trauma of an entire era.
Shi Jiating once experienced a stage of isolation and depression, filled with confusion and denial. This state is like the suffocation and powerlessness of many young people under the weight of reality. The "shit family" arises from the indifference of the outside world and personal loss. When society lacks tolerance and guidance, it is difficult for individuals to find their own identity and sense of value, and they are more likely to fall into self-exile.
As an art student about to graduate, Shi Jiating should have been looking forward to the future, but the difficulty of reality made dreams become a luxury. His painting talent could have taken him further on his artistic path, but he had to worry about his livelihood. This dilemma is not unique. Many young people have dreams but feel confused in the face of cruel reality.
We need to see each other with more understanding, tolerance and love. To break the dilemma faced by young people, we need to create an environment that encourages dreams and tolerates failure, rather than blaming individuals for stress and anxiety. Young artists like Shi Jiating need to be given special attention and help so that they can regain their confidence and continue to explore their artistic path.
"Reproduction" has a strong meaning of reflection, causing us to rethink our personal situation in the times and explore the way out for human nature and society. This is a cry from the heart and a gift to this era.
PS: Shi Jiating once wrote four articles about his growing experience from childhood to adulthood and published them on P4 Theater and your official accounts. Click on the text below to jump.
"History of Youth Violence in Tangshan 1-4"
Fleas play no role in maintaining the stability of the entire ecological chain. If all the shit families are wiped out, there will only be benefits to the biosphere where they are located, but no harm. The reproduction method of the shit family is called nirvana reproduction, that is, finding a nirvana place with rich water sources, giving birth to their own nigiri in the water, and hatching and growing.
Short film documenting the reproduction of evil (simultaneously displayed)
Finding the breeding ground is an effective way to get rid of fleas. If the birthplace of the shit family is found, his sins will no longer spread.
The shit family never really gives their personality to others, never helps others with a sincere face, but always begs for others' mercy. Once the shit family finds someone who can protect a weak individual like him, they will jump on him and catch him.
Immediately after this, the shit family began to reproduce. The faces of countless shit families swarmed in all directions, and countless shit families began to jump mechanically. More than one beam of light can produce more than one shadow, and the shit family is layered on top of each other, walking in files, relying on the butyric acid emitted by the skin to find people, and relying on the temperature generated by the human body to determine the location of the jump. Once it succeeds, it will complete its mission of absorbing nutrients. Shit families formed a colony and began to wreak havoc.
We can no longer be manipulated and harmed by this kind of fleas. We have found the birthplace of shit families and caught these disgusting shit families. We can solemnly declare that the breeding of shit families is being eliminated. Through such a ritual, the problem can be solved from the source, have an impact on the real world, and truly eliminate the shit family. This is the beginning of the end of long suffering.
The Shit Family said: "The so-called kind-hearted me has never harmed others with my own will, and I have never done anything that is far beyond my own principles. I am content with the swaddling bag called "identity" that I have knitted for myself."
Shit family introduction
Shit family, liars, gangsters, real idiots, bedbugs, fleas, lice. Shit families are garbage, a pile of garbage that should have been burned to generate electricity, but the staff forgot to throw it into the incinerator. A shit family is a poison. Any place contaminated by a shit family will rot and become stinky, making people feel nauseous. Shit families like to go underground in places with little light, such as underground garages, underground passages, basements, and basements. Shit families like to lower themselves as low as possible and lie shamelessly in the dark. He claimed that only in the dark underground, "can I feel comfortable breathing the air here."

Wang lost the lawsuit!
Justice is in the heart of the people. We will always stand with you on the side of justice, against evil, and against despicability. The two-year struggle...
In May 2022, several women said they had been verbally and behaviorally harassed by Wang, the founder of Beijing Penghao Theater, and disclosed that when Wang talked about his "life aesthetics", he said "you can reach orgasm without moving."
On June 20, 2022, Wang publicly announced through the official WeChat of Beijing Penghao Theater that he would sue 12 people on the grounds of "reputation disputes."
It is reported that a large number of people who have worked at Penghao Theater have said that they have witnessed him harassing other young women. When describing the frequency of harassment, they use terms similar to "can be seen almost every day", and they are deeply emotional and hateful. Some victims also called the police and testified about this.
On December 6, 2023, the Beijing Internet Court ruled in the first instance to reject all Wang's claims in accordance with the law.
Later, Wang filed an appeal.
On April 23, 2024, the Beijing No. 4 Intermediate People's Court made a final judgment in accordance with the law to reject the appeal and uphold the original judgment.

sources.text:
P4 Theater and You
2024-03-19
Events and Performances
Self-Material Project | "Tangshan Boy - The Artist's Final Chapter" 04
Shi Jiating's "Tangshan Boys" series is a must-read for everyone. Violence never disappears, it goes deep into the bones.
I can also recall many scattered things from when I was very young.
The pain of cutting one's hand with a knife. The burning sensation of caterpillars burrowing into clothes. The first time I went to the beach with my parents, I dived into the sea and swam, feeling suffocated by the sea water. Being bitten by a bat and worrying about being infected by the virus. The pigs were angered in the pigsty in my hometown in the countryside, and the fear caused by the pig's madness. I injured my classmate, and the classmate's parents sat in the school office with a arrogant look, which brought about oppression. The grievance of being told by a classmate, "How little do you think you are?" etc.
I don't think it's an individual thing, I don't think it's because I had a less fortunate childhood than others, or that I'm an individual prone to remembering painful feelings. I think it's a genetic thing. The complex coding of genes allows individuals to remember dangerous events and define the feeling of such events as "painful", so that individuals can avoid such dangers and become safer. However, human society is obviously developing faster than spotted hyena society, and our genetic coding has also fallen behind. If humans are not genetically coded to remember happy things, it would be difficult to support individual survival today.
When I was in the first grade of junior high school, I had a classmate named K who makes me happy when I think about it now. She and I just fight every day. I hit her and she chases me, or vice versa. Or scold each other. If I can't catch her or she can't catch me, I will knock down the other person's desk. One time I pulled her hair and hid in the men's room. She rushed into the men's room without any hesitation, chased me, and beat me. The fight between me and her was intense, somewhere between just being playful and being really angry. She once said to me, I get excited when I see you.
Then she jumped off the building, reportedly because she was slapped by her mother at home. She was very lucky. She only broke her foot when she jumped from the fifth floor. At that time, my mother was undergoing surgery for appendicitis, and I was with her in the hospital. K was in the ward next to me, and from time to time he screamed like a slaughtered pig. I went over to laugh at her and she got really angry. Later, she often didn't come to class, and I didn't know her whereabouts.
In my first year of junior high school, I played very well with the student who was last in the exam in the class and we often chatted together. It's a pity that my seat is closer to the front and he is in the last row, otherwise we would be able to talk during class. His name is M, he is from the village, not a descendant of the Sanyou Group.
My parents didn't worry about my choice of primary school or junior high school because I went directly to a school for the children of the factory. When I was in elementary school, my classes were almost all workers' children. After I got to junior high school, some nearby villages didn't have a junior high school, so I went to my junior high school. M finished primary school in the village, and I was assigned to the same class in junior high school. He said he was quite powerful in the village and if I was bullied I could go to him. What he said is true. The gangsters who live in the building community are really afraid of him. Compared with other boys, he looks very stable. He only chats with me and my classmates, and does not fight or bully others. Or maybe he's too tall and fat to move that fast.
The most beautiful girl in the class at that time was named #, with delicate facial features, dark skin color, and brown lips that matched her skin color. M changed his QQ personalized signature to I #, and often sent her messages. M also often teases her in class. M is very scary for a child, tall and wide, with a sinister face. I don't like him, but I don't dislike M teasing her, and she plays with him with a smile.
M didn't finish his first year of junior high school, so he went back to the village to work. I saw him again in the third grade of junior high school. He went back to school to visit his teachers and classmates. When I was out of school, I saw him standing at the top of the stairs, playing with the latest Apple 5s. He saw me and greeted me, and asked me with a smile if I would like to go to dinner in the evening. He invited me. I also smiled and said no, no, I am about to take the high school entrance examination.
The person who came last in the class was called N, from another village. He, M and I often played together. He would sometimes be arrogant and arrogant to me, but not to the extent that I was disgusted. Unlike M, he often conflicts with the evil children in the community. It's hard for me to recall specific things about him now, probably because he died.
When he was in the third grade of junior high school, he went out for fun at night and sat on the back seat of his friend's motorcycle. When he turned right, he ran into a bread that was traveling in the opposite direction. His entire leg and his penis were knocked off. The next day during the day, I was painting in the studio and saw the news on QQ. I thought N had beaten someone up again, and someone was scolding him on QQ. After repeated confirmations, I realized that he was really dead. Now in my memory, apart from the sadness of learning about his death, I remember very little about being with him, and I can hardly recall it.
N once arranged a group fight with C. C brought more than 20 people, and N called over 60 people. The people on N's side started to fight as soon as they came up. As soon as the fight started, M and a few other people quickly shouted to stop, because if they hit him a few more times, something might happen. But even if he shouted stop so quickly, C still suffered a broken arm.
This is what M told me. They didn't call me. They think my studies are good and they usually don't call me out when there are group fights.
During the time after N's death, C always looked gloomy in school. Many people in the school looked gloomy, and the entire junior high school building looked gloomy. N was very popular, and many people were saddened by his death. There was a boy from N's same village, and I had a very good relationship with him. I wanted to spend more time with him, but he was extremely emotionally unstable at that time and avoided everyone.
There is another interesting thing. There is a fool in the school that everyone hates. He knows that everyone is annoying him and looking down on him, so he scolds others every chance he gets, letting others scold him or beat him up to gain attention. But whether it was because he kept provoking others, or whether he was isolated by other students first, the cause and effect has long been unclear. The fool was beaten very hard by N before. After N died, he made a comment in school that N would die well. So about twenty or thirty boys, including me, blocked his way home and beat him every day for about a week. The fool told his dad, who called the police, but it didn't seem to be of much use. Then his dad takes him to and from school every day.
Later, I asked my classmates about the outcome of the car accident. They said that the man driving the van was drunk and driving on the wrong side of the road, but his family was well connected, so he did not go to jail and was only compensated 400,000 yuan.
As I wrote, I actually felt like I had written a plot similar to a best-selling novel. When I started writing, I thought I would have nothing to write about, so I considered various other ways to help myself survive. But I actually felt that the plot I wrote seemed very exaggerated, and could be rewritten into a novel to sell, or two plays. Does this mean that my experience is different and I am born to be an artist, or does it mean that my brain has tampered with my memory to make it attractive, or something else?
After I entered junior high school, I not only got to know the children in the village, but also the people from Nanbao Salt Factory. The salt factory is adjacent to where I live, and there is a prison there. Many of them are children of prison-related cadres. They look different from us workers' children and the villagers. They obviously have better skin, are more educated, and study better.
When I was in the first year of junior high school, most of the students in the class from Nanyan were ranked first in the O exam, and I was ranked second. O is very cute, with a big round head and very white color. We call him Dandan. He is a stereotypical good student. It seems that his family's input has allowed him to know a lot about Mathematical Olympiads, ancient poetry and the like. He is very happy to show off the knowledge he has learned in the class. He is also arrogant, pleases his teachers, and often talks about Chinese submarines near the United States. He has all the characteristics that a good student should have. But he was restless and had a feeling of being a good baby in the family who wanted to go out of his way, so he attracted me to play with him.
But we haven't done anything interesting. He usually can't go out to play after school or on weekends. We only go to each other's houses to play games, or discuss exercises in class. When I go to play billiards or throw small paper balls in class, he never dares to talk because he is afraid of affecting his image of a good boy in the eyes of adults. He gets very happy when he sees me causing trouble in class.
But there is one thing I still remember. In the second grade of junior high school, one day a student in the class who was very poor in studies, named P, wanted to copy Dandan's homework. Dandan refused to give it to him, but he kept asking for it, and Dandan said to get lost. He was very unhappy and started pushing his balls, and then he only pushed hard once. I became extremely angry, yelled, how dare I hit my balls, and beat P hard in front of everyone in the class, using a lot of force. My behavior is abnormal. Now that I think about it, Dandan looks very cute, so I may have strange feelings for Dandan. I have always liked women, but my level of protectiveness towards my balls is indeed more than that of ordinary friends.
Now I am not in pain because I beat P. What I am in pain is another thing.
After this incident, P kept threatening to find students from technical secondary schools to kill me. Everyone advised me and P to apologize, but I refused. I actually felt that what I did was wrong, but I didn't want P or others to think that I was apologizing because I was afraid of being beaten. A few days later, P's mother secretly found my mother. She told my mother sincerely that her bastard son was going to kill me, and asked my mother to persuade me to apologize to avoid more serious consequences. So I was moved by P's mother and went directly to P's house to apologize to him. P was very happy after seeing me and hugged me. I sat in his room for a while, but when I thought about the cruel words he said, I still didn't want to be the so-called "coward". I said, my mother asked me to apologize, so I came. I just didn't tell him about his mother.
Later I thought about how painful it was for me to do this. Because later I realized that Dandan had always looked down on students who were not good at studying. Whether it was because he borrowed homework or had always felt disrespected, P was unhappy with Dandan, and ended up being beaten by another student who was very good at studying. So when I went to formally apologize, he felt respected and became so happy, but I told him that my apology was not my wish. It would have been nice if I had sincerely apologized to him when I went to his house. He would have been so happy. What's more, I already felt that I had done something wrong.
Things like this have always tortured me, things like the harm I have caused to others have always tortured me.
Later, until the high school entrance examination, my relationship with P was not good. He provoked troubles with me many times, but I did not respond.
In the second grade of junior high school, I was re-divided into classes, and I quickly got mixed up with the gangster leader Q. Because I was very tall in the second grade of junior high school, I sat in the back row, very close to Q. Then we talked in class and found that we had similar temperaments, so we played together.
When I first started in the second grade of junior high school, I drew some obscene comics about various mutated sexual organs, huge sexual organs, and liquids that could turn into various forms. I showed it to Q first, and then he became the publicity ambassador for the comics I drew. The male bad students sitting in the back row all read my comics and affirmed them.
There is a boy named % in the second grade class. He is short and very naughty. He teases other students in the class every day. He didn't dare to tease a gangster leader like Q, but he dared to tease me. He annoyed me for a while, and when I got tired of it, I pushed him to the ground and beat him on the way to school. I thought he would be honest, but unexpectedly he became even more aggressive. He probably underestimated the threat I posed to him and refused to accept my beating, so he began to use all his time to scold me persistently. So I made an appointment with him and asked Q to call someone for me. He said that he could make everyone afraid to do anything by himself. Q and I went there that day. I knocked % down with one punch, and then I hit him on the ground with my fist. I wanted to solve the problem once and for all and make him stop bothering me. But while the fight was going on, Q picked me up and loudly threatened everyone to go back. I was puzzled. He told me the next day that he saw the politics teacher coming this way. The result is that although % has restrained himself a lot, he still scolds me tirelessly, and I can't do anything about it.
Q once asked me to go out for a walk, and then went to the basement of his house to chat. There was Guan Yu in the basement. He respectfully called me "big brother" and asked me to call him "big brother". He told me what he was fighting about. When he was very young, a group of people came over to discuss business in his family's sales department. He was from Luannan, Tangshan, and he couldn't agree with his father, so a few people came up to him. Q's father immediately pulled off the table legs and started to fight with them. That incident left a heavy psychological shadow on him, and he later started fighting.
After I hit P, Q, like others, advised me to apologize to P. But I didn't listen to him.
After playing with Q, we played with R again. If I remember correctly, fourteen-year-old R already weighs more than 160 pounds. He is not fat, has no fat, but looks like a door. Later, when I was in high school, I came across his photo on QQ space. He started working out and became slimmer.
If I remember correctly, I should have weighed over eighty pounds at the time. R's daily pleasure was to study how to lift me. Pick it up, carry it, hold it under one arm, etc. In one physical education class, R put me on his shoulders and ran a full circle around the playground.
And actually, it was more painful for me to hang out with them because the two of them bullied me all the time. It shouldn't be considered bullying in the true sense. I fought my bully to the death, but later he beat someone to death and fled to Qinhuangdao.
Q once encouraged R to carry me to the men's room or the abandoned building in the back after class, pull off my pants, and say I was big. R once turned me around like a toy and asked me if it hurt. Q once suddenly threw me to the ground and laughed. They used to bury my feet together. Wait, wait.
One time, R wanted to teach me how to smoke. I said that I thought smoking was bad. This sentence may have stung him and made him think that I was a good student at that time. After school, he took me to an alley and asked me to give up, otherwise he would beat me.
I do smoke now.
Some people in the school couldn't stand it, and they told me and Q about it. But a fourteen- to fifteen-year-old boy who grew up in an industrial development zone must not be good at solving this kind of problem. Q asked me in a low voice after school one day, did I bully you? I didn't know how to answer, and I said no.
I'm not actually a coward. I have a very bad temper. I've offended many people in school, but I've never been a coward. Several times others wanted to beat me up, but Q helped me solve the problem. At that time, there was a kind of younger brother in the school who would stick to those who were good at fighting, and even give pocket money to the older brother. Some people in the school thought that I was also such a person, which made me feel aggrieved. Because I have always fought on my own before and never thought about relying on anyone.
It was actually a mental block of mine and it's still my problem to this day. Once someone is defined as a "friend" in my mind, I never express my displeasure or attack. This was true for Q and R, and it is still true now that I am almost twenty-five years old. At first, I thought it was okay when Q and R teased me like this. Later, I did feel unhappy, but I couldn't tell them seriously that I was unhappy, and I rarely expressed my unhappiness to my friends. It was too difficult. This obstacle has always made me unhappy. I can barely manage my relationships with everyone around me. My relationships with other people would always slide towards a situation where I was attacked and then unhappy.
This is because I always have a negative attitude toward relationships with others. And, no matter how lonely or unhappy I felt, no matter how much my problems affected me, I had no desire to change my attitude. Maybe it's also a self-destructive tendency, I'm not sure. Anyway, it doesn't quite match the definition of Stockholm.
Maybe I was born a lonely artist, suffering from the pain of not being understood by the world. Only by pursuing great art alone can I realize the meaning of my life.
N and Q are from the same village and have been playing together since they were naked. After N's death, Q's mood was extremely unstable. I didn't have much contact with him, and he passed the high school entrance examination not long after.
"Tangshan Boy - Mother's Dream" 03

The Self-Material Project is an exploration into the inner self, which includes cherishing and organizing personal memories, dreams and various life fragments. We hope that through this plan, we can build a shared collective subconscious with you, so that we can roam together in the infinite sea. This program encourages us to look back on our experiences and piece together fragmented memories and dreams into a meaningful story in order to better understand ourselves, our past and our future. By sharing and communicating these precious moments, we can create deeper connections and explore together the complexity and beauty of human life.

Solution introduction INTRODUCTION
The dream repeats, happening in the brain, reacting in the body, and then waking up trembling.
Messy. Everything was messed up and fragmented. The compound eye that wanted to grow turned into a spherical blade, rolling into the body from the eye socket. It moved continuously, like a 3D pinball. It was impossible to predict the trajectory. I could only control the two swinging rockers at the moment it was about to fall, and hit it back to the body, trying to find the pattern in the continuous impact and crushing.
The mouse controls the joystick, the pinball controls the dream, the dream controls the body, and the body controls the mouse.
Cycle, cycle, cycle, cycle...
Can't shoot, can't shoot, can't shoot, can't shoot...
Can't touch, can't touch, can't touch, can't touch...
Can't tear it apart, can't tear it apart, can't tear it apart, can't tear it apart...
The particles of language form a fog, and the language flows and forms a paste, layer after layer, wrapped in weakness, hypocrisy, control, and selfishness. What beautiful and fitting clothes, wrapped around the body, covering up the tremors, and then standing in front of each specific person and saying: "Look, I'm naked, I love you, let's connect."
An octagonal cylinder with a side length of 1.25 meters and a height of 6.5 meters
Wrapped in a translucent membrane structure. Material properties unknown. Membrane ductility unknown.
Everything is getting out of control.
But you believe there is something out there.
Did I see it?
You see it, but you can only see the shape. What it is, what it is doing, and why it is there, you don't know. It seems to have always been there. No matter how the outside world changes, it has always been there, but you have never noticed it before. When you noticed it, you were caught by it.
That is the imagination created in this uncertain world.
You want it to be real, no longer confusing, understandable, and indifferent.
These rules can be my weapon.
What weapon?
A weapon that can help you solve problems.
