sources.text:
P4 Theater
2024-01-23
Theory and Methods
Travel around the universe｜Become a clone of you and me in one second
Song Menglan has a lot of unfinished works, which has become a big worry for her. I told her to come to 510 to do an exhibition and have all your materials...
Song Menglan has many unfinished works, which has become a major concern for her. I told her to come to 510 to hold an exhibition. All your materials will be reorganized within two weeks, and the editing and soundtrack will be completed as soon as possible. She said yes.
When recording "Personal Chronicle", she insisted on looking at me and saying that she would not let the phone stand between me and her. She wanted to have a conversation and express her feelings at a close distance. I said yes.
Meng Lan's WeChat name is trees. She said that she was deeply influenced by Calvino. She didn't want to be in the sky or on the earth, she just wanted to be stuck in a tree. She said that she was abandoned by her parents since she was a child and raised herself by herself. She is her own mother. She said that people are like sand, there is no pipe between us, only water flows through it, and sand remains unchanged in the river.
Meng Lan is a film director, her image is strange, no one knows what she will become. But what is certain is that she never compromised on her ideals. She took a knife and dived into the deep sea with the stars to catch butterflies and become a fish.
"Song of Travel"
Song Menglan
"Wandering Song" is composed of images, but it is by no means just images. All presences are "occurrences" and "evidences"
The idea for "Songs of Travel" came about in early 2003.
Initially, the protagonist in the image was "travelled" in the form of a movie script. It tells the story of a man who wants to express his desires through the mouth of a performing character after losing the ability to speak. In fact, actors often face this problem. The usual pattern is that the parts of life that cannot be revealed due to repression are released through performance in prescribed situations, and the performed parts are eliminated by the identity of "actor". Of course, there are also some people who think that performance within a prescribed situation is a kind of reality, and people are forced to act out the depression in life. These two rhetorics, which vary from person to person, invariably lead to the boundary between reality and performance. It seems that both sides are true, and everything seems to be false.
So during the filming of "Wandering Song", with the help of AC Community Art Space and friends, we conducted a real drama script reading. Except for Sun Jiarui, the actor of "Wandering", who walked within the established plot, the rest of the people were informed that the camera was on before entering the scene. Everyone was asked to randomly come on stage with their identities as actors to perform the drama. Therefore, everyone has more than two identities. First, he is a different participant in the reading meeting, and second, he is a character in his own script.
Of course, as Zhou You, he also has a third role.
The character Zhou You is a typical gender archetype in my creation. It essentially comes from my fantasy about male identity. Men seem to always be on the road to becoming, like a road to production. When a person fantasizes about becoming something and maintains his own order to achieve "him", he will become his own big other. He is always on the road to becoming that and becoming. When the pause begins, he will fall into endless nothingness. And this nothingness is exactly another result he wants. "Predicting everything and predicting every step beforehand" is the path to becoming a 'god' for someone who wants to become a self-conceived person. Correspondingly, women who have gained fertility are women themselves who are creators, and the prototype of women is been, so for women, to be is no longer a purpose. The purpose of men seems to be to become gods and women.
This is the first entry point from gender, production is a motif for me.
Traveling is not a representative of a gender. "Male" here is a quality, a Sisyphus-like growth path after discipline: acting in a prescribed situation. It seems that this statement is closer to reality. The artistic works break up and reconstruct the minutiae of life, thus creating the character Zhou You. The role played by Zhou You in the video has to play a role, but if you can't get out of the play, you can't get into the play. If you want to get into the play, you have to get out of the play. The contradiction lies here, pain arises, our real problems are exposed, and the boundaries between real and false are confused. This blur is reflected in all problems in the world, and where is the truth? Religious people point to God, and self-consistent people point to themselves. This cycle of nothingness reinforces itself until the load collapses. But is reality really just a dialectical law?
The real term is covered by falsehood, and the real self in fiction will inevitably collapse. From Zhou You's eyes, this is the first perspective.
The problem of traveling is also my problem. If I can't act, how should I arrange myself? "Faith" has no object. This alienation is not only a creative instinct, but also a painful bottomless pit. A second perspective is created here, moving the camera to watch all this, together with everyone. Simulate a perpetual onlooker's eye. In fact, none of the characters played are really involved in the play. The detached part is here, and the prescribed situation is just a kind of interpretation. This eye maintains the illusion of objectivity, watching everything that is planned to happen. Like an invisible surveillance camera, behind such surveillance, an extremely arrogant and deified self stands there as the Creator. He seems to predict and control everything that happens, and the pain caused by it is his purpose. Stop, eternity, in the twilight zone before the final step to solve the problem. And where is the real audience? There is no real audience. The audience is a part of the scene at this moment. The audience is also the audience in the relationship between the performance and the image formed. The audience is also the gazer behind all of this. And behind all of this...
We are always in an unfinished spectatorial relationship, and we think we are the creator. This is the second perspective of traveling around.
The role played by Zhou You's actor has to play a role, and the role played by the audience has to play a role. Zhou You, as the creator of the entire scene, has constructed this situation. As the creator, I have constructed Zhou You. I stand behind the camera together with you. This is the God's perspective that we open when watching an image work. In the process of such a performance within a performance and fiction within fiction, the boundaries between true and false are blurred. But at this moment, your identity as an audience member is random, so you become the uncertainty among all the certainties. Of course, this is far from the end.
This is the third perspective, you can be you, you can be traveling around, you can be separated, you can be me.
In fact, there are endless discussions on the root causes, which are directly proportional to the inward and outward explorations. There is no answer to the inward exploration of the analysis of the spirit of seeking delusion and the outward exploration of the practice of reciprocating life. How can the old language carry this weight of nothing, which has no beginning, no end, and nothing? We can only do this, create a new language.

sources.text:
P4 Theater and You
2024-01-17
Theory and Methods
Self-Material Project｜"Tangshan Boy - Dream About Mother" 03
I dreamed that I was quarreling with my mother again. I was shaking with anger and screaming at the top of my lungs.
I dreamed that I was quarreling with my mother again. I was shaking with anger and screaming at the top of my lungs. After I woke up, I still felt uncontrollable heart palpitations, as if my whole body was floating in mid-air. I still wanted to yell, but when I woke up I completely forgot what I was going to yell. My family is not harmonious and we spend a lot of time arguing. If I were to be judged, I was also unfilial because conversations with my mother would often turn into shouting and I would sometimes throw things and bang my fists against walls. One time, I was in a rental house near my high school. My parents were both there. My mother kept talking to me. As she was talking, I turned over the dining table. Then my dad also started scolding me. I ran to the kitchen and wanted to jump off the 18th floor. As soon as I touched the window sill, my dad, who reacted quickly, hugged my leg.
My parents are different from what many people call their parents. From a young age, my parents treated me as a human being. As I grow older, I feel more and more that my parents don't have any specific expectations for me, as long as I live. They only have the most universal requirements for me, such as being kind to others and not committing crimes. When I talked to my parents since I was a child, I would discuss issues and communicate as if we were two people, rather than as many people say, only my parents have the final say. My parents also give me a lot of company.
Moreover, I don't care about issues such as getting married and having children, buying a house or a car, or having a stable job, which are all talked about now. Because social values kidnap a person, most of them are embodied by his parents. If parents don't care about other people's opinions, then they almost don't have to think about those issues anymore.
I write this not to say that my family is superior to others. What I want to express is my confusion. Because the various conflicts between other people and their parents that I learned from the outside world could not remind me why I kept quarreling with my mother.
In my memory, the content of the quarrel between my mother and I is completely blank. I only remember the sounds, looks, movements, and smells, but I can't remember the words we spoke at all. It's like in my memory, my quarrels with my mother always consisted of shouting out various meanings without any specific content. It was as if I were a hard drive and my complete memory of text-formatted files was extracted and completely deleted.
I never take the initiative to recall the quarrels between my mother and I. It wasn't until I fell in love again in 2021 that I gradually stopped quarreling with my mother. But I occasionally have dreams about quarreling with my mother, which reminds me of this feeling. I felt that I should have known what I was shouting in my dream, and I also knew what my mother was shouting. But once I wake up, I will immediately forget it, only the anxiety keeps aftershocks.
Actually, I talked about this problem with my mother, and she said it was because I didn't do my homework, got into fights, or something like that. But I don't remember it. But I just don't remember it anymore. I spent so much time and energy on quarreling with my mother, hurting each other, and worked hard for it. But now I have completely forgotten all the content, and there is no clue to associate it with the memory. This is amazing. I feel helpless about my memory.
Besides, I feel guilty. I forgot all the arguments I had with my mother. But I remember everything else. I remember my words hurting my mother. Although I also remember that my mother once hurt me.
I often fantasize about being a superman, and subconsciously I also ask myself to be a superman. I feel painful about all the qualities in myself that I am not satisfied with. I feel painful about all the things I have done that I am not satisfied with. I feel that this should not be done and I must change. I regard becoming my ideal image as my pursuit. In my ideal life, I am a superman. I never feel sorry for myself, never make meaningless memories, live in the present in a real sense, act for others and myself every moment, and never consider myself more than I consider others. And his eyes are as bright as a torch, able to distinguish good from evil. Although there is no great goal, we have been working hard for everyone's life and the progress of civilization. Wait, wait, etc., there are many such requests.
This shows that I should have symptoms of obsessive-compulsive and paranoid symptoms.
I tend to be pretentious, which is all too common. I would like to think that I am different from other people. I would like to think that I have great diseases and wonderful thoughts, and I keep telling myself this. Now, I've come to realize that there's nothing special about me.
I gradually realized that my current state may be regarded as strange simply because I have always felt that I have been wronged, and I have no way to resolve it, and I am slowly suffocating. There is no sense of independence from the world in my past fantasies. Maybe it's the so-called youthful confusion that everyone experiences when they're young, maybe it's also Daiyu's sentimentality, maybe it's the superposition of various factors that lead to some symptoms of mental illness in me, such as the obsessive-compulsive symptoms that require me to be a superman, etc. This is a normal reaction of an ordinary living body after encountering certain pathogens. This does not mean that I am an immortal who suffers misunderstanding and ostracism from the world, as I thought before.
I wrote something similar to what I had read countless times in marketing accounts. The marketing account is to add emotional packaging to simple and common problems to spread the word through emotions.
I'm unemployed now. I think about my life sometimes. If my mental state could be treated and managed scientifically from an early age, I might have a completely different life. I may not have regarded painting as my only outlet since I was a child. Maybe I relied on my dad to work in his company as a worker. Maybe I studied mechanics in college and got a graduate degree in school. Maybe I have opened a small restaurant at home. Of course, this is not necessarily happier than now, just very different.
The place where I lived when I was a child was the family building of a state-owned factory. This community is the thing that makes me happy in my memories. The security here is surprisingly good, and there have never been any incidents. There are many idle old people hanging out downstairs. They even shoveled a piece of the public lawn below their respective buildings to grow vegetables. The workers were not as tired as today's workers. After get off work, the male workers played cards and ball in the community, while the female workers did not stay in the community and went shopping outside. Kids like me were running around in the entire area of the family building. Nowadays, there are a lot fewer elderly people, workers and children in the community. It is probably because our society has become more civilized, creating a quiet and harmonious urban landscape.
There was an old lady in the building next door who planted a cherry tree on the lawn. After it produced cherries, I often went to steal them with my classmates. When she saw it, she would run out and curse. She also raised chickens in the enclosure downstairs. I beat her chickens, and then she came to my house to argue with my mother.
Among the children running around in the community, L was very noisy. When she was very young, she said that she liked a very honest little boy and fell in love with him. They broke up not long after. Later, she accumulated many records of dating.
If I were to ask a question to describe her, it would be like an open-book exam. She is in need of love. Her parents had little control over her, and she relied heavily on her grandmother who owned a canteen. Later, her parents got divorced, and she told her children about her affairs, which became a famous saying. She said she told her parents to either give me happiness or give me half a million to buy happiness.
A asked me to go to his studio to learn painting, and later L also went with A. L's painting was okay at first. She liked to polish the brush strokes in the painting very finely. Later, she spent more and more time outside with the male students who were fighting, and she stopped coming to the studio to paint. One day I became that so-called good kid again. She passed by the studio one day and came in to take a look. The teacher pointed at my paintings, complained that she didn't come to paint, and said look at what Shi Jiating had already painted.
A and I were cold to her for a while, and she would cause damage by knocking down our bicycles and the like. Her destruction is different from the ordinary destruction of a little boy, she is doing it to gain attention. Later, her methods became more and more extreme. One time, she buried several thumbtacks in A's car seat. Both A and I were very angry. At that time I felt that L liked A.
When I was in the second grade of junior high school, A might also like L, but I looked down on L very much at that time. I told A that I could get a girl like L in minutes. I wanted to express my contempt for L, but A thought I was provoking him and was very unhappy. So I was also very unhappy and proposed to bet him 20 yuan on whether I could fall in love with L. Later A found B to help him. A few days later, I found out that L had been fingered by B. A came to me and asked for twenty yuan, but I didn't give it to him and I didn't say anything. During that time he kept scolding me. Later, when I thought about this incident, I felt very painful. It was not the process of the painful event, but the painful way I did it.
L and I actually met once after a long time. I was in college at the time, and L also took the art college entrance examination and came to my university to take the art exam. She asked me on QQ if I could help her move her painting tools. After meeting, she has become very sociable and dressed up beautifully. I invited her to have a meal in the cafeteria at noon. She kept talking, so I responded to her. I remember that the only time she complimented me that day was when I asked for a cigarette and I gave her Yuxi. She was very surprised. In fact, I have been smoking very cheap cigarettes, and I just wanted to change my taste during those two days, so I bought a box of Yuxi.
I learned painting because when I was a child, I often went to artificial lakes to catch fish and shrimps. My parents were afraid that I would drown and did not have enough time to look after me. I happened to like painting, so they put me into a half-custody and half-painting tutoring class. The teacher was very amateur, so I went to his studio after being introduced by A.
The studio is opened by a father and son. The son is about thirty years old and his name is J. Both father and son like to paint traditional Chinese paintings, including tigers. Both father and son have very bad tempers. They often quarrel in the studio, and the volume is extremely high. It is said that the old man also has an ex-wife, with whom he has a son who is engaged in music and graduated from the Central Conservatory of Music. The old man also has a calligraphy and painting shop on the pedestrian street, selling calligraphy and painting, but he always helps his son teach. The old man is obviously a better teacher than his son. When I went there, it was around 2010, and the domestic art exam-oriented education was beginning to become deformed, and my son was obviously affected by those exam books. Of course, the education of Western painting in our country has a huge problem, which involves the artists who studied in the Soviet Union and France in the early years of our country. I will definitely not talk about it.
Not long after I came here, J was admitted to the Central Academy of Fine Arts as a part-time graduate student. He worked very hard to market his identity as a graduate student at Central American Academy of Sciences. He added the words "Central American Academy of Sciences" in front of the door of his studio. He often showed his students photos of himself and his tutor. He often boasted about how great his tutor was. He felt that he had entered a "disciple" and that his fellow graduate students were his "senior brothers and sisters" and they all respected their mentor very much. What he said was quite in the style of the current "Central American School".
His famous saying is "Sail against the current, if you don't advance, you will retreat." He taught students that they must work hard to draw, work hard to climb up, and must work hard to gain more fame and fortune so that others can respect themselves.
My grades in junior high school were very good and I was admitted to the best high school in Tangshan. J wanted me to take the art high school entrance examination, but I didn't want to take it. Then J called my mother whenever he was free. My mother couldn't stand J annoying her, so she told me that I should take the exam, so I took the exam.
I returned home after the college entrance examination and painted a plaster statue in his studio for about two weeks. During this period, I also helped to educate his students. Before I went to college, he treated me to dinner and gave me five hundred yuan. Later, he wanted to open a college entrance examination studio and asked me to work with him. I refused because I felt that I couldn't get along with his personality. But he called me several times after that, saying that I was learning to paint when I was a child, and that he wanted me to do it with him, which made me very annoyed. I was embarrassed and turned him down a few more times.
The Self-Material Project is an exploration into the inner self, which includes cherishing and organizing personal memories, dreams and various life fragments. We hope that through this plan, we can build a shared collective subconscious with you, so that we can roam together in the infinite sea. This program encourages us to look back on our experiences and piece together fragmented memories and dreams into a meaningful story in order to better understand ourselves, our past and our future. By sharing and communicating these precious moments, we can create deeper connections and explore together the complexity and beauty of human life.

Communist Script | "Song of Traveling"
Song Menglan, female, from Zhangjiakou, a person with a long tail.
Part 1
He thought this was his special power. After staring at a spot under a dark light for a long time, everything in front of him blurred along with the lines of each object. The whole world became a gray patch, and the entire universe became a flat surface, extending and collapsing infinitely, until he shook his head and everything came back.
He has often played this game since he was a child, all the time and on various occasions, crawling out before being swallowed up by the imaginary world. There is no sharp point in the surrounding people and the surrounding environment that can pierce him. His world is all walls, brick by brick, a self-constructed house, and if he wants to maintain peace, he must keep his own order. This is his sense of security and his home.
He was still looking at each other. In such a rehearsal hall, several people were sitting together. This was the interview session of a play. He signed up to be an actor in a play. The people in front of him took turns performing and introducing themselves. He was about to come. The world he had created was facing the final step of disintegration. This was the decisive moment. The person next to him pushed his back with his arm. The whole world suddenly jumped before my eyes. They asked him to introduce himself and act out a favorite character from the play.
This is a play with all kinds of ancient scripts compiled into a thick book, from the ethical myths of ancient Greece that involved beheading, bleeding, killing one's father and marrying one's mother, to contemporary autobiographies of artists who use neurosis to cover up mediocrity. This comprehensive book is the essence of human language that has been misplaced in the dirtiest frontiers of the past thousands of years. Every word they say is engraved on a kind of human spinal cord. On the Pillar of Shame, human beings whose maternal genes have been passed down for thousands of years are constructed and trained. This is the root of mankind. He thought, this deep call broke his balance. For half a year, he had not spoken in the past six months. He was trying to wait for some grand destiny picture to suddenly invade the originally unbalanced life form. He needed to speak so much.
After the collapse of a certain intimate relationship last time, he established a certain order for himself in order to heal himself. Because he opened too much, he had to close more in order to maintain balance, so he closed his mouth. And man, being a man, his desire to connect with the outside world keeps getting stronger and stronger, he is surrounded by walls of his own making, and now he wants to get out. He firmly believed that there was something that could lead him out, and now it came.
Part 2
He chose a play about a blind man who wanted to tell everyone that an earthquake was coming, but no one on the street believed him, so he and the people here died here due to the earthquake.
He pulled several chairs down on the ground and laid them down. Then he lay on the ground and acted like a dead body in front of everyone.
There was silence.
After a few minutes he stood up.
He was about to cry. He looked at everyone in despair and helplessness. He wanted to call everyone by name. When his sense came back, he suddenly saw the other person. No, this is a blind man. He lowered his head, gradually twitched, and roared incomprehensibly, starting with a heavy bass, and slowly becoming sharper, until the low cry made his chest swell and he could no longer breathe. Then he breathed a sigh of relief, vomited, and knelt on the ground in a vomiting state. He rubbed his fingers on the floor and let out a harsh, dry scream. He fell to the ground tiredly, and his saliva and tears were mixed on the floor.
He closed his eyes, he didn't want to get up again.
Someone awkwardly clapped twice and then fell silent.
How to break this situation? Is he playing a blind man, a mute, or a madman?
Or he wasn't acting at all.
He lay still. It seems that as long as you don't move, you don't have to face anything, and everything can be cut off from beginning to end and just flow in the middle. The same is true for everyone. When an event does not lead to any results, in the middle is the best way. No one wants to break this situation.
For a long time, he seemed to be dead.
Some people are destined to be abandoned by language. It's time to end this, he thought. The focus of his eyes became loose again, his body and heart were out of sync, and he smiled. stand up. Bow to everyone.
"I am all of you, and now we are all dead," he said in sign language.
He failed. The power didn't burst into words from his throat. "Force" doesn't even exist, so is it all just an illusion? Not speaking anymore became a lie to himself, and he became a blind man unable to reconcile with the mute. He did not become his own god as he wished, but fell into an endless self-made hell.
There was nothing, and for the first time in his life he felt a sinking emptiness.
Returning to their seats, everyone was still immersed in the hoarse torture. The next person next to him stumbled and introduced himself, glanced at him, and continued his performance.
To a certain extent, he has become a disabled person as he wished, and his disability is his expression. They were still whispering that a mute successfully played the role of a blind man, and then he got a prophecy, and eventually everyone died because of his disability.
That man was extremely tough, and his eyes kept looking at him. An aura of resentment and death emanates from the performer and the other people next to him. He has done nothing wrong. He just destroyed the hypocritical, friendly, and mutually sensual magnetic field of this space, as if everyone will take revenge on him from now on.
He fled the place quickly.
Part 3
On the subway, imagination flows in continuously with the rumble of the carriage. One person raised his hand and asked him, "Why don't you speak?" One, two, three, four, five, everyone stood up in unison, "Why don't you speak, why don't you speak, why don't you speak..." The voices continued to mix and roar, and the questions turned into curses, and the curses turned into scolding. He opened his mouth to explain, but no sound came out. The person opposite looked up at him, and he looked away. How lucky a person is to be able to use a character and a medium to express his true feelings. And he became mute in order to speak, and blind in order to speak. In order to become a "human", he moves further and further away from "human".
He started running, and his clothes and shoes flew away. He put on a show, covering his eyes and running across the road, dragging passers-by, mouthing "There's going to be an earthquake, run quickly." He almost burst out with the sound in his throat. He even heard the slight vibration of his whimpering vocal cords. He was breathing heavily, and people looked at him in panic, with horror in their eyes about the content. They really believed that there was going to be an earthquake. No one was slandered because of his force. This was on the street, and the performance was just a trick. As long as here, falsehood and truth can be confused, because no one cares whether what you say is true or not, we can all survive.
Suddenly enlightened. He couldn't stop. It no longer mattered whether he could speak or not. He found a new way to deal with the "inability to speak" wound - becoming a new character.
"You never said you couldn't talk."
He stared blankly into the eyes across from him.
"If you don't speak, you should write clearly. We have a play about disabled people. I can take you there."
The person opposite waved his hand in front of him, but he still stared blankly.
The other party held up his hand, but he ducked and picked up his crutch.
They came to a brighter rehearsal hall with a few chairs scattered around.
He sat down in the corner, and another girl turned to look at him.
"I won't speak anymore."
"Communist Script" is an innovative project. It is not only a script, but also an open platform that gathers everyone's imagination and creative talents. Its core lies in continuous creation, encouraging participants to continue writing the stories in their hearts and allowing them to explore and extend into unknown areas. The charm of this project is that whether it is a detailed epic or a simple short story, it can be accepted and appreciated. It does not set limits and does not stick to a fixed plot or ending, but allows every creator to freely use their imagination and creativity. This diversified creative approach gives every story endless possibilities. Another characteristic of the communist script was its communal nature. The joint participation of the creators makes the script like an organism, constantly growing and changing. Everyone is contributing to this common project, and everyone's creations become part of the overall work. This collaborative creation method makes the script full of vitality and change. In general, "Communist Script" is a place that stimulates creativity and brings together the wisdom of everyone. It encourages us to challenge traditional storytelling, break out of fixed thinking patterns, and allow our imagination and innovative spirit to flourish. By continuing to create, we can push our stories further and further into unknown territories, revealing the infinite possibilities and diversity of life.
Contributions welcome

Role introduction
Lin Xiang: She participated in various activities extensively and did not know where to devote her life. Lin Xiang has several male companions, but she sometimes forgets them. She wanted to love me, but it was difficult. Our breakup made her very hurt. In the high-pressure environment of the city, Lin Xiang wanted to do something for others.
Lin Xiang, what are you doing?
I want love or something more intense. I don't believe them. Why do they lie to me when they can't give it to me? They can't tell the truth from the lie but they still lie to me.
My OP: I don't want to go to class, I don't want to obey, I can't think clearly about everything, and my stubbornness is also very fragile. There are too many things in the world that puzzle me, but maybe I will understand them later.
what do you want
I want to rush. I want to hit forward. I want to hit my head and bleed. If the invisible barrier is dyed red with my blood, can everyone see it?
Shen Chen: I opened an independent bookstore MuKKi in Beijing with my friends. Shen Chen gets along well with both women and men.
Nulo: Photographer/Editor. He wants to live a good life and do some creations within his ability. But he always seemed to have something to say in his heart. In the past few years, work has been intermittent and precarious. He rarely cries.
Nulo are you sad?
...When I was a child, I lay on the grass and looked at the stars. They were so bright.

A small stereo stood alone on the ground singing.
Five people stood by the river, and the fireworks in the distance always caused the forest elephant to exclaim.
The prelude of a song sounded.
Shen Chen turned around and smiled at me.

Lin Xiang (suddenly shouting to the night sky): So happy!! You all have to remember me! Do you know? Ahhhhh!
My mouth reached to the base of my ears, which were red from the cold.
Me: We're not that good!
Lin Xiang shouted after me, the plush gloves hanging around her neck.
Lin Xiang: We are not that good!
Me: We're not that bad!
Lin Xiang: We are not that bad!
Nulo (suddenly shouted very loudly): Xiao Ming!!!
Me (smirking): Xiao Ming! You stand up! Stand up quickly!
Nulo just shouted in harmony with me.

Me: You are not dead!
Nulo: Xiao Ming!
Me: Xiao Ming!!
Nulo: Be strong!!!
Me: Ah Xiao Ming! You are the most beautiful! The best!! So I'm going to kill you!
Amid the happy shouts one after another, Shen Chen smiled slightly. He opened the can and took a sip.
Mei (laughing quietly): You are shameless and have no future.
Lin Xiang drank beer happily. May held the beer can and crossed her arms over her chest.
Lin Xiang: Happy New Year!
Me: Happy New Year!
Everyone shouted together: Happy New Year! Happy New Year! Happy New Year!
Just kept shouting.

Sun Jiarui, who played Xu Jinjiang in "Human Surrender", is a talented young male director. Even if your time is limited and you are unable to participate in the creation of this film, it is recommended that you add his WeChat account and don't forget to give him a few more likes when you peek into his private life. February 2nd Recruiting male lead for one-man show "Octagonal Counter"
A dull person is drowned in dreams.
To stumble upon "suffering", you need to find excuses for yourself, and to inflict suffering on others, you also need to find excuses. It is used to nail oneself to a flat canvas. The more people gather, the more people pull the canvas flat. Only then can "we" exist.
The complete hysteria will be completed in dreams. You who exist because of being observed become you between the "birth body" and the "ultimate". You will find a new excuse for your own legitimacy, the lie called the will of the universe.
Only by looking for the causes along the results can we break the cycle.
"He slept for four hours in three days.
He has a strong obsession and a morbid attachment to memories. In order to protect his obsession, he would inject himself with memories containing dopamine from time to time. Then he would lean on the head of the bed and look at the hallucination on the white wall opposite, groaning, laughing, and shaking. The nourishment of obsession made his arms full of needles. Even though the stench of decay was exuding, he just stared straight at the white wall and turned off his sense of smell.
He was willing to indulge in some kind of "reality" and tried his best to capture every sound he heard. To this end, he punched holes in his eardrums and tried to let the language flow in directly. The holes became larger and larger, but the volume became smaller and smaller. The language flowing in was transformed by himself into an auditory hallucination, wandering in the ditch, devouring every new word that came in, and his brain began to become cancerous. What's ridiculous is that his own words are getting further and further away from the truth, and the bubbles popping out of his mouth burst before they reach the point.
He wants to keep moving. He thinks he is always moving, breaking his own black and white space, and traveling through gray passages. But every time he travels, he is only marking the gray passages with black and white. The action he thinks is just watching himself turn those grays into black and white. Faced with his own urine stains on the passage, he tells himself that you have been here. It has both smell and shape. "
He is used to creating his own predicaments and playing a narcissistic game that never ends.
I am also used to treating failure as a nipple to suck on, and then dressing myself up like a baby.

sources.text:
P4 Theater and You
2023-12-30
Project and brand narrative
Self-Material Project | "Tangshan Boy - History of Family Suffering" 02
It's very difficult to recall, but I feel a small sense of satisfaction in wanting to do so now.
It's very difficult to recall, but I feel a small sense of satisfaction in wanting to do so now.
I am extremely thin. I am now 1.79 meters tall and weigh less than 110 pounds. I had a similar body shape when I was a kid, and I was never fat. I've been fighting since I was a kid, and although I won a lot of times, I got beaten much more often. The powerlessness I felt when I was beaten made me very unwilling and angry.
My parents are both from rural areas, Luannan, Tangshan. My father failed the college entrance examination for the second time. When there was a recruitment examination for state-owned enterprises, my father passed it and came to the location of the factory, which is the Nanpu Development Zone to work and settle down. My mother followed him after marrying him. My father's employer is Tangshan Sanyou Group, which is very large. I have lived in the family building of Sanyou Alkali Plant since I was a child.
When I was in elementary school, my uncle suddenly returned to Nanpu Development Zone from Dongguan to join my mother, taking the wife he met in Dongguan with him. I don't know where to start talking about him. The trivial matters of the family are always complicated and confusing.
My grandma has three children. The first is my aunt from her ex-husband, the second is my mother, and the third is my uncle. In my mother's words, her bastard brother has not studied hard since he was a child and does not make people worry. My mother's parents did not support my mother's education, but fully supported my uncle.
I never listened carefully to what my mother told me about family matters. What she probably meant was that my uncle only cared about the family and asking for money for fun, and never cared about his studies. His junior high school and high school were unwilling to accept him, and his family gave the school a lot of money so that he could barely stay in school. He kept making his family spend money. He made his family spend a lot of money. Afterwards, he was admitted to university, majoring in computer science, and became the pride of the villagers.
After graduation, he was humiliated by his fellow villagers, with some saying he was incapable of success. After returning home, he punched the wall and vowed to make a career. He went to Dongguan without hesitation to embrace the circle drawn by Deng Xiaoping.
This description must be even more untrue, the paraphrase is untrue, and my impression of what my mother told me is particularly distorted.
My mother also said that he was cheated in Dongguan and had his arm broken.
My grandma's ex-husband was strong and handsome, but he later went to jail for robbery. My grandma took my aunt and had to marry a loser in the village and gave birth to my mother and my uncle. After my uncle came back from Dongguan, he and my grandfather, father and son, seemed to hate each other very much, and they were always fighting each other every time they met. Maybe my uncle simply looked down on his father and suffered from having such a father. Of course, this is nonsense, and such simple and subjective speculation cannot be believed.
When I write about family, it takes a lot of words to explain things clearly, it has to be long paragraphs, and it contains very little information, which really bores me. Because of my mother, I have no patience to sort out family relationships. Let me write patiently and try to record as many memories as I can.
As soon as my uncle returned to the north, he borrowed 20,000 to 30,000 yuan from my mother and started courier work. He has not paid back the money to this day. He also bought some computer accessories and repaired computers at the express delivery point.
After he came back, my mother was very interested in cursing his wife with me. She said that this southern bitch was very showy at first sight. She didn't work or do housework, and would only spend my uncle's money on a bunch of snacks and cosmetics. In her opinion, my uncle had fallen on his wife. If he married a wife who was a housekeeper, it would definitely not be like this. My mother often helps my uncle at his express delivery point. When my uncle is irritable at work, he will take out his grievances on my mother. Later, after the word "Fu Di Mo" appeared on the Internet, the first thing I thought of was my mother.
It's really similar to many TV dramas and web articles. My mother likes to watch TV series.
My uncle brought me a lot of new things. When I was in fifth or sixth grade, he gave me a ride on his motorcycle. A big scooter, Haojue's. The power of the automatic motorcycle was really outrageous. I twisted the accelerator a little, and the car jumped out like a dog. Later, I hit the wall and flattened the bumper. My uncle never let me touch that car again. He told me that when he was riding in Dongguan, he often exceeded his speed, that is, he rode faster than the speed shown on the dial. I also rode the electric three-wheel he used to deliver express delivery, and I thought it was very easy to ride. Later I enjoyed riding all kinds of bikes.
When he was repairing computers, he often told me about computer parts, and I gradually understood how a computer should be installed. One time, my mother picked up a broken case from outside and gave it to me to play with. I patched up the parts, installed the system, connected the monitor of my computer to it, and it turned on. I asked my uncle for a keyboard, mouse, and monitor. At that time, I had two computers at home.
I played Vice City on my uncle's computer, and it was probably the first good game I ever played. Later I found several pornographic films on his computer, all of which were about women and dogs. I still don't know how he found it. There is also a folder with a lot of photos in it, showing the process of a woman getting dressed, taking off her clothes, and then getting dressed again. She wore sexy lingerie and a very erotic mask.
I have no recollection of my attitude towards my uncle at that time. He still has no children today, maybe he likes me. And I was having a great time playing at my uncle's place while listening to my mother scolding my uncle and his wife. My likes and dislikes about him have been completely blurred in my memory. What is more clear in my memory is his car, computer, and the games and pornographic movies on the computer.
At that time, my parents started to set up a stall on the pedestrian street to sell some of his USB flash drives, mice and other things. That probably piqued my dad's interest. He started to buy a lot of socks, and they were all piled up on my balcony. He is no longer content with the fate of an ordinary state-owned enterprise worker. He wants to reverse the mediocre reality by setting up a stall and selling socks. Later, these socks were accumulated in my home for many years. When I was in high school, those socks gradually disappeared from my home. I should be the biggest beneficiary of my parents' stall, because they are out for a long time and I don't have to study at home and can play games for a long time.
My aunt is ordinary-looking, but she has fair skin, nice skin, and big breasts.
One day, my grandma broke her body while working in the fields. My mother took her to my home for treatment. When I followed my mother to the hospital, my grandma's body was covered in blood, and the smell of old people and blood mixed into a very pungent and unpleasant smell.
According to my mother, my grandma was very mean to her. She never gave my mother the warmth of a mother, and she never beat or scolded me. She never supported my mother going to school. My mother finished technical secondary school. She said that this was the result of her efforts to fight against her parents. My mother said that her grades were more outstanding than mine when she was in school. She probably wasn't lying, because from her description of her student days, she was probably the kind of top student in the class who abided by rules and regulations, and was a bit annoyingly righteous. Despite this, she said, she was still disrespected by her classmates and teachers because her parents were not well-liked by the villagers.
My mother majored in agricultural machinery in technical secondary school. After graduation, she worked as a miscellaneous worker in the grain bureau and was later laid off. In her words, her mother is the same as the rural woman in many people's impressions. My grandma believed that my mother should not work. She once went to the Grain Bureau and other workplaces where my mother found a job after she was laid off, and made a big fuss, which made it impossible for my mother to go to work. In addition, she often threatened my mother by hanging herself to force her not to go to work.
When talking about this, my mother will perfectly become the victim, with tears in her eyes.
This is why I later thought my mother was hopelessly stupid. Because after my grandma broke down, she served my grandma for fifteen years. It was not until the end of last year that my grandma finally died and went to the place she should have gone to fifteen years ago.
After the information age, the information everyone receives has increased exponentially, and everyone understands countless truths, including me. However, many concepts are only given to us by external systems, and we do not know that they represent or represent the interests of those groups. Therefore, these concepts are just texts that exist in the human mind. But the saying that there is no dutiful son before a long-term illness is absolutely correct, so damn right. Caring for an elderly person who cannot take care of himself is too painful.
When I write about my family, my words are very different from the words I write about school experiences.
When I was very young, I went back to my hometown with my mother. My grandparents liked me and used to play with me. Some of them are still retained in my memory. As I get older, I feel pain and anger every time I think about my grandma playing with me.
Later, people who knew my mother in the development zone spoke highly of her and said she was a rare filial son. After my grandma broke down, she couldn't take care of herself. My mother fed her every day, helped her to poop and pee, moved her joints, wiped her body, and soaked her feet. My grandma often pooped and peed on the bed, and my mother would always change her sheets in time. Over the years, my grandma's condition has become more and more serious, and my mother has become more and more tired. After my grandma died, I went home some time ago and heard my mother chatting with an aunt of a similar age. That aunt also had elderly people at home. My mother happily shared with her her experience in dealing with feces and urine.
My grandma often babbles, regardless of time, sometimes very loudly. My mother would scold her whenever she screamed, but it never worked. She would suddenly yell when I was doing homework or sleeping, which affected me very much.
According to my mother, this originated from my grandma's obsession. She loves her ex-husband very much, and she loves my aunt she gave birth to with her ex-husband the most. She looked down on my grandfather and my mother, but she loved my uncle. After her ex-husband was imprisoned, my grandma missed him very much. Finally, many years after giving birth to my mother and my uncle, she got what she wanted. One stormy night with thunderous thunder, her ex-husband climbed into the yard of her house and put his hands and face against the window to look at my grandma.
One year, my mother finally couldn't stand my grandma's demands all day long and sent her back to my aunt's house in the village to take care of her. A few months later my mother took her back and she was covered in sores.
The floor plan of my family building is very poor, which really doesn't match the size of my dad's unit. My house has a small living room that is useless, a small kitchen, bathroom, balcony, and two large bedrooms. My grandma lived in one room, and my parents and I lived in one room. This left me with very little room to move around the house, because the room my grandma lived in always smelled bad.
When I was a kid, my mom stopped looking for a job and she raised me full time. Not two years after I took care of myself, my grandma broke it. Then my mother decided she had to work, so she started sweeping the streets and working as a cleaner. This makes me feel incredible, because my father's salary is not enough to support the family, and she is more educated than most people in the development area. Her job as a cleaner also made me feel embarrassed in front of my classmates, because most of my classmates are the children of Sanyou Group employees and they all live in the same community. She chose to be a cleaner because the working hours of a cleaner are one or two hours at four o'clock in the morning and one or two hours in the afternoon, and she gets a meager salary. This way she can spend most of her time taking care of my grandma. She also made buns at a breakfast shop, but that breakfast shop often kept my mother working until the morning, so she went back to work as a cleaner. When my uncle came back from Dongguan, my grandma was paralyzed. My mother had to take care of my grandma, sweep the streets, help my uncle with express delivery, and take care of me.
When I chat with my mother, I will say it bluntly, I respect you, I appreciate you, and I understand your behavior, but I think you are stupid.
When my mother didn't have time, she would ask me to turn my grandma over, but she didn't ask me to catch her urine. I would also turn my grandma over, but it was always disgusting.
My grandma's years of dragging her down have made my mother very tired, and I feel very sorry for my mother. At the end of last year, I received a call from my mother at night. She said that my grandma had passed away and asked me to go home. I was ecstatic and happily got on the train home the next morning. I was in a very bad state at that time, but my grandma's death made me in a much better state.
After the funeral, my mother and my aunt had an argument. My mother clapped her hands, stamped her feet, and shouted hysterically.
When I was very young, my mother pushed me very hard to study, so that I could study well. When I was young, my classmates were all playing outside, and I spent most of my time doing homework. Later, I learned very easily on my own and my grades were always very good, so she stopped caring about my studies. I don't thank her for forcing me to study, nor do I hate her for it.
Now my grandpa is taking care of himself at home. In my memory, except for crying at my grandma's funeral, my uncle never visited his parents. So does my aunt. They seem to be breaking the law.
When I was a child, I had a dog, a black and white puppy. The female was supposed to be a butterfly dog. When my parents and I went to the market, I liked this puppy very much, so I bought it for five yuan. He was very fat when he was first bought back and was named Pangpang. However, he became very thin when he grew up. In front of the administrative building of Sanyou Group is a beautiful square and an artificial lake. After Pangpang grew up, I took him for a walk in the square every day. Sometimes I would wade in the shallow water of the artificial lake, with Pangpang swimming beside me. I hold it in my arms and kiss it all the time at home, and the elders who come to visit me will think it is unhygienic for me to kiss it.
When Pangpang was one year old, she gave birth to a litter of puppies, which were even fatter than when she was a child. I play often. One day I was playing with the puppies, and Pangpang was in another room. I accidentally dropped the puppy, and it started barking. Pangpang immediately ran over to check and saw the puppy on the ground and me next to the nest. It didn't do anything. It has been emotionally unstable at times since then.
That litter of puppies was given to my grandfather, but he didn't even have to feed them and died.
Pangpang was sent away when he was more than a year old. My aunt and uncle were married for the second time, and my aunt brought a daughter with her when she married him. When Pangpang was more than a year old, before my grandma fell down, my aunt became pregnant, and she wanted to give my uncle another child herself. She must have been nearly fifty at that time. In order to avoid Planned Parenthood, she wanted to take refuge in my home. It is said that dogs are not good for pregnant women, so the adults decided to send Pangpang to my hometown village to be raised by my grandmother until my aunt gave birth to a baby before sending him back.
My dad basically doesn't have the majesty of a traditional Chinese father figure. When he talks to me, he basically recommends books to me, or talks about light topics like history. But when he talks about important things, such as family, or what is on his mind, he will immediately shut up and never say a word. To this day, he has never had a heart-to-heart talk with me, not a single word. But after my aunt came to live with me, she would deliberately show discipline to me. It seems that his brother is very important to him.
My cousin, my aunt's daughter, also lived with my aunt at my house for a long time.
After my aunt gave birth to the baby, the dog was not returned. My parents told me that the dog ran away in the village. I called my grandma and she said that the dog ran away. I didn't believe it because Pangpang was very smart and the fence of my grandma's house was also very high. So I asked irritably for details. At this time, I heard my uncle on the other end of the phone scolding my grandma. He said that my grandma couldn't even coax a child. I started cursing as I realized they might have been lying to me from the beginning. I don't remember how the call ended.
Later, I talked to my uncle on the phone and I scolded him again. He didn't take me seriously. He even lied to me very casually and refused to do it seriously. My cousin once had dinner at my house. When this matter was brought up at the dinner table, I yelled at my cousin. My dad was very unhappy and immediately and sternly asked me to admit my mistake. I shouted to my dad that I was not wrong and started crying. In my memory, I once heard someone say that my aunt thought I was very ignorant.
I was very emotionally unstable at that time and cried at every turn. Once I wanted to go out to find a dog, but I walked all the way to another factory in the development zone. It was very far and it took a long time before I came back. The whole family was going crazy.
I was still very young at that time, and I basically have no memories of my childhood. I only remember these things clearly. Hatred is really a good thing. It will not dissipate over time, but will grow infinitely in consciousness. To this day, the hatred for this matter has turned into a huge star that will not collapse, burning in my heart.
My father seems to have grown up on this matter and he never talked to me about it. I think my father loves me, and I love my father. I wonder if he loves his brother more. I don't hate my father for this, but when I think about what my father did, I feel sad and helpless.
Now my grandma and grandpa are dead, and my uncle has completely broken up with my father and uncle. It seems that my uncle doesn't love his brothers very much. I probably won't see him again.
The Self-Material Project is an exploration into the inner self, which includes cherishing and organizing personal memories, dreams and various life fragments. We hope that through this plan, we can build a shared collective subconscious with you, so that we can roam together in the infinite sea. This program encourages us to look back on our experiences and piece together fragmented memories and dreams into a meaningful story in order to better understand ourselves, our past and our future. By sharing and communicating these precious moments, we can create deeper connections and explore together the complexity and beauty of human life.
