P4 Theater and You
2023-12-28
Controversies and Declarations
Self-Material Project | "History of Youth Violence in Tangshan" 01
I am Shi Jiating, a foolish person. I am now on the edge of life and death, which makes me realize that I must do something.
I am Shi Jiating, a foolish person. I was now on the edge between life and death, and it made me realize that I had to do something. Because so far I don't want to lose my life.
I decided to talk to this simple coding system composed of binary and type the words into the computer. But my swollen brain doesn't allow me to write down any witty words, so I plan to keep a running account and write down whatever comes to mind.
I am twenty-four years old and have no job. I've been so anxious about my age that I often think I'm twenty-five now. I was born into a working-class family, and the biggest feeling I had when I was young was poverty. This does not come from the financial constraints of my family, but from my mother.
My mother, the person I most want to destroy but love, the person I most want to protect but want to destroy. For as long as I can remember, my mother has drilled into me how unlucky my family was. In her words, all my relatives except her are evil people, and they are always thinking about infringing on my family's interests, not just money. She said my father didn't love her and was selfish and unreasonable. She told me that ordinary people like us have difficulty making money and spending it, so money is very important and we must save every penny we have. In her eyes, life is like a boat on a vast ocean with surging undercurrents. She must spend all her life to keep herself afloat on the water and not die.
As I write this, I don't want to write a rant against my parents. I just write whatever comes to my mind.
My mother had a profound influence on me. Now I have become a person who works hard to survive, but I have also lost the right to have a carefree childhood. If my mother didn't love me so much, I don't know if I would still be alive now.
When I was young, I always felt that the children around me were noisy and brain-dead. No matter what happened, they would just make a fuss and enjoy doing some very stupid things. They would do whatever adults said and had no logical ability. This annoys me so much. I've been tired of being around children since I had the memory. In kindergarten, all I wanted to do was escape. Besides, seriously, I felt at that time that the kindergarten teachers didn't take their jobs seriously at all, they just wanted to get the job done and then send us kids home.
Later, I often became an innocent and innocent image in other people's impressions, but it was just that I was tired of others since I had memories, and of course I could not blend into the "group" complacently.
The seeds of my later hopeless self-love may have already been planted in my heart.
Parents often quarrel. As for the reason for their quarrel, the only thing I have vague memories about is the issue of relatives on my father's side, and I can't remember the details. When I think back on my feelings about this, I don't have a very reasonable-sounding feeling of "helplessness" in my memory. I probably felt irritable, sad, confused, etc. at that time. Maybe I chose not to face my parents' arguments at all so that I wouldn't feel isolated and helpless, but instead a false sense of ease took over. So much so that now I can hardly recall the content of my parents' quarrels, I only remember the high decibels.
I can't recall many things, but I can also recall many things.
I remember that in kindergarten, I was good at drawing, and the teacher would give me other children's drawings to add embellishments to show to parents. But I drew something that the teacher didn't want, which made them dissatisfied.
In my mother's memories, I was very bad when I was a child. I would attack other children simply because I was dissatisfied and disgusted with them.
I often torture living things, all kinds of bugs, chickens bought from the market, I like to torture them to death.
I used to hate and feel helpless about my excessive self-awareness, but now I slowly accept it.
When I was a child, I felt that many teachers and classmates did not like me and looked down upon me. It was not until I was older that I understood that wealth and poverty are so important. It is easy to tell which children are poorer and which are richer. The same goes for adults. When I was a child, I had ill-fitting clothes, wasn't hygienic enough, and didn't have enough "teaching". Coupled with my natural aloofness, of course I became the unpopular one among the children. However, in fact, I subconsciously knew that I was looked down upon for being poor, so I just chose to avoid the problem completely, and even deceived myself, making myself feel that I didn't know.
The words "naturally unsociable" are too classic.
But another complicated aspect is that my family is not extremely poor. And my mother never taught me how to be decent, how to hide my poverty, or even told me that I didn't need to maintain my image. She also said that she didn't need to care whether she was poor in the eyes of others. This may be an excellent concept, but it is also a tall order. I am not stronger than others, but weaker than others. I never accepted her words, but only felt inferior because of my image.
My high school is the focus. It arranges free speeches in turns every day to train students. I stood on the podium and talked a lot about my parents. I told them that they were very good people, but they were just unlucky. At that time, I took on the role of my parents on stage, and it was a reluctant and resentful version, like a down-and-out poor man bragging about his past glory with others. After my speech, my classmates hated me even more. What's more, in key high schools, most of the classmates are the children of businessmen, senior officials, and intellectuals.
Why don't the classmates who spurn me feel sorry for me and come to help me? I don't want to have such thoughts, but I still do sometimes.
Then one day I suddenly faced my inferiority complex caused by poverty, and finally changed from a pitiful and hateful person to a pitiful person. I don't know why, maybe it's just age.
Being overly sensitive and fragile, overthinking is very harmful and can cause people to fall into a vicious cycle, in which the brain consumes a lot of energy and becomes unable to act, and the inability to act leads to spending time on daydreams and meaningless rumination. This is actually normal, but I try to at least write down some memories, maybe it can improve me. I am very narcissistic and I care too much about myself, which is disgusting and disgusting to myself. But because of this, I don't want to wait to die.
My primary school teacher happened to be in menopause. She used to hit me with her fists, grab me and tear me hard, grab my head and lift me up, crush my pencil case, etc. I recall many of these things without much pain as they should be, and it seems that there was something wrong with my memory a long time ago.
What made a big difference to me about my primary school teacher was that she wrote in my graduation evaluation handbook that Shi Jiating worked very hard on duty one day, as if he felt that only by working hard can he be recognized by others. I told him that he should lower his head to pull the car but also raise his head to look at the road. I couldn't remember such a thing when I saw it, but I was very moved. But when I grew up, I actually saw the exact same words in my mother's diary: "I told Shi Jiating, you have to lower your head to pull the cart, but also raise your head to look at the road." Of course I don't remember how it happened. After I saw it, I couldn't help laughing. I felt it was extremely absurd.
As I write this, I am recalling group portraits from elementary school. Many of my classmates became a group image that floated in my mind.
A is my good friend. After I stopped contacting him, I missed him terribly. When I grew up and my thoughts became very complicated, I began to look down on him because of his stupidity, so I stopped contacting him. But I have feelings for him and it makes me very sad.
When I was very young, my impression of primary school was that it was a jungle society. In my childhood memories, the innocence and cuteness in the impression of children and adults are incompatible. Maybe this has something to do with the location of my home. My home is in Nanbao Development Zone, Tangshan, Hebei Province. This place was originally a rural area. As state-owned enterprises developed here, many buildings were built and turned into a development zone. It no longer looks like a rural area, but it is not enough to be called a county town. Maybe the problem of unruly people in remote areas is also reflected in the children in my hometown. In my elementary school, everyone was a ferocious beast, trying to steal respect, attention, and likes through certain behaviors. I was the fool or the weakling in the class, like the thinnest and weakest beast struggling to survive.
A's family is not poor, he is tall and handsome, and he was quite popular when he was very young. He is stupid and far less scheming than the other kids, so he is not in the top class of the school. He likes to hang out with a lot of the weaklings in school and treats them like little brothers, like me. But I was actually an outlier in school, far smarter than him and his other younger brothers, so I was bored a lot of the time. But being tall, he also saved me from being beaten by many of my classmates.
He also beats me sometimes. There was a time when the card game was very popular in schools. There are five cards in a 50-cent pack. One person puts his card on the ground, and the other person shoots it with his own card. If he shoots it over, he wins the card. It's a bit of a gamble. Most little boys enjoy collecting cards. A once asked me to buy a pack of cards after school every day, and then I had to lose them all to him, and then we would go back to our respective homes. Otherwise he will be unhappy.
@ is another younger brother of A. I dislike him very much because he is very stupid. This must not be because I am jealous and want A to only play with me. This is simply because I hate his stupidity. I beat him often, and it was difficult to get rid of him for a while, which annoyed me even more. His other little brothers, whose names I can't remember, I often beat them out of disgust.
I don't have much pocket money, so A spends money on snacks and other things outside, so he spends them generously on me. He also enjoys beating me at computer games. That was still the ancient Internet age. We have played together such as Chivalry Road, Wild Vegetable Tribe, Purcell, QQ Speed, etc. The time spent playing QQ Speed is very long. Later, after I went to college, Tencent released the mobile game Qfeiq Speed. I was very sad and even posted on WeChat Moments saying that I missed the friends I no longer had contact with. He can recharge money in games, but I can't. He also spends more time playing games than me who is forced to study by my mother every day. Therefore, he is much better than me in games, which makes him very happy. I have his account password. I once stole his Chiayidao account, sold all his belongings cheaply, and transferred all the money to myself. After he found out, he questioned me, but I refused to admit it. He didn't believe it and thought I was the one who did it.
I had several serious fights with A. The most serious incident that I remember was in junior high school. His attitude towards me became extremely irritable and indifferent for a period of time, which made me very unhappy. One night I got into a fight with him. Because I was very angry, I kept suppressing him and beating him. He talked to me because he couldn't beat me a little bit. As I grew up, I gradually became good at talking and making girls happy. He said this was the same trait as the top class people who often fight in groups in junior high schools. He was afraid that I would mix with them, so his attitude towards me changed. Now I know clearly that there is absolutely no logic in who I hang out with, nor is it because he found out that I am better than him. He just found out that I have very different characteristics from him, so he is afraid of losing me as a friend. A is very fragile.
The worst time I was beaten by my mother was in the second grade of junior high school. A was beaten and he called my landline directly. He cried and told me who had beaten him. When he was a child, he often bullied others, but because A was not smart, as he got older, he became a target of people who formed gangs and fought in groups. That time he was beaten severely. After hearing this, I became furious and immediately wanted to go out and fight. But A called my home landline, and my mother heard the call. She hit me and broke the mop rod, finally successfully stopping me from going out to fight.
Playing with me caused A some pain. I had excellent grades when I was a child, and A was a standard poor student. Adults all think that I am much better than A because of my academic performance, which brings him comparison. A is the standard child who is described as being suppressed by the public account Douyin today. He is kind, simple, stupid, and is denied and spurned by all adults. It is very painful. In the third grade of junior high school, he had trouble. The history teacher praised him for his progress. He was very, very happy. When he was writing history homework in English class, the teacher tore up his paper. He pointed at the English teacher's nose and scolded him. The whole floor heard it, and asked his parents to mediate for a long time.
My first painting teacher was not very bright. I enrolled in an extracurricular class to learn painting but made no progress, so A took me to the studio where he took classes. The teacher taught very well in a place like my hometown. I have never copied pictures, but have sketched a lot of still lifes, which puts me at a higher level than most so-called art students today. But A's painting was very poor, which was also the topic in the art teacher's mouth. One day there were not many people in the art class. As get out of class was about to end, the teacher gathered a few students together to expound on his principles of life. He said that A's mother burst into tears while talking on the phone with the teacher in the junior high school. After saying this, A immediately stood up to leave, but the art teacher grabbed his arm. A almost broke free, but was finally restrained by the teacher. He cried when he realized he couldn't break free. Finally, after being taught a serious lesson by the art teacher, I went home with him.
He runs like an ostrich, so I always call him ostrich.
I spent my time in Nanbao Development Zone before junior high school, and then went to Tangshan City for high school. A very big feeling that ran through me before junior high school was that many of my friends who were poor students were from the top class in the school and were very popular. But without exception, they were tortured very painfully by the adults' denial. Speaking of which, I am also a victim of adults. When I was a child, I was satisfied with my academic performance because I was a little smart.
B is what I call the top class. He is very strong and knows things better than other children. Among a group of young children, he already knows how to express himself. He liked Bruce Lee very much, and after Michael Jackson died, he liked Michael Jackson again. He thinks they're cool, and he thinks liking them makes him cool. There is always no shortage of little girls around him. He had a good relationship with A. Later, when he was in junior high school, he was already one of the gangster leaders, and he protected A from being beaten several times. Of course, he's just a gangster in school, not a gangster in the literal sense.
I remember playing with him when I was very young, and later he often bullied me. In the memory that I can barely recall, he didn't know that he was better than others at first, but then he gradually realized this and started to run rampant. One time he fought for the table tennis table I was using, but I refused to give it to him and started a fight with him. Finally, he put his foot on my head and pushed me to the ground, asking me to call him daddy. I didn't scream. After he was tired of stepping on me, I got up and continued to beat him, but I was stepped on the ground again. After a few repetitions he got tired and left.
Once he grabbed my water gun to play with, broke it and threw it to me. I slammed the water gun against the wall next to his head. At that time, I was standing in my seat, and he was sitting in his seat, far away. He slowly stood up and pointed at the ground, calling me over. I immediately wanted to go over and start a fight, but within a few steps I was hugged and stopped by almost all the boys in the class. One of my shoes was even dropped when they stopped me. This scene made everyone in the class laugh so hard.
There were probably more than 300 people in my junior high school, and by the time I reached the third year of junior high, there were only a little over 200 people left. More than a hundred students went to technical schools or no longer attended school. A classmate who had a good relationship with B beat someone to death, so his mother took him and fled to Qinhuangdao. B did not drop out of school and took the high school entrance examination.
C is a third-generation rich man whose family owns a trading mall. He often spent five or ten yuan to treat his classmates to snacks. From time to time, he takes his classmates to play in his villa. Tibetan mastiffs were still very popular at that time. He had three of them at home, and their long hair blocked his eyes. He played well with B, and I often fought with him when I was young. Once I smashed C's forehead with a rock and it bled a lot. When I called the parents of both parties, C's mother was very reasonable, which moved me very much.
At that time, there was a student named D who was bullied by everyone in the class. C was very happy to beat him and bully him. Once in class, C insulted D in class. D sobbed and cried a lot. After class, I wrote the words "I am domineering" on a piece of homework paper and posted it in front of C's desk. After C saw it, he took it off and ran to the podium to hold it up. He asked loudly who wrote it. I said it was me. He punched me hard several times, but I didn't say anything or fight back.
I use words like good and evil less and less now. The so-called goodness is the imaginary result of human beings evolving into complex animals and possessing the ability to imagine.
D is the weakling in the class. When I was a child, there were a few idiots in school who spoke slowly, had cowardly eyes, always had dust on their clothes, and had black stains on their necks that could never be washed away. But D is not a fool with intellectual problems, and his conversations with others are smooth. He is no more cowardly and stupid than the other weaklings in the class. The Samoyeds will keep a group of Samoyed dogs to protect the reindeer. Sometimes one dog in the group will suddenly be isolated by other dogs for no apparent reason and eventually be killed. D successfully transformed into this role. Because his test scores were always the last in the class, my primary school teacher would always tease him in class. It would be much better if he was the silent shadow in the class. However, he was as cheerful and naughty as every child of his age and communicated with others normally, so he naturally withstood the attacks from all his classmates. I was also one of the people who beat him up, and it was under the applause of my classmates.
My class teacher is a Chinese teacher. When I was in the fourth grade of elementary school, I often asked questions about text comprehension in class. No one in the class raised their hands, but I raised my hand to answer. So she often praised me. Looking back now, it seems that the students were fed up with her unstable temper and did not want to deal with her in class. I may have become the teacher-pleasing sycophant in class without even realizing it.
But this shocked me. Why was I often beaten severely by her, but I felt that answering questions in her class was a normal thing, so why did I do it disapprovingly?
In my memory, I rarely recall warm and happy things, and it is also very difficult to recall painful things, only sporadic fragments. Also, I often have difficulty determining whether my memories are authentic. I don't blame this on the pain I experienced, but subconsciously selectively forgetting things in order to protect myself. My memory must have been distorted and deformed over time, like a broken tree that kept growing and became violently deformed, turning into some kind of subjective fantasy.
According to the blue-pink theory, E is a standard pink girl who likes Barbie dolls and does small crafts. When she was in fourth grade, she liked me because I often answered questions in class and asked other girls to confess to me. I only regarded her as my friend, but after hearing that she liked me, I readily accepted it and fell in love with her. I went to her house to play. She was very cheerful, and later I wrote some sketches and performed them with her during class activities, and the effect was very good. I didn't have any strange feelings towards the opposite sex at the time, but after falling in love, I often fantasized about E eating me. I was more naughty than other little boys, and after thinking E was my girlfriend, I often made excessive jokes with her, much more casually than I did with other people. So she broke up with me. It's not a sexual joke, I don't understand.
In junior high school, E hung out with students who were fighting in groups, and fell in love with many of them. Whenever someone asked E if he and I were in a relationship, E would become very angry and ban the topic. She later went to a technical school specialized in flight attendants.
As I write this, I really want to write more details, but my writing is too rough. But I found that I couldn't write it, and I had forgotten it.
Most ordinary people have very little to write about in their lives. It's interesting, and I am the same. In fact, I am writing this just to find something to do.
F is my friend. We have played together since kindergarten, and our parents also know each other. She often comes to my house to play. I spent a lot of time with her and could barely think of anything to write about. She told me an incident when I was in junior high school. In kindergarten, she asked me to borrow colored pens. The child next to me said to me, "Don't lend her, don't lend her." I raised my hand and slapped the child hard on the face, and lent the colored pencils to F. But when she told me about it, I had no memory of it.
She is very beautiful, very smart, outgoing and lively, sharp-tongued, and often criticizes people. She can sing, dance, and perform at major events such as Children's Day. Like many students, I copied her homework and taught her many questions. In the second grade of junior high school, maybe I told her a lot of questions, but one day she asked me to go to her house to play. I had gone to her house to talk to her before, and it left an impression on me because she was very enthusiastic that day. She listened to me songs by The Supremes, showed me a magazine she took out from her parents' room full of naked women, gave me a bucket of five-pointed stars, and gave me a necklace. I am very happy and touched. But she doesn't like me in a heterosexual way. She was having an affair with a boy who was very fair and had very light eyes, and she practiced Taekwondo with the boy. He has a straight nose and a square mouth, and looks like a little fresh meat. There were rumors at school that they slept with each other.
When I first started school in the third grade of junior high school, one day A and I were running and playing, and I was chasing him. I saw F walking with friends on the road. I ran so fast that I didn't have time to say hello to her. I saw that she also saw me. After that, I was very concerned about the fact that I didn't say hello to her. After that, when I saw her, I would turn away and not say hello to her. I never talked to her after that until I saw her during the college entrance examination and exchanged a few words with her.
I'm twenty-four years old, and I still haven't figured out why I never talked to her again because I didn't say hello once. I am still sometimes surprised by my behavior when I was fourteen. What psychological disorder caused me to behave in a way that caused harm to others?
I am indeed a bit withdrawn and tend to alienate everyone, but this strange behavior of mine is definitely not because of this. I also never act with the sole purpose of hurting others. I was very sickly as a child and spent the first few years of my life in the hospital. As a child I acted silly and my neighbor once asked my mother if I could go to school. It may be a strange situation for me to be able to live a normal life now. When I was late for class in elementary school, I had to stand at the door and shout "report", and I could only come in when the teacher said please come in. When I was in the first or second grade, I was late for class and rushed into the classroom. The teacher in that class was a kind lady. She asked me to go back to the door and shout "report" before coming in. I walked back to the door of the classroom and stood there, silent and motionless. No matter how many questions the teacher asked me, I made no move. This matter was dealt with for half the class, and finally I called my parents. But calling for a report can be tentatively understood as my subtle resistance to formalism when I was not very sensible, but I suddenly stopped paying attention to F. I couldn't find any logic in this matter. When I was a child, my language, movements, expressions, thoughts, and various behaviors were all called alien and were treated as a topic of conversation. Maybe I am a puppet that represents "abnormality", and the producer thought that I was not strange enough, so they added an event that represented abnormality to my behavior so that I could continue to exist as an abnormality.
I often torture myself by recalling things that make me painful.
One day in junior high school, I had a dream. I walked to the platform at the corner of the stairs in junior high school. A little girl came up from downstairs and asked me where the English teacher was or something. She kept repeating this sentence. As she was talking, I felt something was wrong. She was speechless and had no teeth. It turned out that I understood the content of what she said from the shape of her mouth. At this time, she also noticed that I had noticed something strange. She suddenly turned into a fat devil with a mouth full of fangs, round eyes, and drooling saliva. She grabbed my arm and shouted at me fiercely. At this time, the sound of many people's neat footsteps came from upstairs. I didn't dare to let the evil ghost leave my sight. I saw dirty purple feet with my peripheral vision. I was terrified and emotionally shattered. At this time, my desire to survive made me immediately decide to calm down first. I tried my best to regain my sanity. The moment I regained my senses, I woke up, my body still shaking slightly.
I also play with G and H. They both studied well. G is the son of the head teacher. One day he fell off a high platform and was injured. He said it was me who pushed him. I was scolded by the head teacher in the Chinese class. After school, the two of them often come downstairs to my house and ask me to come out and play. After I came out to play, the two of them would discuss a plan to get me away, and then they would run home and suddenly disappear in front of me. I couldn't find them anywhere and went home on my own. They played this way many times. Once when a water pipe was being repaired in a community, a big hole was dug in the cement floor, and it was filled with mud and water. G and H asked me to go down, so I went down. I went down and they left, and then I climbed out of the pit and went home, covered in mud.
I once drew an RPG game and passed it on to many people to play. He himself was the interactive system. Before 2010, it was really advanced to make something like this when you were less than ten years old. I lost contact with him later, but I guess he became a very creative two-dimensional person.
The Self-Material Project is an exploration into the inner self, which includes cherishing and organizing personal memories, dreams and various life fragments. We hope that through this plan, we can build a shared collective subconscious with you, so that we can roam together in the infinite sea. This program encourages us to look back on our experiences and piece together fragmented memories and dreams into a meaningful story in order to better understand ourselves, our past and our future. By sharing and communicating these precious moments, we can create deeper connections and explore together the complexity and beauty of human life.

Events and Performances
It's been a whole year since I lost the moon
(Broken Moon) will be officially performed on December 16th.
Recently, we participated in the production of a play in Beijing called "(Broken Moon)". We originally had a name that was more in line with the original intention, but for some reasons we changed it to the current one.
(Broken Moon) is a small play, and I didn't contribute much in it. I was also very uncertain about my position. I didn't want to be a writer, director, or producer, so I finally chose the title of executive producer.
A promotional material written for (Broken Moon)
I've been missing the moon for a whole year.
Xiao Hei often asks me: "Where are people? Where are others?" I said: "He doesn't want you anymore, idiot."
Another day, I suddenly felt that the sun was so warm and winter was not as cold as in previous years. It was as if the God of Drama was telling me: "Get up, it's time to rehearse."
I have always been afraid of the sun, and there is always a feeling that my secret is being scrutinized, which is more transparent than running naked, and more detailed than an anatomy. I am not afraid of it when I go out at night, and I naturally become invisible at night. No one can see me, so I walk briskly.
There is always a poem in my memory that is more metaphorical than Gu Cheng's black eyes, more poignant than Beidao's noble epitaph, and more desolate than the death of the Haizi gods. But I can never remember the poem. Maybe this is not a poem at all, but a sap that someone hit on the back of my head. It hurts to this day.
That all changed, and as I gave away the address of my secret base to others, the moon no longer appeared. The night is just night, the night is just night.
The night retreats when the sun comes. The night is relieved and thanks the sun. I saw a group of green babies forming a circle and flying towards me, constantly urging: "It's time to rehearse, it's time to rehearse."
"Bah!" I said, "Hurry up."
The bright and stable high-rise buildings and the fast-moving subways in the dark tunnels are all in the same Beijing. I have never doubted that I love this world.
"If someone concludes based on these phenomena that we actually have no emperor at all, then he is not too far from the truth. I have to say again: perhaps there is no one more loyal to the emperor than our people in the south, but loyalty does not bring benefits to the emperor. Although there is a sacred dragon curled on a small column at the entrance of the village, which has been spitting fire in the direction of the capital since ancient times to show its allegiance - but for the people in the village, the capital The city is stranger than the next life. Is there really a village with row upon row of houses, covering fields as far as the eye can see from our little hills, and crowded with people day and night? It is hard for us to imagine that the capital and the emperor are the same thing, just like a cloud that has been swimming quietly under the sun for thousands of years." Kafka said.
In fact, I have never lost the moon. He always hangs high, looking at me teasingly, silently, just like thousands of years ago.
But Xiao Hei didn't give up and asked me: "Where are you? Where are the others?" I said: "He doesn't want you anymore, idiot."
Comes with a poem written by the producer for (Broken Moon)

and the empty market it points to.

fall in love with it

Looking outside the house at the space and excitement
The ship is stationed in the depths of the carefully carved heart for stability and cowardice

All it brings is fresh pain and nail-biting cooking skills
What cannot be eaten is the cold yellow light and tranquility emitted by the spirit
Create a time and space with extreme black flushing and despicable backwardness.
It's not just the pages that overlap
Or is there still a crazy way to go higher?
(Broken Moon) will be officially performed on December 16th.
Friends who want to come to the show, please scan the QR code below and add the producer on WeChat to purchase tickets. I will most likely be there on the day of the performance, haha.

I made up my mind to make a new play a week ago. I regard it as a reboot of the Flavor Theater Company. It may take several months to create the script. I will gradually announce the news about this new play on this official account, hoping not to disappoint everyone. If any friends want to participate, please leave me a message in the background.

Broken Moon | Blood is Coming
The moon burned out, the ground was filled with romantic blood, a primitive fear dominated everyone, and the absurdity and shortness of life echoed. Makes...
The moon burned out, the ground was filled with romantic blood, a primitive fear dominated everyone, and the absurdity and shortness of life echoed. It makes you want to find someone and make up for all the irreparable shortcomings with a life-long romance.
Pursue everything to be still and free from the flow of heat. Every playful creature weighs heavily on my heart at this moment, and all I can do is hold you tight. The romance everywhere was my blood. I was so tired that I shrank to an invisible point and lay there. Everything was so far away from me.
I'm an addict who can't keep the boring stupid self-deceiving bullshit in my head, and I have deep, romantic, and irredeemable loneliness in my blood. In the face of daily excrement, there is no greatness or miracle. In the face of meaningless suffocation, I stopped my desire.
I have died, I will die, I love you with death, the sun has gone out, I squeeze out the last bit of strength in my body, to call the ancient wandering soul, hold up your broken body, and find the dream that has been lost long ago.
"But there is no need to be afraid, everything is not over. In the light of the sun, the moon slowly moves away, and the sun slowly shines towards the earth again, and the earth becomes warm again. A deep feeling captures everyone, and they survive the darkness."

and a god who screwed everything up

Being chosen for the role was quite unexpected at first.
Moreover, it is my first time to play the male lead in a stage play, which brings a lot of pressure and nervousness. It is also my first time to have physical contact with a woman. Shaking hands, hugging or even saying "I love you" to an actress are completely impossible for me to speak in a play because I have never been in love or have any experience in love and I don't know how to communicate with the characters in the play.
Whether I am acting according to a script or performing improvisationally, I will always be very nervous. In real life, I rarely communicate with others, so I can never release my nature in the play.
After many rehearsals and exchanges with the two actresses, I know how to perform physically. However, I am still not used to close contact with girls, even in performances. The first thing I should do in "acting" is to liberate my nature, and I am also working hard to liberate my nature.
Whether it is an extra performer that no one pays attention to or an inconspicuous supporting role, I will seriously give them "life" and "soul".
This time as a starring role, you should treat this "life" more seriously. The feeling of being selected cannot be described as "happy" or "excited". I still have to say thank you to the crew for choosing me.
We just rehearsed for the first show and made many attempts, such as adding some musical elements to the play, and having a bassist accompaniment the music to give the feeling of live actors performing. The atmosphere was very strong and it also helped the actors' performances. I felt very comfortable during the performance.
Our script was being rehearsed and revised. The person who rehearsed it for us at the beginning was Brother Fengning. He set me up as an objective observer, a god, holding a drum in his hand to accompany the other two actors. The rhythm of the drumming should also change, which is the externalization of the actor's psychological rhythm.
We will meet again later. As we continue to create, we all have new questions about the relationship between the three people and the creation of the script. We discuss it together, and finally brother He Fa integrates it with everyone and puts forward new ideas. My character setting has also completely changed, from a god to another participant in the relationship between an actor and an actress (the specifics will not be revealed yet, hehe).
After that, I started to improvise based on the character setting and the big frame of the script. I brought my heart into the character and plot, realized my own spiritual purification, and created this play. The staff who worked with me on the creation were also very satisfied with the creation of the three actors. I also look forward to making better things in the subsequent rehearsals. It is a very happy creative process. I love drama, and I am very happy to be one of the creators (o^^o)

"Broken Moon" Performance | Life drama? Open relationship? Me and you? Broken the illusion, or burned the damn moon?
Come to the theater on the 16th. Will the moon light up again? --Screenwriter Li Yaxin wants you to watch it
moon
Regarding what the moon is, the moon is one side of the sun, the only satellite of the earth, the reunion of the east, and the lunatic of the west. The moon is a belief that the world worships devoutly, but it is moving away from us at a distance of 3.8cm every year. In the human subconscious, the moon always carries a mysterious or holy light, which is just like people's confusion, joy, doubt, sadness, desire, possession, and release when facing love.
Talk about jealousy
Jealousy, in love, we first fall in love with the other person in our hearts, and then we find that what we love is the false thoughts in our hearts, and we oscillate between being divorced from reality and following our hearts. But where is the real other person?
She is a god! Worship, omniscient, controlling all these, these are her results, her imagination, she shuttles between illusion and reality.
They are mushrooms! They died, reborn, and spread spores unscrupulously. They pretended not to recognize their own memories and went to see the old people who were also reborn as new people.
That's the moon! Everything in the forest depends on her to exist, and the love produced under the moonlight always seems more pure and romantic.
broken moon
This time, the (Broken Moon) Theater Company dismantled the moon for the first time. Love stories such as "Luo Zhu", "Butterfly Lovers", "White Snake", "Sirano", etc. have always been considered to have noble and holy emotions. But love, in the end, is either a clichéd story of successful cultivation, or a typical tragedy of two people being separated but still loving each other. I'm afraid love is selfish possession, crazy deep kiss, inner tearing and healing, and cruel death. (Broken Moon), we crush love into pieces: Jealousy makes people realize that they are in love for the first time, and after love is broken, love naturally leads to hatred. The expansion and blending of the hearts of both parties finally brought about the soft communication under the outer shells of both parties.
Po Yue tells the story of facing one's own heart in love, externalizing one's emotions, and expressing these complex thoughts in wrong or right ways. Borrowing two mushrooms, they relied on the energy of the moon to drill out of the soil, their spores met, their mycelium entangled, and they embraced each other under the big tree. A cicada, she only felt that she was God in the eyes of the mushroom, so she tried to control the occurrence and ending of love, but she could not see the mycelium under the soil covered with animal feces...
(Broken Moon) Troupe: What do you think love is like?
In "Broken Moon", everyone has their own understanding and interpretation, the single-minded mushroom, the half-hearted mushroom and even the omniscient and omnipotent God.
After watching "Broken Moon" you can say that you don't understand this kind of love. This "Broken Moon" is so broken! You may also feel that there is a strong resonance, and you say, ah, this is the love I experience, this is the love I think.

P4 Theater and You
2023-11-29
Project and brand narrative
Self-Material Project | The dream that cannot be castrated
How long? --I think almost twenty years. How about twenty years? --I have been having sex with my father in my dreams. How often do you have dreams like...
How long?
I think almost twenty years.
How about twenty years?
I have been having sex with my father in my dreams.
How often do you have dreams like this?
Probably once a year, starting when I was about eleven years old. I am twenty-nine years old this year.
Are you ashamed in your dream?
Yes, sometimes it is shameful.
Was there anyone else in the dream?
Yes, sometimes my mother is around, but we still muddle along.
Are you forced or happy in your dream?
I think, in dreams, my genitals sink most of the time.
Why does such a dream occur?
I'm sorry, I don't know why.
Painful?
Yes, I was in pain and confused.
Who is my father? Is it the author of my childhood sexual trauma? Or the object of my sexual fantasies? Is it important to clarify reality? Yes, important. What are the facts? Sexual trauma or fantasy? Are memories facts? Can I tell the difference between dreams and reality? How should I deal with myself after waking up from a dream? In reality, how should I face my late father? How to deal with his daily deep and attentive care?
What kind of person is he?
Careful, sensitive, suspicious, with high emotional intelligence, in my cousin's words, very social, handsome, with many admirers, and of course the most important characteristic - he loves me.
When I was in high school, my father would drive me to and from school every day. Now when classmates get together, they still mention it, "Your dad is really good to you." How good is it? When my shoelaces came loose while walking on the road, he would take the initiative to squat down and tie my shoelaces. When I was tired, he would boil water for me to soak my feet when I got home, wash and rub my feet, and even massage my body, of course, with a layer of clothing.
It's a pity that in my memory, I don't have the beauty that others see. I only remember the bloody violence, accompanied by his unfathomable darkness and disgusting behavior. During the years when his political career was permanently suspended, he was always like a furious lion, proclaiming his territory over and over again and not letting anyone get close. He was also like a rat in the gutter, living under the dark roof beams, curling up his body and letting the wind and rain rage around him. That kind of suffocating so-called "love" is like binding you to the ground to accept the judgment and ravage of God. Of course, this God is undoubtedly played by him. Yes, he wants to take his daughter as his own. Every time he looks at the prisoner in his eyes, he reveals his love wrapped in selfish desires, which makes me sick.
When I was about 10 years old, one night, I fell asleep on the big bed in my parents' master bedroom. The adults were playing cards in the guest room while I slept. Suddenly, I was woken up by a pair of hands. His hands were playing with my labia. In a daze, he stood up and walked out of the door. I saw a familiar silhouette, his outline was outlined by the faint white light of the outer room. Yes, at that glance, I made a judgment while half asleep. Who is that? Is it him? Or my mother? Is he a guest here to play cards? No, that figure is extremely familiar.
I didn't dare to think about it any more, so when I was young, I decided to rationalize this memory. I didn't recognize who it was that day, whether it was my mother or my father or who it was. Or should I be bolder and let me complete this rationalization? Did that moment happen? That person only came to cover me with the quilt that day. He never put his hand into the quilt, let alone played with my private parts. So, with my efforts, half of this memory was erased by the eraser and scattered in pieces.
But this memory fragment is too real, how can I erase it so easily? I can even remember the moment I saw his silhouette.
"So what if you remember? This is just your sexual fantasy!!!" Such a voice often echoes in my mind. Is this really an illusion in my dream? Was it me who longed for sex with my father? If this is the case, I am happy and can accept it calmly, because it is me who is so perverted, not him.
But what if it turns out to be what I and all the viewers have guessed? If it was really him that night, how should I deal with it? How do I rationalize my relationship with him? How do I rationalize my father? How to survive???
That year, I had just finished the college entrance examination and was still underage. Under the influence of some kind of avant-garde art magazine, I began to advocate the freedom of underwear and became accustomed to "running naked". Of course, my breasts had already developed by then. It was the summer vacation when I just learned to drive. I was sitting in the driver's seat and about to fasten my seat belt. His hand reached over and slid up and down my back. He touched the back buckle of my bra. Later, I told my mother, and she laughed and said, "Your dad just likes to care whether you wear socks or a bra. It's not a big deal." Later, he tried to pat my back again. Every time we walked side by side, I followed the movement of his fingers with vigilance. He never dared to "check" my back button again. Is it because he didn't dare to do this when I grew up? Or for a man, actually putting his hand on any corner of a woman's upper back is enough to judge whether she is wearing a bra?
Later, I grew up and became something he couldn't control. Later, we also had some warm moments in ordinary people's homes. But most of the time, I would hesitate and feel nauseous when facing his caller ID. I couldn't overcome it and didn't know how to deal with it. Later, I got seriously ill, and we came to Beijing for treatment and lived in the same standard hotel room. Nothing happened between us, except for the dream I had year after year, the dream that subverted the ethical standards, reminding me year after year that I have pain and obstacles that I can never overcome in my life.
I went to the hospital the other day and the doctor told me that my vagina was full of viruses and it was running rampant. I want to ask the doctor to use scissors to cut off my vagina along the labia and reach my uterus. In this way, all sins will disappear, and at the moment when my body is mutilated, I will complete self-castration.
The Self-Material Project is an exploration into the inner self, which includes cherishing and organizing personal memories, dreams and various life fragments. We hope that through this plan, we can build a shared collective subconscious with you, so that we can roam together in the infinite sea. This program encourages us to look back on our experiences and piece together fragmented memories and dreams into a meaningful story in order to better understand ourselves, our past and our future. By sharing and communicating these precious moments, we can create deeper connections and explore together the complexity and beauty of human life.
