Recruitment and conversion
Some interviews during the epidemic
Zheng Zhongtian is studying for a master's degree in the history of science and technology. Do some musicals in the spare time, Sondheimian, station B...
Zheng Zhongtian
Currently studying for a master's degree in the history of science and technology. Do some musicals in the spare time, Sondheimian, station B @. Between the absurdity of drama and the absurdity of life, I tend to choose the former, but I often try to return to the latter from the perspective of a historian.
Interview transcript
Interview with Fa He
Interview time: April 18, 2023 15:37-17:17
Interview location: Wangjing, P4 Theater
Interview method: face-to-face interview
Interviewer: Zheng Zhongtian
Interviewee and introduction: Fa He, male, about 30 years old, independent theater creator and actor who lives in Beijing, manager of P4 Theater.
Others present: Liang Mingzhen (drama club friend)
Topic of this interview: The peak of the new coronavirus epidemic I have experienced
Q: First of all, we use November last year to January this year as the peak period of the new crown epidemic. Before that, we had experienced the epidemic for three years. Can you give some examples of how you/your friends/theater cast members have been affected in their working lives?
A: In the past few years of the epidemic, first of all, all large-scale performances and theatrical activities have been axed. In fact, all these official projects have been axed, including various commercial performances. So actually the biggest question is: What should practitioners do? They want to eat. My place (P4 Theater), in a sense, cannot be said to be amateur, it is just a more experimental place. So many actors who lost their jobs due to the epidemic came here. During the outbreak of the epidemic, many actors who had been able to find good jobs in the market and had good performance experience were free and had nothing to do. They found out that there were still some recruitments and some performances in P4 Theater, so they came to give it a try. Of course, a particularly important point is that ours is not an employment relationship, but a creation-oriented one. It is more of a theatrical idea to be activated in this way. So, (we) are still different from the commercial dramas on the market. As far as I know from many situations, there is no soil or room for drama in the overall environment. A large number of theater practitioners cannot actually make money, and they are also very anxious, but they still want to rehearse plays, no matter how loud they are, and then they come to me. There are quite a few such people.
Q: Are they still there now?
A: After the epidemic has recovered, some people have returned to commercial performances because they want to make money, and this is their special skill. After all, they have a basic salary. Most people have returned to this state. A small number of people may have felt something different in such a creative process, and they chose to start more creations on their own initiative. In a sense, this is like an incubation base. Many young people who are ambitious or impulsive and want to act, come here to try it out, and find that they can do it, and then they start acting on their own. We have many such actors here.
Q: In fact, during the three years of the epidemic, your own work was actually focused on P4 Theater, right?
A: First of all, I returned to China in 2019 (study abroad). The first job I looked for after returning to China was as a portfolio teacher. I worked at Galaxy SOHO. It took about half a year to stabilize this job. I used to devote myself to theater work on Saturday and Sunday nights. Later, when it became more and more stable, I just caught up with the epidemic and worked from home. At that time, I turned more time to the creation of P4 Theater. Later, I also changed my job from full-time to part-time, but the main source of my income is still the portfolio of study abroad works. Most of my money is still invested in the theater, which means that I spend all the money I earned from my part-time job in it.
Q: Do you have any close family members or friends who have been greatly affected by the epidemic in the past three years?
A: As far as physical health is concerned, I think everyone has survived, including my parents, relatives and friends around me. They are all doing well. I have a grandfather who is over 90 years old. He also got COVID-19, but he is still doing well.
Q: Is it during peak period?
A: Yes, it's okay if you get it during the peak period. The other elderly people actually died before the epidemic, so they were not greatly affected. Not myself, anyway, but I've heard too much about it. There are many friends, especially those whose grandfathers, grandmothers, grandfathers, and grandmothers have passed away, which is too much. This is what I heard. There are many funerals.
Q: During the three years of the epidemic, I had another concern, which was "Killing That Rose" that I mentioned to you just now. After that incident, it seemed like you had left the original theater venue. What I want to ask is, is it more related to the epidemic, or is it more related to this musical?
A: That's right. In fact, when we produced "Killing That Rose", it should have been June of 2021. At that time, the popular "Drama New Life" had not long been aired, so everyone was actually yearning for drama. At that time, the sponsor Liu Ziluo was also a very enthusiastic girl, and she was attracted by our recruitment. At that time, our recruitment was called the P4U plan, which meant that a bunch of people would work on a movie for a month. Of course, the P4U plan had some very detailed rules when it was released on our official account, such as: everyone must be strangers, everyone must be recorded, and everyone must be photographed (the entire generation process)... Anyway, it is very detailed.
We vacated the large theater at that time, and dedicated this month from May to June to the production of "Killing That Rose." At that time, many people were recruited, and hundreds of resumes were received. During the continuous screening process, or in other words, the screening process, I actually gradually had some differences with the opinions of the sponsor, because I felt that, in a sense, when the sponsor initiated this musical project, some problems began to appear in her direction. As a theater company, I will intervene intentionally or unintentionally. I emphasize more - for example, amateurs are very important. As a space called P4 Theater, we especially encourage non-professionals to come here to try and express themselves.
Q: It means that these things may not have changed much in November, even after the policy is issued, right?
A: It's actually quite strict. I remember that there were several QR codes downstairs to scan, and one day, two days, and three days (note: refers to the number of days before nucleic acid testing). The update frequency of Beijing's Health Treasure was getting faster and faster, so it was quite strict. I also need to look at the specific record. Later, many people were sealed off. One building after another in the community was sealed off, and no one could come. Let alone the party itself (whether it would be reported). (Check the WeChat group chat records.) On November 11, you see someone saying, "Who is coming today?" "I want to come, but I can't come, because the school is sunny." Later, more and more people who participated in the "Love Drama" project were unable to come. When the recruitment started in early November, there were quite a lot of people and it went smoothly. In the middle and late stages, there were fewer and fewer people.
Q: Is there a record of how many people were supposed to show up in the end and how many people actually showed up?
A: Because we are organizing such a theatrical event, the number of people is actually not fixed, and we do not have a strong binding, and we will not say "you have to come" or "you can't come if you don't come". Therefore, some people just say they can't come because of the epidemic - we don't know if it's an excuse or it's true - so if they can't come, then they can't come. It is true that after November, (prevention and control) repeated many times, many people stopped coming, about 20 people stopped coming. But in the end the workshop was held. It was an ongoing workshop, about 2 to 3 times a week. People will continue to come over - for example, if someone has lifted the lockdown, they can still come. Another interesting thing is that many people in Yanjiao have been banned. Some of our friends live in the Yanjiao area and cannot come to Beijing at all, which is quite painful. At that time, when we looked at the map, once we opened it, there were all the explosion points, red, one square after another. Some of them were charged at every turn, which was very strict. Including us here (note: referring to the current address of P4 Theater), the security guards would often come up during that time and say that you are not allowed to have more than a few people here, which is very strange. In my opinion, this must be no problem! But it seems that because of the policy, they are very stuck. And there are some people who specifically come to report - which is even more interesting, I didn't expect anyone to specifically report these things, (but there are) a lot of reports.
Q: I would like to know, at that time, did you believe that a turnaround in policy liberalization was coming soon? Or do you think it's impossible to predict?
A: In fact, at that time, to be honest, my mentality was already quite depressed. Last year, I was also banned. The first one in the community only lasted two weeks and 14 days. I went to Hangzhou at that time, and there were some projects at the Tianmuli Art Museum in Hangzhou. Sometimes it was said that I could go, and sometimes it was said that I was not allowed to go. Then when I came back from Hangzhou, sometimes it was said that I was not allowed to go back, and sometimes I was told that I could go back, which made people panic. At that time, it was very painful to do something with fear every day.
Q: In other words, you never thought that one day you would really let go of this kind of thing?
A: Yes. At that time, I felt very depressed. I saw that all the shops in many buildings had closed down, which was very sad. On the other hand, at that time, we could also feel that the economy was actually getting more and more sluggish, and it became increasingly difficult for everyone to consume, including for us to make money.
Q: Another detail is that at the end of November, there were actually some mass activities in Beijing calling for the relaxation of prevention and control measures. If you have experienced it, can you talk about it?
A: Because I was still working on the project "Love Drama" at the time. For me personally, I felt that completing the project itself was enough. Whether they can get out or not is their choice and decision. For me, I don't care about those things. What I care about is that I do what I am doing well; what I care about is that everyone comes here and whether they can find what they want, and I am responsible for their rights and interests. This is what I'm going to do. I remember that a friend came to the set of "Love Drama" and said, "What are you doing here? You have to take action!" I said, what we are doing now is action. If you want to take action, you can do it yourself. We support you and encourage you, but you cannot do this kind of kidnapping.
Q: Now we may want to talk about the beginning of December again. I went to investigate some information about the two public accounts "P4 Theater" and "P4 Theater and You" at that time. I noticed that from December to January, you guys seemed to have basically not posted anything for two months.
A: I didn't send anything because I was all over the moon. (Note: "Yang" is the colloquial expression of "the COVID-19 test result is positive.")
Q: Are you actually all on hiatus? Aren't there some activities still hanging on?
A: That one is very real, it is Quan Yang. I don't know if this is the case in your school. Anyway, for us, the disease here is very fast. One person got it first, and then they all became infected, and one after another they all ended up at home. Then I will talk about my own personal experience. I was in a lot of pain after having my erection. During the days when I had a fever due to the COVID-19 epidemic, I was so burned that I felt dizzy all of a sudden. I feel like it's much more serious than the usual cold and fever. For me, a lot of emotional or emotional things came out during the time when I had a fever, so it was actually quite a long process for me personally. So from that time on, my overall mood was very down (depressed), very depressed. Then I can also feel that many of my friends around me have reached a stage where they are very uncomfortable emotionally and physically during the period after they have recovered from the disease but have not yet opened up. At that time, I lived near the Lama Temple. I remember that sometimes when I was walking or riding a bicycle, I could feel that there was no one everywhere and the whole street was empty. At that time, there were still yellow sand and fallen leaves. I feel that some people are very afraid of the sun. For example, some old people are afraid of the sun and lock themselves up. Some people only go outside after the sun has passed. Very rundown (street scene). Of course, it will definitely be different from now. Now it is a very vibrant state. At that time, everyone was very panicked. Those who did not have it were very panicked, fearing that they would be infected; most of the people who had it were in great pain.
Q: Can you talk about the sequelae after you and those around you got COVID-19?
A: It's okay to tell the truth around me. During that time, I felt that my body was getting worse anyway, and I felt out of breath and so on... Personally, I felt a little bit, but I think I should be fully recovered now. Of course, what about influenza A? Anyway, I didn't get influenza A.
Q: I ask about the sequelae because many people around me will have COVID-19 and their mental state will not be very good within a month.
A: Anyway, my mental state was very bad at that time. I don't know if it was called having COVID-19.
Q: Do you feel it is related to the epidemic? Or maybe it's just related to my situation at that time.
A: Well, of course it has something to do with your own situation. I felt very uncomfortable at that time, and as you just said, I didn't post anything on the official account.
Q: Because the official account is mainly run by you.
A: Yes, I am responsible. The official account could not be used, so it was completely shut down. At that time, I was lying like a scrapped machine. I was in pain every day. It was really painful and uncomfortable. I would think: Is this the end of the epidemic? Is it going to end in this way? The way everyone got it quickly...then why didn't they get it earlier? Why did it take so long to wait? Then all the friends around me got it. It should break out after a while. I think it probably starts from December and lasts until the Chinese New Year. At that time, the whole thing is in the process of shock. Of course, I gave myself some comfort and said: Oh, just don't do anything while you have a cold and a fever. Take a rest, take a rest.
Q: So you really didn't do anything, or did you do something?
A: I really didn't do it because I couldn't do it. At that time, you said it was impossible for you to ask everyone to rehearse the show. I couldn't arrange it, everyone was in that state, very down, the whole person was in a very droopy state, and no one knew what they were doing. And at that time, I felt that the emotions were also in a very mixed state, and the whole person and the whole social state were very mixed and disordered. I think now everyone seems to be slowly yearning for the future again, but at that time I was in a state where I didn't want to think about anything.
Q: Did you especially discuss the topic of COVID-19 when you met with your friends?
A: Let's talk. I'll definitely talk. First of all, ask whether Yang is Yang. At that time, we would also talk about grabbing medicines, some people were more serious, and how to distribute medicines.
Q: What do you usually communicate about grabbing drugs? Will they discuss such issues as whose illness is more serious or less severe, what causes it, etc.?
A: This will definitely happen, and at that time (they will ask): You are seriously ill, do you want medicine? We will also communicate at that time. I immediately called my mother after I found out about the release. My hometown is in Jiangsu. I told my mother to buy fever-reducing medicine as soon as possible, white plus black or something like that. Buy it as soon as possible.
Q: Have you bought it?
A: I bought it. I got the news early, so I went to buy it. At that time, there was no need to rush to buy medicine. (The peak of the epidemic infection) was at least two or three weeks late before it started to spread to Jiangsu. Beijing was the fastest, and (symptoms) were very severe in Beijing at that time, but it was already very mild when it reached Jiangsu. Anyway, my parents said that we should just have a fever for a day or two and be fine. They grabbed a bunch of them and gave them to friends and neighbors.
Q: At that time, were there any cases where an elderly person died due to illness?
A: I've heard some stories around me, and there's also talk about one of my friends' relatives passing away. That's true. There are also some cases, for example, when a friend's parents are older and get seriously ill, it especially involves grabbing the COVID-19 drug. That COVID-19 drug (note: refers to Pfizer's specific drug Paxlovid) is very expensive, costing more than 2,000 yuan. Because of that, many people cannot get it and have no money to buy it. What should they do? That was a very painful experience. Everyone will also discuss. Some people are very anxious. There are elderly people in the family, who are in their 70s, 80s, or 90s. What should they do? Do you want to prepare this medicine? But like me, my grandpa is over 90 years old. If he can get it, then it will be fine. At least from my side, I never thought about it. I don't think I need to buy some COVID-19 medicines to stockpile. But I heard that someone said that he wanted to buy some of this new coronavirus medicine to prepare in case the elderly couldn't resist it. There are people who would make such preparations, but I have not.
Q: At that time, many people actually read some news or information related to the new crown with an almost obsessive-compulsive mentality. What was your state at that time? Will you pay much attention to this information?
A: Not paying attention at all. I think it'll be fine if it's over. But one thing is very interesting, that is, I let go after it was over, and some people even asked me to wear a mask. For example, I want to go to a supermarket, and the waiter says: Hey, put on the mask quickly. I feel very sad.
Q: How would they react if you told them I had it?
A: Yes, I said: I can get through it, I'm already done with it. I'm already exposed, what kind of mask do you want me to wear? I don't know if that's what you mean by obsessive-compulsive disorder, but that thing keeps coming back, and it's quite painful for me. Even now when we walk on the street, so many people wear masks, which makes me feel uncomfortable.
Q: Do you really dislike masks?
A: Actually, sometimes, especially when I see my children wearing them, I feel quite uncomfortable. Why? Because there are many tiny fibers in the mask itself, if they are sucked into the lungs, they cannot be discharged first, which is even worse than PM2.5. Second, when you wear a mask, your oxygen supply rate will definitely decrease, which I think will have a great impact on brain development and cardiopulmonary function. You no longer need to wear a mask in this situation. Everyone has achieved herd immunity. Why do you still insist on wearing a mask?
Q: And wearing a mask is still mandatory in many places now.
A: Yes, I feel very painful. I think it doesn't matter adults, you are still targeting children, and it is a very coercive behavior. He doesn't understand the child. In fact, the so-called child wearing it means that the parent allows him to wear it, which is to transfer his (parent's) fear to the control of the child. This is particularly bad and unscientific. We said, let's wear it on hazy days, right? It's no problem outdoors. It's a sunny day and the air is so good. Why are you wearing a mask? I can't understand this. And the virus is gone.
Q: In fact, we have almost talked about the peak period. Speaking of post-peak, when will theaters resume? In other words, when will everyone come back and start activities again?
A: That would be after the Chinese New Year. It will slowly recover after the Chinese New Year. We started working on the "Wind and Waves" project in February. Of course, the title is quite funny, that is: We will set sail again in February. In a sense, we were also responding to the depressive state of the whole person at that time, that is to say: what has to be done is in the past, let us face the future again, let us face hope again, and then do this (new drama project). Just after the New Year, everyone is in a state of readiness and renewed vitality. Then starting from February, we started doing these scenes, which was pretty good.
Q: Are there quite a few people coming back?
A: Hey, yes. I felt like everyone was very excited when I signed up this time. For example, the students who are returning to school say "I want to participate" and "I want to participate", and they are all in a very excited state. I can feel that in February, after everyone got rid of the epidemic situation, they wanted to catch something new. But actually, for example, it's April now, everything has been relaxed, and there are a lot of activities now. When there are a lot of activities, it is actually not that easy to recruit people. But at that point in February, there weren't actually that many activities, (but) everyone started to have that kind of impulse and energy.
Q: Got it. Around February, everything started to get on track, and everyone's excitement suddenly emerged.
A: Yes, especially for college students. Because all the classes were online before, otherwise the college students would be imprisoned in a campus, unable to go out anywhere, or all the classes would be online, which made them feel very aggrieved. It is a very liberating process for them to reopen the school and reconnect with society and people.
Q: Is it also a release for your own mentality? Were you completely released at that time, or were you still in a state of immersion?
A: Yes, my body recovered in February, and I started to slowly accumulate energy to meet new opportunities in 2023.
Q: That is to say, do you feel that after the New Year in February, it will be a relatively new node for you, your project, and the audience, as everyone is back. Another question I want to ask is: During the peak period, you said that you were completely in a state of shutdown. Did the silence during this period bring you any inspiration?
A: First of all, you see, during the entire epidemic, people were locked up most of the time, right? For example, if you are a couple, you may discuss the relationship a lot. This is different from the previous model of going to work and coming back at night. Many things can be released. But when you are locked together, a lot of things about two people will be exposed even more. So to be honest, sometimes I can really feel that everyone's creations are based on looking inward. Especially during these years of the epidemic, everyone has no way to find an outlet outside and cannot build relationships with other people, so build relationships with yourself. Including Kang Hae Joo's scene, he actually looked inward, as did the "Porphyria" at that time. It was either one person or two people struggling to explore it. There will be more (such works).
Q: Are you in this state yourself? For example, you are also locked up with your girlfriend, so the first thing you think of is this example, right?
A: Yes.
And then we actually did a pretty interesting art project at that time. In 2021, on January 2, we did a play called "The Howler on the Rooftop." We don't know, this is a bit prophetic in a sense, we know that Shanghai... Wuhan started at that time... Oh, Wuhan was the earliest. This thing is quite interesting. We later saw what happened in Shanghai and it was very painful. It was really painful. At that time, we could see a lot of that kind of... Because we still have many friends in Shanghai, that kind of fear and anxiety was very, very great. The fear was not the fear of the virus, but the fear of people. I can't eat! Some are really trying to grab food, which is very painful. We were actually in Tianmu at that time, and we also had a performance at Shuijing Square. At that time, I recruited a lot of friends in Hangzhou. For example, once, there was a performance tomorrow. When we were rehearsing around 10 o'clock in the evening, we had a very fun process of responding. We were in the small square, everyone shouted to each other, and used a shouting method to make a sound. But just because of that shouting, the last performance was canceled. This is amazing. I think of something. Everyone seems to be afraid, or some people are afraid to hear this sound. When he hears this sound, he feels: Hey, you can't make it anymore. This is a fact, I have encountered this situation many times.
Q: Around March of this year, you started the "Personal Chronicle" project. Actually, I'm quite curious. Was it the process of inward searching that made you decide to do this project when you were locked up at home due to the epidemic, or was it that you had wanted to do it for a long time?
A: Oh, actually when we make this thing, we do it first, and then when we do it, we feel: Oh, this is it. Then I went back and described the matter more clearly, and then started recruiting again. It was always like this. We have been doing co-creation plays since 15 or 16 years ago. In fact, we had them back then. For example, we recruited four or five people in a short period of time, within a month, and we would arrange the play, including music, synthesis, lighting, lines, dance, etc., and we would make it. In fact, everyone does not have such clear responsibilities. If you are in charge of dancing, you can only dance; if I am in charge of lighting, I... it is not like that. Like some professional theater troupes, the division of responsibilities is clear. It's not like that. It is a very loose and free state of mutual creation and stimulation. It was not until 2019 that we started to work on it. For example, the "Real Image" project and the following P4U project were generated in this way one at a time. Hey, this is fun. But for example, when we encountered - for example, when we first started acting in 2019, we did a play called "Psychedelic". At that time, we discovered some problems, which was this kind of nepotism. That's why we made several corrections later to avoid this happening. So it's like doing it first, and then discovering problems while doing it. When we release the real recruitment or some plans, we will list these rules in more detail. So the "personal journal" seems to us to be one... Of course, there are many detailed rules and regulations in the personal journal. These detailed rules and regulations are mainly because many accidents happened at that time. For me, many of them are things that I can't control. Also, when it comes to acting, this is the particularly troublesome thing, which is the ambiguity between reality and fiction, or let's say, the relationship between creation and life... Ah, we started laughing again, and we started to understand each other again! Ha ha. After all, I am the theater manager, so I have to coordinate this matter constantly, constantly, constantly. Moreover, there are too many things that can be projected on me as my symbol or my image, and they can be thrown and projected on me at every turn. On the one hand, I have to shoulder the responsibility, and on the other hand, I have to think that this matter cannot continue like this, otherwise in the end, many things that are originally good will fall apart. I think it is quite a pity.
Q: In fact, "personal history" is quite related to some experiences like yours. I remember you said that you hope to do a "personal biography" for everyone who leads a drama or a project in the future.
A: There is such an entrance. We first use a description of a person to let everyone know, oh, so this person is like this. Then we start again. I think this is very important: what kind of person you are, you first describe it to everyone very frankly in front of the camera. Everyone also has such a preparation to start the project later. This also allows each other to have a confirmation and guarantee, otherwise it is often imaginary: I just read your words, I am just an imaginary thing, and I don't know you that well. Then when something happens to you, I feel that I don't agree with you, or I feel that you are wrong. At that time, I felt that this was not good, so we should make the connection first at the beginning. So I also discovered this recruitment. For example, at the beginning, we did a lot of recruiting, and we would receive hundreds of resumes at every turn. But in fact, that was an illusion, because many people... came to the interview with the mentality of applying for jobs. In fact, you shouldn't hire these people because: first, you can't provide funds or wages; what the two of them may want is a play produced by a director, and they don't want to co-create it. In fact, they don't see this clearly, which actually increases the cost of communication. So later on, our creations or our recruitment became more and more written... Many people said, hey, what the hell are you doing? can't read.
Q: Is it a bit like searching for the stratosphere?
A: Yes, yes, yes, yes. That is, as the targeting becomes stronger and stronger, the connection will become better and better. So, later on, we actually discovered that sometimes you don't need to write something too general, but you have to put out the most authentic things about each person, and you can attract the most like-minded people, and this kind of like-mindedness is so important. This scent congeniality is the feeling of a bee meeting a flower. So later on, we may recruit two or three people just by sending out a recruitment call, but these two or three people will be enough, so there is no need to recruit so many people. It's possible that your words are flying out of control, and that's no problem.
Q: There is another question that may be more open, that is, from the lockdown to the relaxation, many people will say: we have returned to normalcy. Wondering what you think about this issue? Because actually P4 Theater looks at some of the push introductions I have observed before, and it is something that is not normal, or even abnormal. Do you think that after the epidemic is over, there will be a return to a so-called normalcy? Or do you feel that something has changed irreversibly? It doesn't have to be theater, you can also talk about your own personal experiences.
A: Oh, sure. Regarding the idea of normalcy, there is definitely no going back to the past, that's for sure. First of all, this experience cannot be erased. These three years are indelible memories for everyone. And to be honest, the entire international situation has undergone great changes. From a macro perspective, this is a human movement. The epidemic has actually left us a lot of treasures, asking us to think about the reasons for those things. If a disaster similar or greater than this happens again, how should we face it? This is what I feel particularly important to reflect on, and one of the points here is the relationship between people. I remember that from the earliest days, I could feel that there were many faults in the relationships between people, such as mutual distrust, conflicts and contradictions, etc. It doesn't mean that these things will disappear as soon as the epidemic is over. As for those things that are stimulated, we need to use a more careful and clever eye to find those things, and then think about how to solve them.
Including this actually involves a lot of micro-power things, as small as a power relationship between people. It's very simple. Let's talk about the big fire in Xinjiang. Why can one person lock the door of a house? How can it be done like this? What does it mean behind the scenes? So how will we face it in the future? It doesn't mean that we should reflect on it when disaster strikes. But we now have to think again: What should we do when we face a new disaster soon or in the future? I think there will be no shortage of disasters.
Q: What I mean is that you feel that this normal state may not have existed, and there have always been some hidden dangers, including some hidden dangers in human life as a whole that have been highlighted in this disaster, but this is something we have to consider all the time.
A: Because I am born in the 90s, and you are born in the 00s, right? You see, we are already 10 years apart. My experience of these 33 years is too exaggerated. Just think about it, reform and opening up, China's development history, I just stepped on the line and walked all the way - until the epidemic. To be honest, it wasn't until the epidemic that I felt this "pop" suddenly change. Before the epidemic, I was always very confident. I always thought, wow, how wonderful this future is. But this epidemic just hit... I wonder if you have thought that since you were young, you have experienced those disasters, such as floods and earthquakes, and there is no problem? Even if there is a financial crisis, we can solve it just by relying on our great leadership. Look at this economy, right? The Internet economy, wow. How awesome we are, what about Huawei phones... hahaha. The feeling is that the epidemic suddenly came and triggered a series of things that I think are systemic. For example, the simplest thing is that young people have great difficulty finding jobs. Then everyone has to take the postgraduate entrance examination and the public examination, which is already very abnormal. There would be no chance.
Q: Does this matter have a lot to do with the epidemic?
A: I think it is a trigger, but what emerges from this trigger is actually a lot of things we need to think about. Well, we say it is a natural disaster, but there are also man-made disasters. How to deal with natural disasters and man-made disasters? What I mean to say is that this period of history that we have experienced together is a treasure house. This treasure house can be constantly recalled and reviewed, and some things in this history can be brought out to make us new preparations to build something - and those things are actually what we have been missing for a long time.
Well, for example, as far as theatrical activities are concerned, there has always been something missing, that is: how can everyone discuss it together, just like what I just mentioned about "Killing That Rose", how can we reach a consensus? In our small ecosystem - whether we are a crew or a group of people, how can we establish a trusting relationship instead of a strong confrontation with each other, instead of a quarrel? And it's not even like, "Hey, we can't solve it, I'll call a third party to come over and solve it." It shouldn't be like this. It's like children fighting, right? Children have to fight when they encounter problems. "I want to tell the teacher!" and "Let's see, how to deal with this and this, and how to deal with this and this." That is, is there any other way besides suing the teacher? In the same way, in fact, after the epidemic, what we feel is the constant "I want to sue the teacher" things, and these things have been strengthened. What's particularly obvious is that in recent years, complaints and calls to 12345 have become deeply rooted in everyone's hearts. Damn it, this thing makes me think: Why do I have to complain so often? Of course, this is also related to Taobao, Pinduoduo, etc., because I do get cheated all the time, haha. So where is our other communication? How do we establish a trusting relationship? I think when we return to normalcy now, we have to make efforts in this regard.
Including a few details, I just received a call yesterday from a friend of mine and a girl who has acted in our crew. She once met a pedestrian on the road. She said that the pedestrian suddenly felt so hungry that he couldn't walk. She was quite concerned about him and asked, "What's wrong with you?" He said I can't eat and I don't have a penny left. Can you lend me some money? My friend was very kind. She not only bought him food, drink and water, but also gave him money to keep him going back to his hometown. Then what happened to that person? I had a phone call with him yesterday and talked about this matter. It was because he had a good chat with a girl on a dating website, and then the girl told her to come to a place in Yanjiao. In fact, he was defrauded. He was taken to a pyramid scheme group and stayed in it for more than a year. After defrauding all the money from his friends and relatives, the pyramid schemes group was finally eliminated in a sense, and he was lost on the streets. Then he had no one to rely on, so he went to a shelter. They could only stay in the shelter for one week, and he was kicked out after one week. After being kicked out, he didn't have a penny to do anything, and he couldn't even borrow a penny from all the trust relationships he had, so he was hungry. A person in such a state. I just find it very interesting.
He now has a lot of debt. I contacted this person yesterday because I read an article on a public account. Someone said that I was fucking cheated. Someone lent me money and said he had no money to go home for dinner. I lent him the money, but he blocked me. I said, hey, this is very similar to what happened to my friend. Then let me ask, has that person paid you back? Is that true or false? Then the friend contacted that person again. But what he said should be true, but he didn't pay back the money. Then I made a call to this boy yesterday, and he told me about his own experience: He originally had the purpose of falling in love and getting married, but ended up being deceived into a pyramid scheme and borrowed hundreds of thousands of dollars from relatives and friends around him. Now a person is working in Guangzhou and cannot make much money every day. Then many credit cards are overdrafted, and countless banks collect debts from him every day. This is also a real person. What should he do with his life? I think, in just 30 years, we have gone from a planned economy for 40 years to a market economy now. Many people have made money, and many people will become people like this, or even what we call the "Sanhe Great God". Then he said, oh, I have a friend who sold his kidney for 280,000 yuan, and I want to sell it too. This is how they live. If I take this 280,000, I might be able to return all the money. He couldn't find a way to survive. He was locked and locked by these layers of things.
Q: The epidemic has made this situation worse.
A: It keeps getting worse. Then he really said that he asked many people to borrow money. If he wanted to go home, he could still make an excuse or even ask for some food. Either begging for food or asking for some help. No one paid any attention to him, no one. Everyone's attitude towards him was: Oh, I've seen too many people like you, so stay away. Including some policemen and so on, he asked (policeman) if you could (lend me money), and he said that the policeman said directly: Shall I lend you money? I meet hundreds of people like you every day, should I borrow them all? So in the end my friend did give him a few hundred dollars. He said that he would remember that feeling for the rest of his life, it was very warm. That person was extremely desperate, because he had deceived all his relatives and friends, and no one believed him. Everyone blocked him as soon as he spoke to him, or said: Pay him back quickly, or I will kill you if you don't pay back, and so on. His parents definitely don't care, because he has told too many lies before, because of pyramid schemes. What to do at that moment? When I think of these things, I find them quite interesting, and they are actually somewhat related to this theme.
Q: I just got some new ideas from some of the things you said, and I want to ask a few more questions. You just mentioned that there are more and more frictions and collisions between people. In fact, I am quite curious: although there may not be much contact with epidemic prevention personnel after the relaxation, it may be that in November everyone will experience contact with epidemic prevention personnel and those people who were hidden under protective clothing as we called them "Dabai" at the time. What was your experience with them?
A: We had friends here who thought it was "Dabai" because there were still jobs like this and we couldn't find any other jobs. In fact, there were some things that I thought were very funny at the time. They were not related to Dabai, but to the so-called "big data". For example, in April last year, I was monitored by the electronic fence, and it was said that that area was closed and you couldn't go out, and so on. But actually I was already in Hangzhou at that time, so I ignored the call. When I came back from Hangzhou, he called me suddenly and said: You are going to be quarantined, and I am going to put a seal on you now. I said this was a month ago. He asked me if I had been to that place, and I told him that I had been to that place a month ago. He said, "That doesn't matter, you will be sealed now." I said: No, please tell me what time and where the big data (shows me) is. He said: No matter, big data said so. Later, a neighborhood committee in Haidian called me and said: If you don't cooperate, I'll call the police. I said: Cooperate, cooperate, cooperate. You see, I have been outside for a long time, so there must be no risk, and the codes are all green. Two days later, he said: Are you going to do this? I said: I no longer live in Haidian, I live in Chaoyang. He said: Okay, I'll transfer your phone number to Chaoyang. Chaoyang has never contacted me. I think this sense of absurdity is very interesting. (I have to) deal with many such absurd things. (The other party) just throws the word "big data" into the air. Can you tell me which one, which point, and which thing about you? He just blocked me casually. I encountered this situation several times: He said, have you been somewhere? The thing is we haven't been there, and that's even been the case a few times. Of course it wasn't me who met it, it was my girlfriend who met it. She had never been to that place, and suddenly she didn't receive a call saying that you were blocked and we were going to install a monitor or something on you now. I find it very baffling. You can provide evidence for whatever you want. You can't just accuse someone casually. I have encountered many ridiculous things like this during this epidemic, not just one (incident), such as pop-up window 4, pop-up window 3, pop-up window 3, and pop-up windows again... and then somehow it was eliminated all at once. The funniest thing is that when a friend of ours was looking for a job, he pretended to be Dabai. He said that I specialize in clearing pop-ups. As soon as you give them to me, I will clear them for you. There's a lot of room for manipulation and a lot of room for error. The mistake may be: "I didn't see this" or "I saw it wrong", but no one admits these mistakes and no one is willing to take responsibility for them. Where does this responsibility fall? Dump it on big data.
Q: Do you think big data has no ability to bear mistakes.
A: That's right, so some people were imprisoned alive for several months, and were taken out alive and isolated for a long time.
Q: I wanted to mention "Dabai" just now, because there are many people hiding under the "Dabai" clothes. Just like the big data you just mentioned, they don't have the ability to bear mistakes. In fact, they also avoid the need to bear mistakes to some extent, thus exceeding their rights and responsibilities.
A: Yes, just like the last time I answered the phone, I still have the recording. If you want to listen, I can play it for you. "You won't cooperate, right? Then I'll call the police." He doesn't communicate with you at all. I said: OK, tell me what time and time I am, what is the content of my record, and whether I am quarantined or not. He wouldn't say it, he said it was big data, otherwise I would call the police. I feel that this kind of blaming behavior has really destroyed a lot of the credibility that was originally established. Credibility is very important. As an integral part of a national machine, it is to maintain this trust relationship. But many people destroy this relationship very easily. Is there pressure on him behind this? Or is it that he has been suppressed time and time again in this relationship and has to resort to means? This is what I'm thinking about. I also particularly understand the person behind "Dabai" you just mentioned, because my friend is a very timid person, but according to his own description, when he puts on that clothes and gives various commands, he immediately feels that he has some kind of power.
Q: Did you experience any material problems in November when the lockdown was more severe?
A: No, I have never encountered it. Never encountered it.
Q: Have you never encountered this in Beijing?
A: Yes. I didn't encounter it in Hangzhou last April.
Q: Also, have you ever encountered any situation where you were discriminated against after having sex? At that time, I heard that some workers and service personnel at the grassroots level would not be allowed to work after they passed the sun.
A: No, no, this has never happened.
Q: That's pretty much what we want to know. If you have anything to add, you can add more.
A: Let me say one more thing. P4 Theater ran from that big space to this small room. In fact, it was definitely because of the excuse of the new coronavirus epidemic, or some kind of driving force generated by the prohibition of gatherings. Such a movement (referring to epidemic prevention and control) caused the space to shrink from a very large space that could accommodate hundreds of people to a space that could only accommodate dozens or even a dozen people. However, such a small space has carried all discussions and some small performances after 21 years (P4 Theater the year of relocation). For example, when we performed "Iceberg" here on January 1, 2022, we recruited 15 audience members and 8 crew members, a total of 23 people, and also performed many performances here. I think the relationship between such a contraction and the epidemic is also very interesting.
Of course, now that we are free, we can go to various large and interesting places to perform, and then we can perform for hundreds of audiences at a time. I feel that in such a shrinking process, at least we have not given up on expressing ourselves, and we have not given up because the environment does not allow us to speak out. We can still do this, and I think this is a very valuable thing. Who knows when it will open? But even if we are not open, we are still moving.
Q: Do you still have any plans to return to a big "home" like the previous sculpture table?
A: Ah, of course. There are actually quite a few such spaces now, and we will also have cooperation. We had held a performance in that boxing ring before, and there were more than 140 people there. We can have relationships with them in various spaces. Of course, we also did a show in Jingshan Park, which was a purely outdoor scene. It was a lot of fun.
Q: Do you think it's more interesting to perform in different scenes and spaces, or is it more interesting to perform in a fixed space?
A: I think we need to be more and more open.
Q: Maybe even if you finally return to that big fixed space, you will find various places to try in the future?
A: Yes, you must go out. Drama is not something that happens in a fixed place.
Q: Okay, that actually brings it to an end here, thank you.

About burning the moon, or what love is, or the illusion of fragmentation and wholeness
On December 16th, watch "(Broken Moon)" and watch the moon being burned to pieces again, between you and me.
01
I have known Zichou for almost a year. He was born in 2001 and just graduated from college this year. His real name is Xu Shuai, but he named himself Zichou. His university major was stage art, but he couldn't find any related job at all.
He wrote several scripts this year. Some scripts were rejected, some were discarded, and some were misappropriated. Until this play, it was originally called "Burning the Moon." Later, because it had the same name as a play by a certain theater troupe, an official letter was issued, and now it is renamed "(Broken Moon)."
02
He rarely smiles, and his expression is usually dull, but his heart is full of emotion. It was when he played the capitulator that I was most moved, because the light seeping out from the gaps was even more precious. Using one's own life to perform is the bravest thing, especially to bring out the most vulnerable things in oneself.
The first time he came to participate in p4 was the project of "The Wind and Waves", and later he participated in "Four Eyes", "The Kingdom of Happiness", and finally participated in "Human Surrender" and "The Last Rehearsal". In drama, it is a place where he can still breathe. He said that he did not know what Aalto's cruel drama was, but he was fascinated by it.
03
He failed to pass the postgraduate entrance examination, and his first love was a patient with depression. He told me two days ago that he doesn't know how to love anymore, and now he can only treat the person he loves most in the coldest and cruelest way. I am eleven years older than him, and sometimes he disappears suddenly without transition, leaving only his back.
Where is the love? What is cruelty to me? We'll find out the answer to this during the performance on December 16th. I firmly believe that drama can give us something, and love is definitely not an empty discussion. We have long been accustomed to the inability to express love and the inability to express love.
04
What does the Burning Moon burn? When I take a picture of Zi Chou, what appears is the Zi Chou moon. Is it a cold stone or a distant dream? We are locked into this dungeon of the human world and can only rely on projection to identify the truth. It is ridiculous and sad at the same time. The so-called "rationality" is nothing but lazy inertia, and no one wants to smash anything.
The stone rolled down from the top of the mountain again and again and fell into the same pit again and again, but this was not the curse of Sisyphus. What makes humans transcend all things is that we always have to transpire upward and break free from those shackles and shackles, even if we destroy everything eternal in the world. People will die before they are reborn.
05
The play on No. 16 is a practice that completely escapes from any established formal system. It does not need to be labeled with any decadent names at all. Those dirty tricks cannot be compared with this. We are writing history, writing about things that have never happened. The stones will be broken into pieces, and the light of hope will be reinterwoven in the gaps. Love will not die.
Rehearsals for the entire troupe are arduous and challenging. The changes in personnel and the mix of time make everyone feel as if they are on Medusa's attack. It is precisely because of this that a strange force tightly binds everyone's fate together. The broken moon is the breath coming from the deep sea, and it is also everyone's courage to rush towards the high hanging things.
Come and experience a question about love and hate with us on December 16th, under the moonlight, next to the tree.

sources.text:
p4剧场和你
2023-10-04
理论与方法
电影放映——疯神
具象的凶残，暴力和杀戮。疯狂的梦魇，血腥诡异的噩梦，丑恶骇人的怪物，肮脏卑贱的生命，残忍可怖的存在，荒诞无稽的行为，人类脑海深处最原始的可怖。极致癫狂的画图，噩梦诅咒般的预言，诡谲恶变的怪奇形种，一幅幅死亡压迫的构图，孤绝狂妄的巴别塔，预示着黑暗狂妄的毁灭。
本人大爱cult片
他从潜水钟出来，被送到末世梦魇般的地狱中。
具象的凶残，暴力和杀戮。疯狂的梦魇，血腥诡异的噩梦，丑恶骇人的怪物，肮脏卑贱的生命，残忍可怖的存在，荒诞无稽的行为，人类脑海深处最原始的可怖。极致癫狂的画图，噩梦诅咒般的预言，诡谲恶变的怪奇形种，一幅幅死亡压迫的构图，孤绝狂妄的巴别塔，预示着黑暗狂妄的毁灭。
资本主义是一尊疯神，它残酷地剥削压榨，将生命挤压成干尸，拼凑成畸形的怪物，又无情地把它们碾碎。电击着被缚的巨人，肢解着残破的血肉，生产暴虐的奇观。哪一位天使会来拯救我们呢？连上帝都已经解体了。你要给自己安上翅膀吗？低头看看吧，连巨人的尿液都已被榨取殆尽。
这部电影在拍什么？里世界！一个完全意识形态化了的资本主义拜物教的国家的意识世界！精神扭曲干枯，爱欲的失落破碎，扭曲的变态的彷徨的失落的无助的倾轧的撕裂的破碎的一切！再去放一枚炸药吧！再去放一枚炸药吧！你怎么还不动手？看不到那比无还少的无穷痛苦吗？再来一位烈士吧，用身躯去推动指针的最后一秒。美好的生活在地狱中是可耻的，我想知道怎样的身躯能爆破出一种崭新的未来。
充满了隐喻和宗教意味的暗黑讽刺，末世朋克版柯南伯格，极致疯癫的史云梅耶，暗黑地狱中的阿内拉鲁，变态版来自深渊。
人不是抽象的蛰居于世界之外的存在物，人就是人的世界，就是国家，社会。人的本质，在其现实意义上，就是一切社会关系的总和。劳动产品和劳动本身的分离，客观劳动条件和主观劳动条件的分离，是资本主义生产过程事实上的基础和起点。资本不是物，而是一定的、社会的、属于一定历史社会形态的生产关系，后者体现在一个物上，并赋予这个物以独特的社会性质。
资本家对工人的统治，就是物对人的统治，死劳动对活劳动的统治，产品对生产者的统治。在“充满形而上学的微妙和神学的怪诞”的商品世界里，人与人之间的关系颠倒为物与物之间的关系，物控制和支配人，人的逻辑臣服于物的逻辑，正如卢卡奇指出的那样，“在资本主义发展过程中，物化结构越来越深入地、注定地、决定性地沉浸在人的意识里。
必须推翻使人成为被侮辱、被奴役、被遗弃和被蔑视的东西的一切关系。只有在那个时候，即在迫使个人奴隶般地服从分工的情形已经消失，从而脑力劳动和体力劳动的对立也随之消失之后；在劳动已经不仅仅是谋生的手段，而且本身成了生活的第一需要之后；在随着个人的全面发展，他们的生产力也增长起来，而集体财富的一切源泉都充分涌流之后，——只有在那个时候，才能完全超出资产阶级权利的狭隘眼界，社会才能在自己的旗帜上写上：各尽所能，按需分配！
你是一个在恐惧中等待主人鞭打的奴隶吗？如果你还有一点感觉，那你肯定能感到鞭打，因为我对这件事情的解释定会让你血流不止。

sources.text:
P4 Theater and You
2023-10-04
Theory and Methods
Movie Screening - Mad God
I love cult movies. He came out of the diving bell and was sent to the nightmare hell of the apocalypse. Fierce brutality, violence and killing. Crazy...
I love cult movies
He emerges from the diving bell and is transported to an apocalyptic nightmare hell.
Fierce brutality, violence and killing. Crazy nightmares, bloody and weird nightmares, ugly and terrifying monsters, dirty and despicable lives, cruel and terrifying existences, absurd behaviors, the most primitive horror deep in the human mind. The extremely crazy paintings, the nightmare-like prophecies of curses, the strange and malignant forms, the compositions of death and oppression, the lonely and arrogant Tower of Babel, foretell the destruction of darkness and arrogance.
Capitalism is a mad god that cruelly exploits and squeezes life into mummies, pieces it together into deformed monsters, and crushes them ruthlessly. Shocking the bound giant with electricity, dismembering the broken flesh and blood, producing a tyrannical spectacle. Which angel will come to save us? Even God has disintegrated. Do you want to give yourself wings? Look down, even the giant's urine has been squeezed out.
What is this movie about? Another world! The conscious world of a country that is completely ideological and capitalist fetishism! The spirit is twisted and dry, the love is lost and broken, the twisted, perverted, wandering, lost, helpless, strangled, torn and broken everything! Go put another explosive! Go put another explosive! Why don't you take action? Can't you see the infinite pain that is less than nothing? Let's be another martyr, use your body to push the pointer for the last second. A good life is shameful in hell. I want to know what kind of body can explode into a new future.
A dark satire full of metaphors and religious undertones, the apocalyptic punk version of Cronenberg, the extremely crazy Svanemeyer, Anelaru in the dark hell, and the perverted version from the abyss.
Human beings are not abstract beings living outside the world. Human beings are the human world, the country, and society. Human essence, in its practical sense, is the sum of all social relations. The separation of labor products and labor itself, the separation of objective labor conditions and subjective labor conditions, is the de facto foundation and starting point of the capitalist production process. Capital is not a thing, but a certain, social, production relationship belonging to a certain historical and social form. The latter is embodied in an object and gives the object a unique social nature.
The rule of capitalists over workers is the rule of things over people, the rule of dead labor over living labor, and the rule of products over producers. In the commodity world "full of metaphysical subtleties and theological weirdness," the relationship between people is inverted into the relationship between things, with things controlling and dominating people, and human logic surrendering to the logic of things. As Lukács pointed out, "In the process of capitalist development, materialized structures are increasingly deeply, destined, and decisively immersed in human consciousness.
All relationships which make man into something humiliated, enslaved, abandoned and despised must be overthrown. Only then, after the situation that forced individuals to submit to the division of labor slavishly, and thus the opposition between mental and manual labor, has disappeared; after labor has become not only a means of livelihood, but itself has become the first need of life; after the productivity of individuals has increased with the comprehensive development of individuals, and all sources of collective wealth have fully flowed - only then can society completely transcend the narrow vision of bourgeois rights and write on its banner: From each according to his ability, to each according to his need!
Are you a slave waiting in fear for a whipping from your master? If you can feel anything at all, you can definitely feel the whiplash, because my explanation of the matter will make your blood bleed.
Blow the blood out of your neck

sources.text:
p4剧场和你
2023-09-27
理论与方法
510放映——伊尼舍林的报丧女妖
呼应上期的女巫主题，我们放映一期马丁麦克唐纳的电影。电影的大致剧情是在爱尔兰的伊尼舍林岛上，一对昔日好友因人生价值的分歧和个人边界感的不同而走向决裂。
一切的荒诞，都是我们自身的荒诞
呼应上期的女巫主题，我们放映一期马丁麦克唐纳的电影。电影的大致剧情是在爱尔兰的伊尼舍林岛上，一对昔日好友因人生价值的分歧和个人边界感的不同而走向决裂。
导演精心地把许多意向安插在情节的铺陈中：门与窗是探索与侵入的通道；鲜艳明亮美好的室外与阴暗的室内又映射着世界与个人状态的分裂，神父与杂货店老板娘分别意指宗教在面对深刻的存在危机时的过时与无力、与封闭环境中庸俗的好奇心与精神麻木，英国内战与好友割席、美好与诅咒，即使美好如伊甸园的伊尼舍林岛也阻止不了一段旧日友谊的毁灭。。。
岂不是另一种烧仓房
导演对故事发生地点的选择也很有意思：如果说欧洲的外岛是不列颠，不列颠的外岛是爱尔兰，那么爱尔兰的外岛，就是伊尼舍林，即INISH-ERIN。在一个最与世隔绝的岛屿发生这样一出亲密好友的隔绝之戏，既意味着了人与人之间根本的割裂与回归伊甸的不可能性；又表达了艺术作为生存的追求，终究和庸俗的日常一样，逃不脱女妖的诅咒与无聊的责难。或许有人觉得导演将唯一的希望放在划船离开投入主岛的妹妹身上，她拥有丰富的理解力与强大的内心，在无聊与绝望中，她最终离开了那个封闭的岛屿，去面对世界，探索一种直面炮火，改变现实，向世界敞开的打破僵局的可能性。可别忘了，远处的炮火所预示的，是更加残暴和盲目的相互杀戮，她乘船所去的，是一个更加残酷，遍地女妖的世界。
"don't say oh pardrick,say yes.“
马丁麦克唐纳的剧本中总是存在着两股相互抗衡的力量。即在世界荒诞无常以及精神与存在危机之下所产生的悲剧力量，和身处其中的人们如何面对这种存在主义危机。作为重要的“直面戏剧”浪潮中的剧作家，麦克唐纳不断地讨论他者与荒谬之间的关系，因为荒谬也从人与人之间根本的断裂与不可理解性之中诞生。他不提供给观众任何逃避现实的途径，也阻断了所有对未来的憧憬，坚持以自己的客观视角刻画现实主义故事原貌。“我对自己看待生活与世界的方式、对人类本性的思考保持绝对坦诚。”这部影片兼具大众的观赏性和残酷绝望的严肃思考，是麦克唐纳将直面戏剧带向大众的一次成功尝试。
”不说话，不表达自己的感受，心怀怨恨，所有这些似乎永远都不会消失。我尽量让自己不要如此，但我内心深处还是有这个特质。我不知道，我希望我们这个族群正在变得更好。“
最后 放上往期映后交流剪辑版

sources.title: 510 Screening - The Banshee of Inisherin
sources.text:
P4 Theater and You
2023-09-27
Theory and Methods
510 Screening - The Banshee of Inisherin
Echoing last issue's witch theme, we present a screening of Martin McDonagh's films. The general plot of the movie is that on the Irish island of Inisherin...
All absurdities are our own absurdities
Echoing last issue's witch theme, we present a screening of Martin McDonagh's films. The general plot of the movie is that on the Irish island of Inisherin, a pair of former friends broke up due to differences in the value of life and different sense of personal boundaries.
The director carefully placed many intentions in the plot: doors and windows are passages for exploration and invasion; the bright and beautiful outdoors and the dark indoors reflect the split between the world and the personal state; the priest and the grocery store proprietress respectively represent the obsolescence and powerlessness of religion in the face of a profound existential crisis, and the vulgar curiosity and mental numbness in a closed environment; the British Civil War and the separation of friends, beauty and curse; even the beautiful Inisherin Island, like the Garden of Eden, cannot prevent the destruction of an old friendship...
Isn't this another kind of barn burning?
The director's choice of the location where the story takes place is also very interesting: if the outer island of Europe is Britain, and the outer island of Britain is Ireland, then the outer island of Ireland is Inisherin, that is, INISH-ERIN. Such a scene of isolation between close friends on the most isolated island not only means the fundamental separation between people and the impossibility of returning to Eden; it also expresses that art as the pursuit of survival, after all, like vulgar daily life, cannot escape the curse of the banshee and the blame of boredom. Some people may think that the director placed his only hope on the sister who left the main island in a row boat. She has rich understanding and a strong heart. In boredom and despair, she finally left the closed island to face the world and explore the possibility of breaking the deadlock by facing gunfire, changing reality and opening up to the world. But don't forget that the gunfire in the distance foreshadows more brutal and blind killings. What she is going to by boat is a more cruel world full of banshees.
"don't say oh pardrick,say yes."
There are always two competing forces in Martin McDonagh's plays. That is, the tragic power generated by the absurdity and spiritual and existential crisis of the world, and how people in it face this existential crisis. As a playwright in the important wave of "face-to-face drama", MacDonald constantly discusses the relationship between the other and the absurd, because the absurd is also born from the fundamental rupture and incomprehensibility between people. He does not provide the audience with any way to escape reality, and blocks all longing for the future, insisting on depicting the original appearance of the realist story from his own objective perspective. "I am absolutely honest about the way I view life and the world, and my thoughts on human nature." This film combines public viewing with serious reflections on cruelty and despair. It is Macdonald's successful attempt to bring direct drama to the public.
"Not talking, not expressing your feelings, holding on to resentment, all of that never seems to go away. I try not to do that, but it's still there deep down inside of me. I don't know, I hope that our community is getting better."

理论与方法
510放映——反基督者
两夫妻在浴室做爱的时刻，他们的婴儿却坠床而亡。生命的创造和死亡都是最原初的创伤。亨德尔的咏叹调、黑白色的慢镜头、让这个残酷的事件形成了新的“感情长度”，我们投入的情感越多，我们就越痛苦。
现代人比原始人更加远离他自己情绪的真相。——克尔凯郭尔
两夫妻在浴室做爱的时刻，他们的婴儿却坠床而亡。生命的创造和死亡都是最原初的创伤。亨德尔的咏叹调、黑白色的慢镜头、让这个残酷的事件形成了新的“感情长度”，我们投入的情感越多，我们就越痛苦。
丈夫带着妻子来到森林里的小屋，以治愈他们意外丧子之痛，可“自然正是撒旦的神殿”，在心理治疗和女巫研究之间，一股更加黑暗原始的驱力使女主逐渐趋于迷狂。理性掩盖压抑了无处不在的撒旦，以伪装的权力关系支配他人，而又虚伪的无视这一点。妻子的迷狂不仅是丧子之痛和原始欲望的发泄，更是理性被压抑物的返回。自然界的自然现象已超出道德伦理、秩序和理性逻辑的约束，而这些现象呈现出一种被颠覆的自然。秩序是宗教从一种原始崇拜转向有组织集体崇拜的必然工具，人们接受一种井然有条便是接受一种禁锢；而理性逻辑与原始宗教的博弈，产生了对后世影响深远的新教，理性被纳入宗教思维，是基督教对自身岌岌可危地位的挽救。而影片中“三个乞丐”的预言更是跟新约中耶稣诞生的场景唱反调，这些针锋相对的符号寓言无不体现导演对基督教及其延伸物的态度，这是影片最直观的态度。
拉斯冯提尔在这部最具哲学性的作品中，将性与宗教这两个主题共同推向极端，正是在极端与越界的情境下，真正的思考才能够得以展开；也正是在观众“无法接受”与“失去安全感”之际，换言之在一种情绪性的压迫之下，才更能够使人去追寻这种“无法接受”背后的根源，从而反思那种所谓的“安全感”是否只是虚幻的外衣。
“我有整整两年的时间都非常沮丧，整天不知道在想什么，或者我什么都不想。这部电影就是在那段时间里拍摄完成的，灵感来自于我自己的感受、想法和恐惧。我拍电影是想表达出一种接近真正黑暗的恐惧，而不是让他们来体会我内心的想法。”导演将两年来的精神分裂的所有阴郁与暴躁全部发泄在《反基督者》之中。在这部影片中，Lars又回到了他早期的对视觉技巧的着迷，同时又不失《狗镇》简洁有力的戏剧张力。因此，这部影片是他导演生涯的一个不小的转折点。

sources.text:
P4 Theater and You
2023-09-23
Theory and Methods
510 Screening - Antichrist
Modern man is further removed from the truth of his own emotions than primitive man.
Modern man is further removed from the truth of his own emotions than primitive man. --Kierkegaard
While the couple was having sex in the bathroom, their baby fell from the bed and died. The creation and death of life are the original traumas. Handel's arias and black-and-white slow motion give this cruel event a new "emotional length". The more emotions we invest, the more painful we are.
The husband takes his wife to a cabin in the forest to heal them from the unexpected loss of their child, but "nature is the temple of Satan." Between psychotherapy and witch research, a darker and more primitive drive drives the heroine gradually towards madness. Reason covers up and suppresses the omnipresent Satan, dominating others with disguised power relations, while hypocritically ignoring this. The wife's madness is not only the release of the pain of losing her son and primitive desires, but also the return of the suppressed rationality. Natural phenomena in nature have exceeded the constraints of moral ethics, order and rational logic, and these phenomena present a subverted nature. Order is an inevitable tool for religion to transform from primitive worship to organized collective worship. When people accept an orderly manner, they accept a kind of confinement. The game between rational logic and primitive religion gave rise to Protestantism, which has a profound influence on later generations. The inclusion of reason in religious thinking is Christianity's way of saving its precarious position. The prophecy of the "three beggars" in the film is in opposition to the birth of Jesus scene in the New Testament. These tit-for-tat symbolic allegories all reflect the director's attitude towards Christianity and its extensions, which is the most intuitive attitude of the film.
In this most philosophical work, Lars von Trier pushes the two themes of sex and religion to extremes. It is in extreme and transgressive situations that real thinking can unfold; it is also when the audience is "unacceptable" and "loses their sense of security", in other words under a kind of emotional oppression, that people can better trace the root cause behind this "unacceptability" and reflect on whether the so-called "security" is just an illusory cloak.
"I was very depressed for two full years. I didn't know what I was thinking all day long, or I didn't think about anything at all. This movie was shot during that time, and was inspired by my own feelings, thoughts, and fears. I made the movie to express a fear that is close to real darkness, rather than letting them experience my inner thoughts." The director vented all the gloom and irritability of the two years of schizophrenia in "Antichrist." In this film, Lars returns to his early fascination with visual tricks without losing the simple and powerful dramatic tension of "Dogville". Therefore, this film was a turning point in his directorial career.

共产剧本 | 尿
当我颤颤巍巍地从地面上站起的那一刻，戏，也正式开始了。那会儿，我控制失能，经常尿裤子，于是他们为我戴上了纸尿布，要是纸尿布湿了，我总是会哇哇大哭，但是我分明看见他们为我更换纸尿布时，笑容满面，安详慈祥。长大以后，他们也总是会笑我尿裤子，说，你又尿裤子啦？由此，我以为尿裤子是一件好事，所以这一尿，就尿到了懂事以
当我颤颤巍巍地从地面上站起的那一刻，戏，也正式开始了。那会儿，我控制失能，经常尿裤子，于是他们为我戴上了纸尿布，要是纸尿布湿了，我总是会哇哇大哭，但是我分明看见他们为我更换纸尿布时，笑容满面，安详慈祥。长大以后，他们也总是会笑我尿裤子，说，你又尿裤子啦？由此，我以为尿裤子是一件好事，所以这一尿，就尿到了懂事以后。那年我六岁，终于从家里人的眼中见识到了嫌弃，起初，这个嫌弃并不明确，像是藏在迷雾里的字，难以识别。后来，他们极其严肃地告诉我，你不能再尿裤子了，否则要惩罚你，打屁股。我愣住了，我实在不能理解，既然如此，那么当初何必笑呢？只可惜，从来都是放纵的肌肉哪里是说控制就能控制的，于是，尿，从此，也成了最恐怖的噩梦。
记得在幼儿园时，每当我面露难色，老师都会放我去洗手间。我脱下鞋子袜子裤子，清洗弄湿的腿脚，穿上书包里取出的备用裤子，再将尿脏了的裤子装进塑封袋，回到教室后，把椅子擦干净，还要面对同学们捏住鼻子的冷嘲热讽，百般嫌弃。这便是我童年所经历的日常。
尿骚味仿佛藤蔓在我的成长路程里不断地束缚着我，我无论跑到天涯海角，它都会跟到天涯海角，我无法呼吸，不能习惯，因在清洗过后闻见过干净，有了对比，恶臭就是恶臭，无可争议，哪怕十年以后，二十年以后，照样如此。事实证明，也确实如此。在我三十六岁那年，周遭的人孩子都开始写小说了，我却依然独善其身。我渴望陪伴，可每当有人要深入了解我时，我会不由自主地感到一阵自卑，逃离，回避，东躲西藏，他们在剥离我的躯壳后，看见布满了尿黄色的世界时，绝对会马上将我抛弃。
别以为你们能抛弃老子，老子首先把你们抛弃啦！我自我欺骗。说起大雨，我最喜欢大雨了，在大雨的冲刷下，我终于能扔走尿袋，轻松一把了，自由的尿就顺着雨落下，在这之后，将不会有一丝一毫的气味。我向天张开嘴巴要喝雨，我要喝很多很多的雨，再尿很多很多的雨。我在大雨中翩翩起舞，幸福快乐，要是人们从远处看我，一定以为我中了彩票，但他们不知的是，我在尿尿，在大庭广众之下，我在尿尿，正如我在呼吸，我在眨眼睛，我的五脏六腑在各司其职。我无需为我控制不住的事情而羞愧。上帝啊，就让这大雨永不停止地落下，冲刷到我身上的冷眼与尿骚味。那些尿渗透进我的皮肤，渗透进我的骨头，渗透进我的灵魂，将我反复拷打，我实在是厌倦了在这种处境中生存。在我精疲力尽，返回家后，尿已经没了，一干二净，我能感受得到。床单是新铺的，我整个人扑上去，盖上被子。过了片刻，被子里是暖洋洋的，外头雨声淅沥，雷声轰轰，我感到有一些闷热，将双臂伸到枕头的两边，那里是凉的。要是每天如此，该有多好。
可惜没有如果。要不怎么说这是噩梦呢？清醒后，我依旧尿了一床。幸福总是短暂的。我将床单抽出来，底下的那张塑料防水垫子似乎有些破损，尿就顺着破损处渗进了床垫。我要找我买的自动清洗泡沫给它清洗及除味，但是死活寻不见。于是，我哭了，我不争气地哭了，我上面在哭着，底下就在失控地尿尿，其实应该已经没有尿了，但是我每次哭泣，这一抽一抽的，就难免会挤出一两滴出来。去他的尿袋，去他的免洗泡沫，去他的生活。
我要自杀，我如此打定注意。耶稣也留不住我，我说的。却没想到，耶稣似乎也早就知晓这件事，让我遇见了......
未完待续......
"共产剧本"是一个富有创新性的项目，它不仅是一个剧本，更是一个集结众人想象力与创作才能的开放平台。它的核心在于持续创作，鼓励参与者们接续写下他们心中的故事，让它向未知的领域探索延伸。这个项目的魅力在于，无论是一部详尽的史诗，还是一个简单的短篇，都可以被接纳和欣赏。它不设限，不拘泥于固定的情节或结局，而是让每一位创作者自由地发挥他们的想象力和创意。这种多元化的创作方式，让每一个故事都有无尽的可能性。共产剧本的另一个特点是其社区性质。创作者们共同参与，使得剧本像是一个有机体，不断生长、变化。每个人都在为这个共同的项目贡献力量，每个人的创作都会成为整个作品的一部分。这种协同创作的方式，让剧本充满了活力和变化。总的来说，"共产剧本"是一个激发创造力、汇聚众人智慧的场所。它鼓励我们挑战传统的故事叙述方式，打破固定的思维模式，让我们的想象力和创新精神得以充分发挥。通过持续创作，我们可以将故事推向更远、更未知的领域，揭示出生活的无限可能性和多样性。

P4 Theater

Project and brand narrative
Communist Script | Urine
Unfortunately there is no if. How else could I say this was a nightmare?
The moment I stood up tremblingly from the ground, the play officially began. At that time, I lost control and often wet my pants, so they put on diapers for me. If the diapers got wet, I would always cry, but I could clearly see them smiling, peaceful and kindly when they changed my diapers. When I grew up, they would always laugh at me for peeing my pants and say, "Did you pee your pants again?" From this, I thought that peeing my pants was a good thing, so I peeed until I became sensible. I was six years old that year, and I finally saw the disgust in the eyes of my family. At first, this disgust was not clear, like words hidden in the fog, difficult to identify. Later, they told me very seriously that you can't pee your pants again, otherwise you will be punished and spanked. I was stunned. I really couldn't understand. If this was the case, why did I laugh in the first place? It's a pity that the muscles that have always been indulged cannot be controlled, so peeing has become the most terrifying nightmare since then.
I remember in kindergarten, whenever I looked embarrassed, the teacher would let me go to the bathroom. I took off my shoes, socks and pants, washed my wet legs and feet, put on the spare pants I took out of my schoolbag, and put the urine-stained pants into a plastic bag. After returning to the classroom, I wiped the chair clean, and faced the cynicism and sarcasm of my classmates who pinched their noses and expressed disgust in every possible way. This is what I experienced as a child.
The smell of urine is like a vine constantly restraining me as I grow up. No matter where I go to the end of the world, it will follow me to the end of the world. I can't breathe and can't get used to it, because I have smelled it clean after cleaning. With comparison, the stench is the stench. There is no dispute. Even ten or twenty years later, it will still be the same. Facts have proved that this is indeed the case. When I was thirty-six years old, everyone around me was starting to write novels, but I was still alone. I long for companionship, but whenever someone wants to get to know me deeply, I can't help but feel inferior, run away, avoid, and hide. After they peel off my body and see a world full of urine yellow, they will definitely abandon me immediately.
Don't think you can abandon me, I abandoned you first! I deceive myself. Speaking of heavy rain, I like heavy rain the most. Under the wash of the heavy rain, I can finally throw away the urine bag and relax. The free urine falls along the rain. After that, there will be no smell at all. I open my mouth to the sky to drink the rain. I want to drink lots and lots of rain, and then pee lots and lots of rain. I danced happily in the heavy rain. If people looked at me from a distance, they would think I had won the lottery. But what they didn't know was that I was peeing. In public, I was peeing, just like I was breathing, blinking, and my internal organs were performing their duties. I don't need to be ashamed of things I can't control. God, let this heavy rain never stop falling, washing away the cold eyes and the smell of urine on my body. The urine seeped into my skin, into my bones, into my soul, and tortured me over and over again. I was really tired of living in this situation. After I returned home, exhausted, the pee was gone. It was clean and I could feel it. The sheets were newly laid, so I threw myself on them and covered myself with the quilt. After a while, it was warm under the quilt. The rain was pattering outside and the thunder was booming. I felt a little stuffy. I stretched my arms to both sides of the pillow. It was cool there. It would be great if this happened every day.
Unfortunately there is no if. How else could I say this was a nightmare? After waking up, I still wet the bed. Happiness is always short-lived. I pulled out the sheet, and the plastic waterproof mat underneath seemed to be somewhat damaged, and the urine seeped into the mattress along the damaged areas. I'm looking for the self-cleaning foam I bought to clean and deodorize it, but I can't find it. So, I cried, I cried unsatisfactorily. I was crying above me, but I was peeing uncontrollably below. In fact, I should have stopped peeing, but every time I cried and pumped, one or two drops would inevitably come out. Fuck the diaper bag, screw the no-rinse foam, screw your life.
I'm going to kill myself, I'm so determined to pay attention. Jesus cannot keep me, I say. But I didn't expect that Jesus seemed to have known about this for a long time and allowed me to meet...
To be continued…
"Communist Script" is an innovative project. It is not only a script, but also an open platform that gathers everyone's imagination and creative talents. Its core lies in continuous creation, encouraging participants to continue writing the stories in their hearts and allowing them to explore and extend into unknown areas. The charm of this project is that whether it is a detailed epic or a simple short story, it can be accepted and appreciated. It does not set limits and does not stick to a fixed plot or ending, but allows every creator to freely use their imagination and creativity. This diversified creative approach gives every story endless possibilities. Another characteristic of the communist script was its communal nature. The joint participation of the creators makes the script like an organism, constantly growing and changing. Everyone is contributing to this common project, and everyone's creations become part of the overall work. This collaborative creation method makes the script full of vitality and change. In general, "Communist Script" is a place that stimulates creativity and brings together the wisdom of everyone. It encourages us to challenge traditional storytelling, break out of fixed thinking patterns, and allow our imagination and innovative spirit to flourish. By continuing to create, we can push our stories further and further into unknown territories, revealing the infinite possibilities and diversity of life.
