sources.text:
p4剧场和你
2023-09-13
争议与宣言
第 六 病 室
第六病室倒置一幅描绘疆域的长卷山峰填满谷底谎言背面找不到原罪只有平庸的开幕式和下一个谎言他们说坚持到下一个阴
第六病室
倒置一幅描绘疆域的长卷
山峰填满谷底
谎言背面找不到原罪
只有平庸的开幕式和下一个谎言
他们说坚持到下一个阴雨天
爱做梦的囚徒将呈上万物有灵的证据
但我不为所动
我宁愿浸没在历经劫火的口头文学
宁愿把自己锁在被处决的地主的后院
他们马上就要宣布
唯顺服者才配吃饭
我会不假思索地绝粒
可是妈妈，别为我哭泣
这并不意味着坐以待毙
请期待我更好的台词和歌词
因为，我还不会死
并非我先于明世宗或始皇帝
洞彻了从毛孔向宇宙射线
汲取能量的奥秘
借此摆脱了困在冰层下的白鲸的噩运：
为了二十分钟一次浮出水面换气
殒身于北方领主无朋的口器
我不低头，也不畏惧
狂云勾勒出的青灰色的鬼脸
和妇人般的手指在紫檀桌案上的轻弹
只怪我瞥见了谜底
世袭的肥硕不容置疑
而一旦打败了
人必须依赖食物存活的成见
你我皆得以退出这种游戏
诗人简介
陈渐离：
写诗的原动力几经压抑和审视，趋于不可阻止。它受到古圣先贤的召唤，如今它开始准备召唤。它被戏剧点燃又点燃了戏剧。它与影像反复较量然后一起奔赴自由。它为唤醒语言而向语言绽放并消融语言的坚冰。
是的，写诗。
编辑的话
当饥饿不再成为凌虐的酷刑、当不再受肠胃驱使为了生存弯腰乞食，我得以逃离领主为驯服者圈定的戒律、我得以摆脱沦为刀俎鱼肉的命定。
只怪我早已窥悉了谜底、和编织原罪的荒谬，只怪我早已见识过万物颠覆、和谎言的真实面目。
肥硕不过是世袭者的丑陋，紧贴肋骨的皮肉方可显露我勇于绝粒的气魄。
屏住呼吸、关闭味觉，我在五感尽失的空洞中也不感寂寞：只因文字和词句早已在脑海中幻化成形伴我左右、只因我从不渴求羽化成仙的灵丹妙药。我接受生命以内给予我有限的狭隘，摒弃本我以外一切桎梏的妨碍。
与死亡深渊的对视只会令我更加大胆——头顶的狂云他愈是肆虐、我所执的笔他愈是狂野。
妈妈，请别为我哭泣。若我自缚着双腿跪地，那绝不是坐以待毙。我会以笔作剑向胸口刺去，以我血向大厦将倾献祭。
同时，我们也提供该诗的翻译英语、德语、法语与西语版本，并在翻译过程中最大限度保持诗歌原有的风格与韵律。
读者在阅读时，也可感受该诗在不同语言语境下的独特与共通之处。
English Version
In the Sixth Ward
A scroll of borders turned upon its head,
Where mountains fill the valleys deep and wide,
Behind the lies, no original sin reside,
But banal openings and the lies ahead.
They say to hold until the next rain's slide,
Dream-prisoners will present the proof they've bred,
Yet I remain unmoved by what they've said,
I'd rather sink in spoken tales of pride.
Soon they'll declare that only those who heed,
Deserve their share of daily bread to feed.
Without a thought, I'd fast and deny the bite,
But mother dear, please shed no tear tonight,
For I'm not ready to admit defeat,
My words and songs, they're yet to reach their peak.
For I'm not destined to meet the end,
Not before emperors or ancient men,
I've glimpsed the secret of cosmic array,
Not doomed like whales beneath ice layer's sway.
I won't bow down, nor will I live in fear,
Of clouds that sketch grim faces oh so clear,
Nor of the lady fingers' tapping sound,
Upon the rosewood desk, where truth is bound.
For once we conquer man's innate need to dine,
You and I, from this game, may both resign.
from: Henri Matisse
Deutshce Version
Das sechste Krankenzimmer
Ein umgedrehtes Gemälde der Grenzen zeigt,
Wo Berge das Tal ausfüllen,
Auf der Rückseite der Lüge findet man keine Erbsünde,
Nur eine triviale Eröffnung und die nächste Lüge.
Sie sagen, halte durch bis zum nächsten Regentag,
Der traumliebende Gefangene wird Beweise für den Geist in allem präsentieren.
Doch ich bin nicht bewegt, ich ertrinke lieber in mündlicher Literatur, die durch Feuer ging,
Bevorzuge mich selbst, im Hinterhof des exekutierten Landbesitzers einzusperren.
Bald werden sie verkünden,
Nur die Gehorsamen sollen essen.
Ohne zu überlegen werde ich mich enthalten,
Aber Mutter, weine nicht für mich,
Das bedeutet nicht, passiv zu sein,
Erwarte bessere Verse und Lyrics von mir,
Denn ich werde nicht sterben.
Nicht weil ich vor Ming Shizong oder dem ersten Kaiser
Das Geheimnis erkannt habe, Energie aus Poren in kosmische Strahlen zu ziehen.
Damit dem Schicksal des weißen Wals unter dem Eis entfliehend:
Nur um alle zwanzig Minuten aufzutauchen, um Luft zu holen,
Sterbend im Maul des nördlichen Herrn ohne Freunde.
Ich werde nicht nachgeben, ich werde nicht zittern,
Vor dem grau-blauen Gesicht, das durch wilde Wolken gezeichnet wird,
Oder dem Frauengleichem Finger, der leicht auf dem Rosenholz-Tisch tippt.
Nur weil ich die Antwort erblickte,
Das Erbe der Fülle ist unbestreitbar.
Und wenn man das Vorurteil besiegt, dass Menschen essen müssen, um zu überleben,
Können wir beide dieses Spiel verlassen.
from: Henri Matisse
Version française
La sixième infirmerie
Un rouleau dépeignant des territoires inversés,
Où les sommets comblent les vallées profondes.
Derrière les mensonges, nul péché original n'est trouvé,
Seulement des débuts médiocres et un autre mensonge en seconde.
Ils disent d'attendre le prochain jour de pluie,
Le prisonnier rêveur montrera que tout est vivant.
Mais je ne suis pas ému, je préfère m'immerger dans la poésie,
Préférant être enfermé dans le jardin d'un propriétaire condamné.
Bientôt, ils proclameront à haute voix,
Seuls les soumis méritent leur ration.
Sans hésiter, je refuserai leur loi,
Mais mère, ne pleure pas en cette occasion.
Cela ne signifie pas l'abandon,
Attends mes meilleures paroles et chansons.
Car je ne mourrai pas si tôt,
Pas avant les empereurs d'il y a longtemps, dont j'ai vu le tableau.
Découvrant le secret d'énergies extraites des pores,
Échappant au destin de la baleine sous la glace.
Je ne baisserai pas les yeux, j'aurai encore,
Face aux nuages furieux, et le tapotement délicat d'une femme sur la table de palissandre.
Hélas, j'ai vu la réponse au bout,
L'opulence héréditaire est indiscutable.
Mais une fois que l'idée de manger pour vivre est renversée,
Nous pourrions tous quitter ce jeu détestable.
from: Henri Matisse
Versión española
La sexta habitación del hospital
Un pergamino que retrata territorios invertidos,
Montañas llenan valles profundos.
Detrás de la mentira, no hallarás pecado original,
Sólo aperturas mediocres y otra mentira esencial.
Me dicen que aguante hasta la próxima lluvia que vendrá,
El prisionero soñador ofrecerá prueba de un mundo espiritual.
Pero no me conmueve, prefiero sumergirme en literatura oral,
Prefiero encerrarme en el jardín del terrateniente que se va a ejecutar.
Pronto dirán que sólo los obedientes merecen cenar,
Sin pensarlo dos veces, rechazaría ese manjar.
Pero madre, no derrames lágrimas por mí,
No significa que me rendiré tan fácilmente aquí.
Espera mejores líneas y canciones de mí,
Porque no moriré, eso ya lo decidí.
No es que haya descifrado antes que Ming o el emperador,
El secreto de tomar energía del cosmos con fervor.
Evitando el destino del cachalote atrapado debajo del hielo,
Por un respiro, caer en la boca del señor del cielo norteño.
No me inclino, ni temo
A las caras esbozadas por nubes, ni al dedo que resuena lento.
Quizás porque vislumbré la respuesta, lo confieso,
La opulencia heredada es un hecho que no cuestiono.
Y una vez que superamos la idea de depender de comida para existir,
Podemos dejar este juego, y finalmente desistir.
from: Henri Matisse

510放映——我是古巴简介
一场诗意流动的盛宴。片子是古巴革命政权成立并完成“社会改造”之初（1964年）由苏联导演米哈依尔·卡拉托佐夫
一场诗意流动的盛宴。
片子是古巴革命政权成立并完成“社会改造”之初（1964年）由苏联导演米哈依尔·卡拉托佐夫操刀，是苏古两国的一篇政治蜜月宣言。在冷战中作为共产阵营的意识形态输出产品被西方国家封杀。冷战结束后《我是古巴》在西方一批颇有眼力的电影人的努力下重见天日。
卡拉托佐夫在《我是古巴》中讲述了四个情节上并不相互关联的故事，运用顶级的视觉艺术和无与伦比的长镜头，展现巴蒂斯塔独裁政权下古巴的社会现实和反抗的革命风潮。我是古巴的四个故事长短不一，各自具有本身的情感高潮，同时又表达着顺序相关，逐步递进的四个主题“忍受、自戕、警醒、崛起”，也是爱情、生活、自由和革命，每章都匠心独运地使用着大量的电影符号和语言。难怪弗朗西斯·福特 科波拉和马丁·西塞克斯在2002年看到这部上个世纪的电影时，禁不住高呼，这是一部近十年来最伟大的电影。对于卡拉托佐夫而言，在情感逻辑和政治逻辑的指导下，这样四个环环相扣的故事正是他表达他对于古巴现实批判和美好明天的憧憬的最好方式。
“为了你，我是赌场，我是酒吧，我是酒店，我是妓院，但是这些幼童和老妪伸出的乞讨的双手，那也是我，我是古巴。”

510 screening - Introduction to I am Cuba
A poetic and moving feast. The film was produced by Soviet director Mikhail Kalatozov at the beginning of the establishment of the Cuban revolutionary...
A poetic and moving feast.
The film was directed by Soviet director Mikhail Kalatozov at the beginning of the establishment of the Cuban revolutionary regime and the completion of "social transformation" (1964). It is a political honeymoon declaration between the Soviet Union and Cuba. During the Cold War, as an ideological output product of the communist camp, it was banned by Western countries. After the end of the Cold War, "I Am Cuba" was revived through the efforts of a group of discerning filmmakers in the West.
In "I Am Cuba", Kalatozov tells four stories that are not interconnected in terms of plot, using top-notch visual art and unparalleled long shots to show the social reality and revolutionary trend of resistance in Cuba under the Batista dictatorship. The four stories of I am Cuba are of different lengths. Each has its own emotional climax, and at the same time expresses the four sequentially related and progressive themes of "endurance, suicide, vigilance, and rise", which are also love, life, freedom, and revolution. Each chapter uses a large number of movie symbols and language ingeniously. It's no wonder that when Francis Ford Coppola and Martin Sissex saw this film of the last century in 2002, they couldn't help but shout that this was the greatest film of the past decade. For Kalatozov, under the guidance of emotional logic and political logic, such four interlocking stories are the best way for him to express his criticism of Cuba's reality and his vision for a better tomorrow.
"For you, I am a casino, I am a bar, I am a hotel, I am a brothel, but the begging hands stretched out by these young children and old women are also me, I am Cuba."

Ward Six

Ward Six
Turn upside down a long scroll depicting territory
Mountain peaks fill valley bottoms
No original sin can be found behind lies
Just a mediocre opening and the next lie
They say hold on until the next rainy day
The dreaming prisoner will present evidence of animism
But I'm unmoved
I'd rather be immersed in oral literature that has endured fire
Rather lock yourself in the backyard of an executed landowner
They're going to announce it soon
Only those who obey are worthy of eating
I will die without thinking
But mother, don't cry for me
This doesn't mean sitting back and waiting for death
Please look forward to my better lines and lyrics
Because I won't die yet
It's not that I precede Ming Shizong or the First Emperor
From pores to cosmic rays
The secret of gaining energy
This way, he got rid of the bad luck of the beluga whale trapped under the ice
To surface for air every twenty minutes
Killed by the mouth of the northern lord Wu Peng
I don't bow my head, nor am I afraid
The blue-grey grimace outlined by the wild clouds
The gentle flick of womanly fingers on the rosewood table
It's just that I caught a glimpse of the answer
Hereditary fatness is unquestionable
And once defeated
The stereotype that people must rely on food to survive
You and I can quit this game
Introduction to the poet
Chen Jianli
The driving force for writing poetry has been suppressed and scrutinized several times, and it becomes unstoppable. It was summoned by the ancient saints and sages, and now it begins to prepare for the summons. It is ignited by drama and ignites drama. It battles with the image over and over again and then rushes to freedom together. It blooms into language and melts its ice in order to awaken it.
Yes, write poetry.
Editor's Note
When hunger no longer becomes a torture of abuse, and when I am no longer driven by my stomach to bend down and beg for food in order to survive, I can escape from the commandments set by the lord for the tamer, and I can escape the fate of being reduced to a knife and a fish.
It's just that I've already seen the answer to the riddle and the absurdity of weaving original sin. It's just that I've already seen the subversion of all things and the true face of lies.
Being fat is just hereditary ugliness. Only the flesh that clings to my ribs can reveal my bravery.
Holding my breath and closing my sense of taste, I don't feel lonely even in the void where all five senses have been lost: just because the words and phrases have already been transformed in my mind and are with me, just because I never long for the panacea that will transform me into an immortal. I accept the limited narrowness given to me in life and abandon all shackles outside of myself.
Staring into the abyss of death only makes me bolder - the more raging the clouds above my head become, the wilder the pen I write becomes more wild.
Mom, please don't cry for me. If I tie my legs and kneel down, I will never sit back and wait for death. I will use my pen as a sword to stab my chest, and use my blood as a sacrifice to the generals of the building.
At the same time, we also provide translated English, German, French and Spanish versions of the poem, and maintain the original style and rhythm of the poem to the greatest extent during the translation process.
When reading, readers can also feel the uniqueness and commonality of the poem in different language contexts.

Yet I remain unmoved by what they've said
I'd rather sink in spoken tales of pride.
Soon they'll declare that only those who heed
Deserve their share of daily bread to feed.
Without a thought, I'd fast and deny the bite
But mother dear, please shed no tear tonight
For I'm not ready to admit defeat
My words and songs, they're yet to reach their peak.
For I'm not destined to meet the end
Not before emperors or ancient men
I've glimpsed the secret of cosmic array
Not doomed like whales beneath ice layer's sway.
I won't bow down, nor will I live in fear
Of clouds that sketch grim faces oh so clear
Nor of the lady fingers' tapping sound
Upon the rosewood desk, where truth is bound.
For once we conquer man's innate need to dine
You and I, from this game, may both resign.
from: Henri Matisse
Deutshce Version
Das sechste Krankenzimmer
Ein umgedrehtes Gemälde der Grenzen zeigt
Wo Berge das Tal ausfüllen
Auf der Rückseite der Lüge findet man keine Erbsünde
Nur eine triviale Eröffnung und die nächste Lüge.
Sie sagen, halte durch bis zum nächsten Regentag
Der traumliebende Gefangene wird Beweise für den Geist in allem präsentieren.
Doch ich bin nicht bewegt, ich ertrinke lieber in mündlicher Literatur, die durch Feuer ging
Bevorzuge mich selbst, im Hinterhof des exekutierten Landbesitzers einzusperren.
Bald werden sie verkünden
Nur die Gehorsamen sollen essen.
Ohne zu überlegen werde ich mich enthalten
Aber Mutter, weine nicht für mich
Das bedeutet nicht, passiv zu sein
Erwarte bessere Verse und Lyrics von mir
Denn ich werde nicht sterben.
Nicht weil ich vor Ming Shizong oder dem ersten Kaiser
Das Geheimnis erkannt habe, Energie aus Poren in kosmische Strahlen zu ziehen.
Damit dem Schicksal des weißen Wals unter dem Eis entfliehend
Nur um alle zwanzig Minuten aufzutauchen, um Luft zu holen
Sterbend im Maul des nördlichen Herrn ohne Freunde.
Ich werde nicht nachgeben, ich werde nicht zittern
Vor dem grau-blauen Gesicht, das durch wilde Wolken gezeichnet wird
Oder dem Frauengleichem Finger, der leicht auf dem Rosenholz-Tisch tippt.
Nur weil ich die Antwort erblickte
Das Erbe der Fülle ist unbestreitbar.
Und wenn man das Vorurteil besiegt, dass Menschen essen müssen, um zu überleben
Können wir beide dieses Spiel verlassen.
from: Henri Matisse
Version française
La sixième infirmerie
Un rouleau dépeignant des territoires inversés
Où les sommets comblent les vallées profondes.
Derrière les mensonges, nul péché original n'est trouvé
Seulement des débuts médiocres et un autre mensonge en seconde.
Ils disent d'attendre le prochain jour de pluie
Le prisonnier rêveur montrera que tout est vivant.
Mais je ne suis pas ému, je préfère m'immerger dans la poésie
Préférant être enfermé dans le jardin d'un propriétaire condamné.
Bientôt, ils proclameront à haute voix
Seuls les soumis méritent leur ration.
Sans hésiter, je refuserai leur loi
Mais mère, ne pleure pas en cette occasion.
Cela ne signifie pas l'abandon
Attends mes meilleures paroles et chansons.
Car je ne mourrai pas si tôt
Pas avant les empereurs d'il y a longtemps, dont j'ai vu le tableau.
Découvrant le secret d'énergies extraites des pores
Échappant au destin de la baleine sous la glace.
Je ne baisserai pas les yeux, j'aurai encore
Face aux nuages furieux, et le tapotement délicat d'une femme sur la table de palissandre.
Hélas, j'ai vu la réponse au bout
L'opulence héréditaire est indiscutable.
Mais une fois que l'idée de manger pour vivre est renversée
Nous pourrions tous quitter ce jeu détestable.
from: Henri Matisse
Versión española
La sexta habitación del hospital
Un pergamino que retrata territorios invertidos
Montañas llenan valles profundos.
Detrás de la mentira, no hallarás pecado original
Sólo aperturas mediocres y otra mentira esencial.
Me dicen que aguante hasta la próxima lluvia que vendrá
El prisionero soñador ofrecerá prueba de un mundo espiritual.
Pero no me conmueve, prefiero sumergirme en literatura oral
Prefiero encerrarme en el jardín del terrateniente que se va a ejecutar.
Pronto dirán que sólo los obedientes merecen cenar
Sin pensarlo dos veces, rechazaría ese manjar.
Pero madre, no derrames lágrimas por mí
No significa que me rendiré tan fácilmente aquí.
Espera mejores líneas y canciones de mí
Porque no moriré, eso ya lo decidí.
No es que haya descifrado antes que Ming o el emperador
El secreto de tomar energía del cosmos con fervor.
Evitando el destino del cachalote atrapado debajo del hielo
Por un respiro, caer en la boca del señor del cielo norteño.
No me inclino, ni temo
A las caras esbozadas por nubes, ni al dedo que resuena lento.
Quizás porque vislumbré la respuesta, lo confieso
La opulencia heredada es un hecho que no cuestiono.
Y una vez que superamos la idea de depender de comida para existir
Podemos dejar este juego, y finalmente desistir.
from: Henri Matisse

一些关于新桥恋人的思考
关于新桥“新桥”位于1989－91年间关闭大修的巴黎最古老的一座桥上，故事的大部分场景都设置在桥的北段：一面
关于新桥
“新桥”位于1989－91年间关闭大修的巴黎最古老的一座桥上，故事的大部分场景都设置在桥的北段：一面闪烁着Samaritaine百货大楼不眠的霓虹，远处是卢浮宫巍峨的剪影；一面响荡着圣母院的钟声，凝重的司法建筑群无言矗立，但在烟花的闪耀下仿佛也绽放出激情。
位置的设立使得新桥充满隐喻意味，我们的爱和欲望受到权力的塑造和限制、历史的制约和现实的影响，但存在又将重新生成新的关系。你们想要一个主人，你们会有的。在挣脱着旧有的权力制约，终于又来到新桥上时，我们又当如何存在？
婴儿与洗澡水
国家机器的修补力量通过镜头语言得到清晰的表达。破坏的裂痕与社会的修补通过影片中的列兵场景展现出来，个人意志也在这种强大的压迫力量中痛苦窒息。他们对抗这种秩序性的压迫的方式，就是沉入酒精忘却现实，以一种酒神狂欢的方式进入悲剧的迷狂，突破作为无法修补者的“社会边缘漂浮的碎片”的权力体系定位。
个人通过保护肉体与精神的“裂痕”与国家修补术对抗，某种意义上说是一种自残、自伤的行为。因而“拼贴图”的主角必然是反英雄的形象：他们的对抗方式是非组织、非暴力的，与“国家力量”的庞大压迫相比，他们渺小、脆弱。只有在对自己立场的坚持里，体现出一种孤独的不妥协，一种真正的英雄气质。
五月风暴的反思，正指向革命的局限性，想象力的局限性，和爱欲的局限性。因此，一个不可回避的困境是，在意识形态的象征因素被充分意识并彻底摒弃后，乌托邦也相应成为一片废墟。卡拉克斯给爱情设置了一个不可能的预设，这个极为大胆的预设成为悬置的不停拷问那建立在一定物质基础上的爱情观念：物质上一无所有，精神的符号秩序也被抽离，爱情还可能吗？
我想
爱情从未存在
没有可能
只有实在
在新桥上
我们只能纵身一跃
在可能性之外 漂流
像一个流产的婴儿

Stand-up comedy Stand-up comedy Stand-up comedy
脱口秀畅聊会
每一个故事都值得被诉说
每一段经历都值得被记录
每一种情绪都值得被倾听
周三丨畅聊脱口秀
这个世界的声音过于喧嚣，我们内心的呐喊总是轻易被淹没。每一种声音都值得被听见，每一种声音都应该被听到。每一个人都值得被看见，每一个人都应该被看到。
We re not doing that.
这不是一次传统的脱口秀演出，甚至不是一场演出。这是一场沟通，是与到场参与者的沟通，也是与这个世界的沟通。活动没有演员，每个参与者都是演员；活动没有观众，每个参与者也都是观众。这里只有最真实的故事、最真实的情绪和最真实的反馈。这里只有最真诚的分享者和最真诚的倾听者。
来参加此次活动的朋友不需要有任何脱口秀技巧，无需准备稿子，只要有分享欲或发泄欲即可。你可以来分享有趣的或开心的，也可以来分享愤怒的或头疼的，凡是你愿意分享的都可以分享。
希望那天场域的所有人，能够发生思想的碰撞并激发产生一些有趣的东西。
让我们一起来发现和吐槽这个世界和社会的荒诞可笑之处吧~

Recruitment and conversion
Some thoughts about New Bridge Lovers
About the Pont Neuf "The Pont Neuf" is located on the oldest bridge in Paris that was closed for overhaul from 1989 to 1991. Most of the scenes in the...
About Xinqiao
The "New Bridge" is located on the oldest bridge in Paris that was closed for major renovations from 1989 to 1991. Most of the scenes in the story are set in the northern section of the bridge: one side is flashing with the sleepless neon of the Samaritaine department store, and the towering silhouette of the Louvre is in the distance; the other side is ringing with the bells of Notre Dame, and the dignified judicial buildings stand silently, but they seem to be blooming with passion under the sparkle of fireworks.
The establishment of the location makes the new bridge full of metaphorical meaning. Our love and desire are shaped and restricted by power, historical constraints and reality, but existence will regenerate new relationships. You want a master and you will have it. How should we exist when we break away from the old constraints of power and finally come to the new bridge?
Baby and bathwater
The mending power of the state apparatus is clearly expressed through the language of the camera. The cracks of destruction and the repair of society are shown through the private scenes in the film, and personal will is also painfully suffocated by this powerful oppressive force. Their way of resisting this orderly oppression is to indulge in alcohol and forget about reality, enter the tragic ecstasy in a Dionysian way, and break through the position of the power system as "fragments floating on the edge of society" that cannot be repaired.
Individuals fight against the state's patchwork by protecting the "cracks" between body and spirit. In a sense, this is an act of self-mutilation and self-injury. Therefore, the protagonists of the "collage" must be anti-heroes: their method of confrontation is non-organized and non-violent, and they are small and fragile compared with the huge oppression of "state power". Only in insisting on one's own position does one show a kind of lonely uncompromisingness and a true heroic temperament.
Reflections on the May Storm point to the limitations of revolution, imagination, and love. Therefore, an unavoidable dilemma is that after the symbolic elements of ideology are fully realized and completely abandoned, Utopia also becomes a ruin. Carax sets an impossible presupposition for love. This extremely bold presupposition becomes a suspended interrogation of the concept of love based on a certain material basis: when there is nothing materially, and the spiritual symbolic order has been abstracted, is love still possible?
I want
love never existed
no possibility
only reality
on the new bridge
We can only jump
Drifting beyond possibility
like a miscarried baby

P4 Theater and You
2023-09-09
Recruitment and conversion
Wednesday Talk Show | Talk Show Chat Club Recruitment
Talk show, let's talk about life, talk about life, use words to release our energy
Stand-up comedy Stand-up comedy Stand-up comedy
Talk show chat session
Every story deserves to be told
Every experience is worth recording
Every emotion deserves to be heard
Wednesday | Talk show
The world is so noisy that our inner cries are easily drowned out. Every voice deserves to be heard, every voice deserves to be heard. Everyone deserves to be seen, everyone deserves to be seen.
We re not doing that.
This is not a traditional stand-up gig, or even a show. This is a communication, a communication with the participants present, and a communication with the world. There are no actors in the activity, and every participant is an actor; there is no audience in the activity, and every participant is also an audience. There are only the truest stories, the truest emotions, and the truest feedback. There are only the most sincere sharers and the most sincere listeners here.
Friends who come to participate in this event do not need to have any talk show skills or prepare scripts, as long as they have the desire to share or vent. You can share what is interesting or happy, you can share what is angry or a headache, whatever you want to share can be shared.
I hope that everyone in the field that day can have a collision of ideas and inspire something interesting.
Let us discover and complain about the absurdity of this world and society~

周二读书会｜《神话修辞术》罗兰·巴特，读书小组组员招募
《神话修辞术》一书的章节之间相互之间可以说是较为独立，因此，本次读书会上，来参与的每一个人都会主动选取或随机抽取一个小节，与其它成员共同阅读，在任意小节阅读结束后，有相关联想、启发和驱动实践的方法论总结，都可以随时分享给其他人。最后，我们希望那天场域里的所有人，能一起创造出点有趣的东西。
《神话修辞术》一书的章节之间相互之间可以说是较为独立，因此，本次读书会上，来参与的每一个人都会主动选取或随机抽取一个小节，与其它成员共同阅读，在任意小节阅读结束后，有相关联想、启发和驱动实践的方法论总结，都可以随时分享给其他人。最后，我们希望那天场域里的所有人，能一起创造出点有趣的东西。
我们想说的：
罗兰巴特把神话看为一种修辞，一种描述世界的方式，并努力揭露神话这一修辞方式对人类的遮蔽。我们想要以神话制造者的身份观看神话的解读，在清醒过后，主动的陷入“自然”和“人造历史”的混杂状态，构建自我的神话叙事体系。
《神话修辞术》简介（来源豆瓣）：
“神话学家”罗兰·巴特在《神话修辞术》中破译了日常生活中的各种神话，探索将真实与人类、描述与阐释、对象与知识的重新和解。他试图向读者表达，我们不断地在对象与破除其神秘性之间航行，没有能力恢复全貌：因为，如果我们进入到对象之中，解放了它，但却摧毁了它；如果我们放任不管，我们尊重了它，但却又使其神秘化。

2023-09-08
理论与方法
我 俩
我俩请再想想，仔细想我俩应该不止是朋友你若用友谊去掂量那些日子不如索性彼此相忘不如把掌纹镌刻在流沙上自从上一
我俩
请再想想，仔细想
我俩应该不止是朋友
你若用友谊去掂量那些日子
不如索性彼此相忘
不如把掌纹镌刻在流沙上
自从上一次遍野金子般炫目的油菜花
绽放
造反的犬类瞳孔胀的血红
自从上一次长夜被警笛深深地刺痛
我俩一直笨拙地掩饰那场遭逢
你确信我必严守你埋在银杏树下的秘密
尽管任何妇人所生者皆无法杀死你
但用不着强调虚无历来是你
石版画的母题
我的指关节因负重而变形
紫藤、青蛇和我的发辫
紧紧地纠缠在一起
小心，别弄脏了你的法衣
每值七月既望
你喜欢在不平静的水面泛舟
放肆地赞美月亮
而我情愿指点着前方
麻木不仁的建筑物：
闪开，别挡住我俩的月光
from: Marc Chagall
诗人简介
陈渐离：
写诗的原动力几经压抑和审视，趋于不可阻止。它受到古圣先贤的召唤，如今它开始准备召唤。它被戏剧点燃又点燃了戏剧。它与影像反复较量然后一起奔赴自由。它为唤醒语言而向语言绽放并消融语言的坚冰。
是的，写诗。
编辑的话
我羞于将你我二人关系定义。我只愿说，我们绝不只是朋友。
曾经的过往沉甸甸，沦陷在丧失蓝色的乌黑湖底，等待发酵、蜕化、蒸腾、升华，我嗅到的绝不只是友谊散发的单一味道。
共同目睹过最绚烂的景致，共同经历过最狂野的逃亡，我给予你我最致命的忠诚，你还予我你最剜心的信赖。
直至死去，我将背负你最阴暗的秘密；直至死去，你将替我宰杀一切不堪的宿敌。
我们二人是如此默契，施展法力所幻化的各种形态，无需言辞，早已被对方一眼洞悉。
我是你印版创作时所执的笔，你是我跋山涉水时所拄的杖。你将我握住，万物便如游龙般起舞诞生，我将你握住，世界便在双脚起伏间为你我征服。
有你在我身边，月光我绝不独享。
同时，我们也提供该诗的翻译英语、德语与法语版本，并在翻译过程中最大限度保持诗歌原有的风格与韵律。
读者在阅读时，也可感受该诗在不同语言语境下的独特与共通之处。
English Version
The two of us
Ponder once more, do think it through,
More than just friends, me and you.
If mere camaraderie defines our days,
Let's forget, go our separate ways.
Or inscribe our palms on shifting sands,
Since the last golden bloom o'er lands.
Rebel canines, with pupils in angry hue,
Since sirens pierced nights and through.
We've clumsily masked our chance rendezvous,
You believe the secrets 'neath ginkgo, I keep for you.
Though no mortal can threaten or harm you, 'tis true,
Yet emptiness has always been the motif you drew.
My fingers warp from burdens they keep,
Wisteria, serpents, and braids, they entwine deep.
Beware, lest your robes by my closeness are stained,
At full moon in July, your fondness remained.
You'd row 'cross restless waters, praising the night's glow,
While I'd rather direct at the numb structures below:
"Move aside, do not shadow the moonlight we know."
from: Marc Chagall
Deutsche Version
Wir beide
Bitte denk nach, denk genau nach,
Wir sollten mehr als Freunde sein.
Wenn du die Tage mit Freundschaft misst,
Besser wir vergessen uns ganz.
Besser im fließenden Sand unsere Handlinien zu gravieren,
Seit dem letzten Mal, das Rapsfeld so golden strahlte,
Die rebellischen Hunde mit blutroten Augen.
Seit der letzten langen Nacht, tief durch den Alarm gestochen,
Haben wir uns stümperhaft vor diesem Treffen versteckt.
Du bist sicher, dass ich dein Geheimnis unter dem Ginkgo bewahren werde,
Obwohl kein Kind einer Frau dich töten kann,
Betonen, dass die Leere immer dein Hauptthema war.
Meine Fingerknöchel verformen sich unter der Last,
Wisteria, grüne Schlange und mein Zopf sind eng verflochten.
Vorsicht, beschmutze nicht deine Robe,
Wenn der Vollmond im Juli kommt,
Liebst du es, auf den unruhigen Gewässern zu fahren,
Den Mond unverhohlen zu loben,
Aber ich bevorzuge es, auf die gefühllosen Gebäude vor uns zu zeigen:
Weg da, blockiere nicht unser Mondlicht.
from: Marc Chagall
Version française
Nous Deux
Pense encore, pense bien profond,
Ne sommes-nous que simples amis au-delà?
Si tu mesures nos jours en amitié fond,
Mieux vaut nous oublier, c'est la loi.
Grave plutôt nos lignes de main dans le sable,
Depuis le dernier champ de colza étincelant,
Les yeux rouges des chiens, en rébellion s'établent,
Depuis la dernière nuit, par sirènes percée tant.
Nous avons caché maladroitement cette rencontre,
Tu es sûr que je garderai ton secret sous le ginkgo,
Aucun né de femme ne pourrait te surmonter, en montre,
Mais nul besoin de dire que le néant est ton écho.
Mes doigts se déforment sous le poids, en torsion,
Le wistéria, le serpent vert, mes tresses sont entrelacés,
Attention, ne tache pas ton robe sacrée, en vision,
Chaque pleine lune de juillet, tu aimes naviguer.
Sur des eaux agitées, louant la lune, sans retenue,
Moi, je préfère montrer les bâtiments insensibles:
Dégagez-vous, ne bloquez pas notre lune, vue continue.
from: Marc Chagall

We both

Both of us
Please think again, think carefully
We should be more than just friends
If you use friendship to weigh those days
It's better to simply forget each other
It's better to carve your palm prints on the quicksand
Since the last time the rapeseed flowers were as dazzling as gold everywhere
bloom
The rebellious dog's pupils are swollen and blood-red
Since the last long night I was deeply stung by a siren
We both have been clumsily covering up what happened.
You are convinced that I will strictly guard the secret you buried under the ginkgo tree
Although nothing born of woman can kill you
But there is no need to emphasize that nothingness has always been you

Wisteria, green snake and my braid
tightly entangled
Be careful not to soil your cassocks
Looking forward to every month in July
You like boating on rough water
Praise the moon unrestrainedly
And I would rather point the way forward
Insensitive buildings
Get out of the way, don't block our moonlight
from: Marc Chagall
Introduction to the poet
Chen Jianli
The driving force for writing poetry has been suppressed and scrutinized several times, and it becomes unstoppable. It was summoned by the ancient saints and sages, and now it begins to prepare for the summons. It is ignited by drama and ignites drama. It battles with the image over and over again and then rushes to freedom together. It blooms into language and melts its ice in order to awaken it.
Yes, write poetry.
Editor's Note
I am ashamed to define the relationship between you and me. All I can say is that we are more than just friends.
The past is heavy, sinking at the bottom of the black lake that has lost its blue, waiting for fermentation, degeneration, transpiration, and sublimation. What I smell is not just the single smell of friendship.
We have witnessed the most gorgeous scenery together and experienced the wildest escape together. I give you my most deadly loyalty, and you give me your most heart-wrenching trust.
Until my death, I will carry your darkest secrets; until my death, you will kill all the unbearable enemies for me.
The two of us have such a tacit understanding that the various forms transformed by the use of magic have already been understood by each other without the need for words.
I am the pen you use when creating printing plates, and you are the staff I use when traveling through mountains and rivers. If you hold me, all things will dance and be born like a dragon. If I hold you, the world will be conquered by you and me in the ups and downs of my feet.
With you by my side, I will never have the moonlight to myself.
At the same time, we also provide translated English, German and French versions of the poem, and maintain the original style and rhythm of the poem to the greatest extent during the translation process.
When reading, readers can also feel the uniqueness and commonality of the poem in different language contexts.

P4 Theater and You
2023-09-08
Theory and Methods
Tuesday Reading Club | "The Rhetoric of Myth" by Roland Barthes, recruitment of reading group members
The chapters in the book "Mythical Rhetoric" can be said to be relatively independent of each other. Therefore, in this reading meeting, everyone who comes...
The chapters in the book "Mythical Rhetoric" can be said to be relatively independent of each other. Therefore, in this reading meeting, everyone who comes to participate will actively select or randomly select a section to read with other members. After reading any section, any relevant associations, inspirations, and methodological summaries that drive practice can be shared with others at any time. In the end, we hope that everyone in the field that day can create something interesting together.
What we want to say
Roland Barthes regards myth as a kind of rhetoric, a way of describing the world, and strives to expose the shadow that myth, a rhetorical method, has on human beings. We want to watch the interpretation of myths as myth makers, and after waking up, actively fall into the mixed state of "nature" and "man-made history" to construct our own myth narrative system.
Introduction to "Mythical Rhetoric" (source: Douban)
"Mythologist" Roland Barthes deciphered various myths in daily life in "The Rhetoric of Myth" and explored the reconciling of reality and human beings, description and interpretation, objects and knowledge. He tries to convey to the reader that we are constantly navigating between the object and demystifying it, without the ability to restore the whole picture: because if we enter the object, we liberate it but destroy it; if we let it go, we respect it but also mystify it.
Statement
1. You don't need to have read this book.
2. You don't need to buy the book for this.
3. You don't need to do any mental preparation to come to this reading club.
4. I sincerely hope that everyone can move from reading to practice.

你不需要窥视我，我会把自己吊起来捆起来，掰开揉碎了给你看
今年开始我总是在生病，我不知道是怎么回事，不知道是因生理的不适还是因为处在亲密关系的舒适网里，总之我被困住了。和人相处别扭，开始不想面对，事情，发一句消息也是事情，赴一场约会也是事情，我只想，回到我那张破烂的红色床垫上，在那个阴暗的角落里，扑朔迷离地做梦。
我有一天梦到我要坐电梯出门去，在楼层与楼层的间隔中电梯停电了，我费力地从一个窟窿里面钻出去，外面是一个巨大的墓穴，壮观的石头山，和蜿蜒的洞庭，我看到了我的同学和老师，老师招呼我过去,他把我抱在怀里猥亵我，我大喊，海柱来救我，我的男朋友拿着武士刀冲进来，冲每个人劈头盖脸地砍下去，哗哗的血溅出来，每个人都被劈成了两半，他说，我就知道，我就知道。我们要逃出去，我们披着被砍死的人的人皮，从门口的侍卫眼皮子底下逃走。我以为故事要结束了，走出了巨大的墓穴，我才发现这是一个搭建的景棚，我们开始擦干身上的血浆，导演说再来一条。于是再来一条，我重新回到老师的怀里被猥亵，被那些男学生拉进小屋子里轮奸，被狠狠地羞辱完后，我在门口碰到路过的海柱，我们互相点头，擦肩而过。道路的尽头，一个垂髫的老妇人对他竖起大拇指，你真是一个好演员，他宿命般的回头望向我。梦结束了。我醒来，眼角的泪顺势流下去，海柱拍拍我，怎么了，做噩梦了，我说我好像在一个平行时空里遇见你两次。这不是一个爱情故事，这也不是一个恐怖故事，这是我心里的巨大的痛苦，而现在，它被某种温暖的东西压抑住，我身体里那股毁灭的力量被封起来了，像一个假人的皮囊，血液粘稠地贴进我的皮肤，我透不过气来。我不明白我想要什么，我想要面对来自身体里层巨大的苦痛的肆虐，还是从外界找些实在的消解，每一面都让我沉溺，又痛苦万分。
我是在最底层长大的人，我的父亲是小武，母亲是失足的女学生，我是家里第一个大学生。童年的时候我是留守儿童，再大一点我是孤僻的青年，成长到一个阶段，我成了我自己的素材，我以为表达是唯一的灵魂出口，直到有一天我又不再相信语言。和我十三岁就在一起的女生说，你好像从始至终都没变过，又好像不知道什么时候走向了世界背道而驰的反面。我看着她的脸，很多人成了我短暂人生的分水岭，我说你也是。
2020年的夏天，她从苏州跑来北京，从北京又坐车到燕郊，她说她怀孕了，我摸着她的肚子，我问她，你有感受到什么吗，她说什么都没有。我十九岁，她二十岁，我妈妈也是在二十岁生下的我，我在她肚子的每一天，她都想把我打掉，我的出生是一个意外的错误，而母体的连接是一种臆想。我的朋友说对我说想把这个小孩打掉，我突然很难过，我觉得她肚子里怀了一个我，而此刻我又要死一次。这件事情成了我多年的梦魇，我总在幻想我是她，我是她肚子里的小孩，我把它打掉，我把我自己杀死。我写了一个又一个有关于这个故事的剧本，我想把它拍出来.....
2023年的夏天，我和我大学期间最好的女朋友断绝了联系。那是个炎热的中午，她走在前面，我走在后面，她好像没有看到我，我也没打算叫住她，她坐上出租车扬长而去，我在微信里找到她的名字点了删除键。为什么呢？所有人都在问为什么，我不知道，我不知道，就是有一天，我们发现，我们都不再需要对方的拥抱了。很奇妙，没有一件具体的仇恨，也没有一句具体的爱。我想起是她代替我去医院陪另一个女孩做的流产手术，我想起，有天跨年的夜里，我被前男友扔在北京郊区的一条河边，我独自步行走了一夜的路走到公主坟，她喝的酩酊大醉追着我打抱着我哭，我想起她曾被一个男生打，在见到了同样的男式格子衬衣时她崩溃大哭，我像一个母亲一样抱住她.....我不知道，我不知道怎么接受我们不再需要对方这件事情，我不曾向这个世界要求过什么东西，所以我从没做好失去的准备，于是我删掉了她。
我还在写，显然有些东西是滞后的，我无法实时将它播报出来，我再也无法接受我的生命体验是一台即时转播的电视机，而这一切的导演是我自己。人活着已然是一件极其残忍的事情，诉说者有诉说者的宿命，生存者有自己的生存之道，而我显然都不行，于是我时长陷入无端的苦痛里。
我的另一个男生朋友，他总在问大家，你说这个世界想告诉我什么呢。如果世界是一个具体的东西，那它真的是罪该万死。
还是不要答案了。我们如此劝说自己，如此囿于自己造的幻想里。
我觉得幸福这个词是被编造出来最最虚假最最恶心的形容词。
可我还是要做，虽然不知道为什么，不知道怎么办，虽然我还是没有恨起来，没有愤怒起来。我在亲密关系里天天都在哭，我和我的男朋友做了一部不属于我们任何一个人的戏，我越来越想相信别人，我越来越不相信别人，我看不到人的脸，我得弄明白。
你不需要窥视我，我会把自己吊起来捆起来，掰开揉碎了给你看，给你看我的大脑，我的生殖器，我的心肝肺，我的皮肤，我的血液，我的骨架，我的屎我的尿我的分泌物呕吐物。你要看，因为我不是你，这是一个对你来说全新的活体的领域，你要看，因为我也是你，其实你也受着和我一样的罪。这相同的该死的体感让我们连在一起，回到几万亿年前同一个基因的身体。
树林 2023.8.24

P4 Theater and You
2023-09-07
Project and brand narrative
Self-Material Project | Blood Dreams and Sea Tires
You don't need to peek at me, I will hang myself up, tie myself up, break it up and crush it to show you
I have always been sick since the beginning of this year. I don't know what is going on. I don't know whether it is due to physical discomfort or because I am in the comfort net of an intimate relationship. In short, I am trapped. It was awkward to get along with people, and I didn't want to face things at first, including sending a message, and going on a date. I just wanted to go back to my tattered red mattress, in that dark corner, and dream in confusion.
One day I dreamed that I was going to take the elevator out. The elevator had a power outage between floors. I struggled to get out of a hole. Outside was a huge tomb, a spectacular stone mountain, and a winding cave. I saw my classmates, teachers, and teachers. He called me over, he held me in his arms and molested me, I shouted, Haizhu came to save me, my boyfriend rushed in with a samurai sword and slashed at everyone, blood splattered, everyone was split in half, he said, I knew it, I knew it. We want to escape. We wear the human skins of the people who were hacked to death and escape from under the eyes of the guards at the door. I thought the story was about to end. After walking out of the huge tomb, I discovered that it was a set-up. We started to wipe off the blood on our bodies, and the director said there would be one more scene. So here's another one: I returned to the teacher's arms and was molested. I was dragged into a small room by those male students and gang-raped. After being severely humiliated, I met Haizhu passing by at the door. We nodded to each other and passed by. At the end of the road, an old woman with a droopy head gave him a thumbs up, "You are such a good actor." He looked back at me with a fatalistic look. The dream is over. I woke up, tears streaming down from the corners of my eyes, Haizhu patted me, what's wrong, I had a nightmare, I said it seemed like I met you twice in a parallel time and space. This is not a love story, this is not a horror story, this is the huge pain in my heart, and now, it is suppressed by something warm. The destructive power in my body is sealed, like a dummy's skin, and the blood sticks to my skin so thickly that I can't breathe. I don't know what I want. Do I want to face the raging pain from inside my body, or do I want to find some real relief from the outside world? Every aspect makes me addicted and extremely painful.
I grew up at the bottom of the class. My father is Xiao Wu and my mother is a female student who has fallen behind. I am the first college student in my family. When I was a child, I was a left-behind child. When I was older, I was a lonely young man. When I grew up to a stage, I became my own material. I thought that expression was the only outlet for my soul, until one day I no longer believed in language. The girl who has been with me since we were thirteen said that you seem to have never changed from the beginning to the end, and you seem to have gone to the opposite side of the world without knowing when. I looked at her face and realized that many people had become a watershed in my short life, and I said you too.
In the summer of 2020, she ran from Suzhou to Beijing, and then took a bus from Beijing to Yanjiao. She said she was pregnant. I touched her belly and asked her, did you feel anything? She said nothing. I was nineteen and she was twenty. My mother also gave birth to me when she was twenty. Every day I was in her belly, she wanted to abort me. My birth was an accidental mistake, and the connection between the mother and the body was a fantasy. My friend told me that she wanted to abort the child. I suddenly felt very sad. I felt that she was pregnant with me, and now I was about to die again. This incident has become a nightmare for me for many years. I always fantasize that I am her, the child in her belly, I will abort it, and I will kill myself. I wrote script after script about this story, and I wanted to film it...
In the summer of 2023, I cut off contact with my best girlfriend from college. It was a hot noon. She was walking in front and I was walking behind. She didn't seem to see me, and I didn't intend to stop her. She got into a taxi and drove away. I found her name in WeChat and clicked the delete button. Why? Everyone is asking why, I don't know, I don't know, just one day, we found that we no longer need each other's hugs. It's strange that there is no specific hatred and no specific love. I remembered that she went to the hospital to accompany another girl for an abortion on my behalf. I remembered that one New Year's Eve, I was abandoned by my ex-boyfriend by a river in the suburbs of Beijing. I walked alone all night to the Princess Tomb. She was very drunk and chased me, beat me and hugged me while she cried. I remembered that she had been beaten by a boy. When she saw the same men's plaid shirt, she broke down and cried. I hugged her like a mother... I don't know, I don't know how to accept that we no longer need each other. I never asked for anything from this world, so I was never ready to lose, so I deleted her.
I'm still writing, but obviously some things are lagging behind. I can't broadcast it in real time. I can no longer accept that my life experience is a TV that broadcasts it in real time, and the director of it all is myself. Human life is already an extremely cruel thing. Those who tell have their destiny, and those who survive have their own way of survival. But I obviously can't do it, so I have been in unreasonable pain for a long time.
Another boy friend of mine is always asking everyone, what do you think the world wants to tell me. If the world were a concrete thing, it would really be worthy of death.
No more answers. We persuade ourselves so much, so trapped in our own illusions.
I think the word happiness is the most false and disgusting adjective ever invented.
But I still have to do it, even though I don't know why or what to do, even though I still don't hate it or get angry. I cry every day in an intimate relationship. My boyfriend and I made a play that doesn't belong to either of us. I want to trust others more and more, but I don't trust others less and less. I can't see people's faces. I have to figure it out.
You don't need to peek at me, I will hang myself up and tie myself up, break it apart and crush it for you to see, show you my brain, my genitals, my heart, liver and lungs, my skin, my blood, my skeleton, my shit, my urine, my secretions and vomit. You have to see, because I am not you. This is a new realm of living bodies for you. You have to see, because I am also you. In fact, you also suffer the same sins as me. This same damn body sensation connects us, back to the same genetic body trillions of years ago.
woods 2023.8.24

周日放映 | 一无所有的爱 — 新桥恋人放映正式招募
我们相识的时候，你即将失明，我们来做彼此的光。我们用酒精和喧闹相互依偎，彼此搀扶。我要做一个未经教化的狼孩，一个没有未来的幽灵，我只知道索取爱情，如同溺水的人抱着稻草一样。可爱情对我是一种本能，对你却复杂太多。
那年烟花太多了-被浇灌的自由无法让你奔向我
我们相识的时候，你即将失明，我们来做彼此的光。我们用酒精和喧闹相互依偎，彼此搀扶。我要做一个未经教化的狼孩，一个没有未来的幽灵，我只知道索取爱情，如同溺水的人抱着稻草一样。可爱情对我是一种本能，对你却复杂太多。
梦是最无耻的骗子，它用幻象载着你接近那不可能的真实，爱在无穷远的彼岸注定触礁，淹没你的破碎成无数片嘲弄的余波。
没有明天，就在今夜！我们做一回喷火的恶龙，让火的弧线划过冰冷的夜空。旧时代的幽灵带着创伤的和解消逝，庞大的收买手续又一次的达成，如果你也背弃我，世界将只剩下一团无谓的绝望。
我要忍受你？不！
我最诚恳的爱，是和你一同沉入塞纳河。
我们的爱由什么组成？
我们从对方那里获取了一具身体？获取同情和陪伴？获取亲吻和性爱？高潮和抚摸？获取幻想的达成？支配与侵凌？甚至地位与金钱？爱在哪个缝隙栖身呢？
我们有权要什么呢？
我是一个对世界的错乱绝望的人，爱的给予总伴随着她的历史，伴随着错乱与失败。我学会一种认可的爱，缺失的给予而少索取。我无权向这个世界要求任何东西，任何的给予都是爱的载体，纯粹的礼物。我出让我的期待，换取你全然的在场。冲垮棱镜的花园，抛下摇曳的盛世，在自由与平等之间，向他者的奇迹建一座爱的新桥。
新桥恋人
故事发生在巴黎新桥，巴黎最古老的桥，如果有什么地点天然为与国家力量对抗的个人提供栖息之所的话，就是新桥。它是一种在历史与现实之间漂浮的能指，奇妙地把商业、艺术、宗教和政治剪接在一起；而它身下塞纳河的流水，则是孤独心灵永不枯竭的力量源泉。此地于1989-1991关闭大修，因此成为流浪者的栖身之地，因失恋和眼疾落魄离家的Michele在新桥上遇见流浪的Alex，一段烟火般绚烂的爱情从此开始。
导演卡拉克斯是“后新浪潮”的代表人物，他的大胆和反叛与新浪潮的精神一脉相承。
导演 卡拉克斯
这部电影浓缩着法兰西式的决绝的浪漫，在电影中你一定会感受到他独特的电影美学。在卡拉克斯镜头下，巴黎显得肮脏而真实，在暗色调冷色调的背景中有三个鲜亮的颜色贯穿始终，那就是红、白、蓝，这不仅是法国国旗的颜色，也呼应了电影深层的主题--自由，平等和爱。
关于510

收费供应零食饮料酒水，更有服务员为您的各项需求提供专属服务。
本地为常设活动地点，欢迎常来交流。

New Bridge Lovers
The story takes place on the Pont Neuf in Paris, the oldest bridge in Paris. If there is any place that naturally provides a shelter for individuals fighting against the power of the state, it is the Pont Neuf. It is a signifier that floats between history and reality, wonderfully splicing together business, art, religion and politics; and the flowing water of the Seine beneath it is an inexhaustible source of power for lonely souls. This place was closed for major renovations from 1989 to 1991, so it became a place for homeless people to live. Michele, who left home due to a broken heart and an eye disease, met the homeless Alex on the New Bridge, and a love affair as splendid as fireworks began.

共产剧本 | 嫖娼日记 —— 答案
某天我们在一起喝酒，见他醉醺醺后，我试探的问他；你真的是个嫖娼不眨眼的人吗？
我认识一个资深的嫖客，总爱谈及他和娼妓们的趣事。
某天我们在一起喝酒，见他醉醺醺后，我试探的问他；你真的是个嫖娼不眨眼的人吗？
没想到他竟心直口快，说他得性病，蹲看守所，一切都是真的。但唯独没嫖过娼，因为他就是个娼，并且毫无任何原则底线，又卖男的又卖女的，上面、下面、后面全卖，还连具体的定价都没有，只要给他发支烟，他就能够和你搞上一下。
为此，长期如此的生活令他心理有些叛逆。于是他重塑了另一个身份，一个只嫖别人，而不被别人嫖的资深嫖客，这个嫖客威武、凶猛，一天天长大，最后占据了他的整个人生和全部的记忆。
接着，他又说出了另一个版本的答案。便是他从没嫖过娼，也从没当过娼妓，得性病和蹲看守所也是假的，一切都是他编造的，他不过想要愚弄人们。
他还说，我是个聪明人，没有任何精神疾病。而他，也不是我。据我对他多年的了解，他并不擅长说谎。
"共产剧本"是一个富有创新性的项目，它不仅是一个剧本，更是一个集结众人想象力与创作才能的开放平台。它的核心在于持续创作，鼓励参与者们接续写下他们心中的故事，让它向未知的领域探索延伸。这个项目的魅力在于，无论是一部详尽的史诗，还是一个简单的短篇，都可以被接纳和欣赏。它不设限，不拘泥于固定的情节或结局，而是让每一位创作者自由地发挥他们的想象力和创意。这种多元化的创作方式，让每一个故事都有无尽的可能性。共产剧本的另一个特点是其社区性质。创作者们共同参与，使得剧本像是一个有机体，不断生长、变化。每个人都在为这个共同的项目贡献力量，每个人的创作都会成为整个作品的一部分。这种协同创作的方式，让剧本充满了活力和变化。总的来说，"共产剧本"是一个激发创造力、汇聚众人智慧的场所。它鼓励我们挑战传统的故事叙述方式，打破固定的思维模式，让我们的想象力和创新精神得以充分发挥。通过持续创作，我们可以将故事推向更远、更未知的领域，揭示出生活的无限可能性和多样性。

2023-09-03
争议与宣言
独自宣言｜ 走，再来一遍：“ 向我开炮，也向你开炮 ”
★最近觉得最愚蠢的事情就是堆叠专有名词，不说人话；再者就是匆忙定性一个东西、事件或群体。要不要这么匆忙？这么
★
最近觉得最愚蠢的事情就是堆叠专有名词，不说人话；再者就是匆忙定性一个东西、事件或群体。要不要这么匆忙？这么慌慌张张？用这些词汇话术来自保、自慰、来党同伐异、获取优越感和性资源、来给别人贴标签、社交、滥交，狗苟蝇营；说实话这种人的创作在我看来也与玩梗无异，还不如绝大多数搞抽象的玩的高级。
★
我现在的脑回路非常简单粗暴，我只需直面——向我迎面而来的问题。但是，仅仅这些问题，弱智得像1+1，也从来没有尽头，几乎没有一个亘古不变的答案。现实有时候是虚幻的，在虚幻到极致时又会转化成最真实的东西，带来真实的影响，比如历史上的很多破事。我最反感的不是假、做作、装逼，我最反感的是——那种侥幸的浑浊，那种装睡。如果有什么东西降临到面前，那就撇过头去，就用“注定如此”给他框死，多扣几层帽子。这是知识最糟糕的用法，这是最无用的经验。我不知道一个一直逃离真理、逃离真相的人会有什么下场，但善终对我来说根本就不重要，是个伪命题，谁知道王翔能不能善终。一个逃了一辈子的人，能安稳度日吗？我可怜他们，要撒越来越多水平低下的谎，制造越来越多的迷障，那种一时的得意太过可笑，以为自己跟所有人都不一样，狗屁自我！这种人所有的，只是最粉碎的人性，最稀烂的认知和行为逻辑，最可笑的是还是“讲逻辑”的，侮辱逻辑。
★
所以说天堂是为在世间无法真正获得幸福的人准备的。我只有怜悯，我可怜他们。当然还有一点蔑视，戏谑。因为地狱天堂皆在人间。
我能理解这种妄人的命运，因为我在所有人身上看到自己的影子。但我会难堪、我会内疚，我会感到抱歉，我会追问下去。所有这些不安都是有意义的，我不忽视任何这些感觉，是实在界的反馈，每一次我的固步自封被击碎，我都看到更大更深的世界。我常常难以忍受，我天天想死，活着见证这个时代总是需要太大的勇气，乃至执念。
有的人是不得以走进自己建造的牢笼，以此惩罚自己，因为理想太纯粹，现实太龌龊。而有些人的逃避，只是不敢正视自己，尤其不敢把其他人当人——不敢不物化别人。也有可能存在部分过于龌龊的人，认为所有人都跟自己一样，只是不说出来罢了。但是错了，龌龊的是部分人性，而非所有人所向往，所有人所行为。
都一样，都会浏览一些网站，保守一些秘密，有一些见不得人的欲望。我面对过：有人说恨我。那是绝对真实的情感，那个人也绝对不是傻逼，这种事也完全不是意识形态冲突，不是学术竞赛也不是谁比谁更高级。唯一真实的决裂，只是一种无可奈何的无能为力，其他任何敌对斗争、割裂划分、都是蓄意为之。不要把任何人当傻逼。
★
爱应该是人做事的前提，以及底线。爱以及任何崇高的词汇，不是免死金牌、不是说明书指导手册、不是抵着别人的脑袋的枪。素质越低的地方，才越要弘扬素质教育，分明屁大点事。比屁还渺小，还无形，只存在在最玄妙曲折的过程中。
为了心中的正义只好他妈的去战斗，否则就是活千年，也不过是千年的禽兽。
"《独自宣言》项目是一次内心的宣泄和重生，是一次与过去告别的仪式，也是一次投身未知的冒险。它象征着我们挣脱过去的束缚，勇敢地迈向那个更加广阔、更加神秘的未来。这个项目不仅是一份对自己的承诺，更是一次寻找自我、探索未知的旅程，让我们能够在孤独和挑战中找到属于自己的方向和力量。"

Alone Declaration｜Let's do it again: "Fire at me and fire at you"
★The stupidest thing I feel lately is to pile up proper nouns without talking about people; or to rush to characterize a thing, event or group. Do you want...
★
The most stupid thing I feel recently is to pile up proper nouns without talking about people; and to rush to characterize a thing, event or group. Do you want to be in such a hurry? So flustered? They use these words and expressions to protect themselves, masturbate, join the party and oppose dissidents, gain a sense of superiority and sexual resources, label others, socialize, and have promiscuous relationships. To be honest, the creations of such people are no different from meme-making, and are not as advanced as most abstract games.
★
My current brain circuit is very simple and crude. I just need to face the problem head on - the problem that comes to me. However, just these questions are as stupid as 1+1, and they have no end. There is almost no eternal answer. Reality is sometimes illusory, but when the illusion reaches its extreme, it transforms into the most real thing and brings real impact, such as many bad things in history. What I dislike most is not fakeness, pretense, or pretense, but what I dislike the most is the muddiness of luck, the pretense of sleeping. If something comes in front of you, just turn your head away and frame it with "it's destined to be this way" and add a few more hats to it. This is the worst use of knowledge, this is the most useless experience. I don't know what will happen to a person who has been running away from the truth, but a good death is not important to me at all. It is a false proposition. Who knows whether Wang Xiang can die a good death. Can a person who has been running away all his life live a stable life? I pity them, they have to tell more and more low-level lies and create more and more confusions. Their temporary complacency is so ridiculous, they think they are different from everyone else, bullshit themselves! What this kind of person has is the most shattered humanity, the most shoddy cognitive and behavioral logic, and the most ridiculous thing is that he is still "logical" and insults logic.
★
Therefore, heaven is prepared for people who cannot truly achieve happiness in this world. I have only pity, I pity them. Of course, there is also a bit of contempt and teasing. Because hell and heaven are all on earth.
I can understand this delusional fate because I see myself reflected in everyone. But I will be embarrassed, I will feel guilty, I will feel sorry, and I will keep asking. All these insecurities are meaningful. I don't ignore any of these feelings. They are feedback from the real world. Every time my stubbornness is shattered, I see a bigger and deeper world. I often find it unbearable. I want to die every day. It always takes too much courage and even obsession to live to witness this era.
Some people are not allowed to enter the cage they built to punish themselves, because the ideal is too pure and the reality is too dirty. And some people's escape is just that they don't dare to face themselves, especially they don't dare to treat other people as human beings - they don't dare not to objectify others. There may also be some people who are too dirty and think that everyone is just like them, but they just don't say it out loud. But I'm wrong. What's dirty is part of human nature, not what everyone aspires to or what everyone does.
They are all the same, they browse some websites, keep some secrets, and have some shameful desires. I've faced it: Some people say they hate me. That is an absolutely real emotion, and that person is definitely not an idiot. This kind of thing is not an ideological conflict at all, nor is it an academic competition or who is superior to another. The only real break is a helpless powerlessness. Any other hostile struggle or division is deliberate. Don't treat anyone like a fool.
★
Love should be the premise and bottom line for people to do things. Love, and any noble word, is not a golden ticket, an instruction manual, or a gun to someone's head. The lower the quality of the place, the more important it is to promote quality education, which is obviously a big deal. It's smaller than a fart, it's invisible, and it only exists in the most mysterious and tortuous process.
You have to fucking fight for the justice in your heart, otherwise even if you live for a thousand years, you will be nothing more than a beast for a thousand years.

From what I have known about him over the years, he is not good at lying.
I know a senior prostitute who always likes to talk about interesting things between him and prostitutes.
One day we were drinking together, and after seeing him drunk, I asked him tentatively: Are you really a prostitute who never blinks an eye?
Unexpectedly, he was so outspoken that he had a sexually transmitted disease and was in a detention center. Everything was true. But the only thing I have never been to is a prostitute, because he is a prostitute, and he has no bottom line. He sells men and women, top, bottom, and back. There is no specific price. As long as you give him a cigarette, he can have sex with you.
For this reason, living like this for a long time made him mentally rebellious. So he reshaped another identity, a senior prostitute who only prostituted others but was not prostituted by others. This prostitute was powerful and ferocious, grew up day by day, and finally occupied his entire life and all his memories.
Then, he gave another version of the answer. Even though he had never visited a prostitute or worked as a prostitute, it was also a lie that he had sexually transmitted diseases and was in a detention center. He made everything up, and he just wanted to fool people.
He also said that I am an intelligent person and do not have any mental illness. And he is not me either. From what I have known about him over the years, he is not good at lying.
"Communist Script" is an innovative project. It is not only a script, but also an open platform that gathers everyone's imagination and creative talents. Its core lies in continuous creation, encouraging participants to continue writing the stories in their hearts and allowing them to explore and extend into unknown areas. The charm of this project is that whether it is a detailed epic or a simple short story, it can be accepted and appreciated. It does not set limits and does not stick to a fixed plot or ending, but allows every creator to freely use their imagination and creativity. This diversified creative approach gives every story endless possibilities. Another characteristic of the communist script was its communal nature. The joint participation of the creators makes the script like an organism, constantly growing and changing. Everyone is contributing to this common project, and everyone's creations become part of the overall work. This collaborative creation method makes the script full of vitality and change. In general, "Communist Script" is a place that stimulates creativity and brings together the wisdom of everyone. It encourages us to challenge traditional storytelling, break out of fixed thinking patterns, and allow our imagination and innovative spirit to flourish. By continuing to create, we can push our stories further and further into unknown territories, revealing the infinite possibilities and diversity of life.

sources.text:
p4剧场和你
2023-09-02
活动与演出
人类投降派｜我消失了 —— 在演完《最后的排练》之后
甲瑞在《人类投降派》电影中饰演B、徐锦江和假锐三个角色，这是他在演完电影中的戏剧《最后的排练》后，写下的文字，他在演出前写的文字——《人类投降派 | 这是最后的排演！是真的！都是真的！》可以配合这篇文字一起读。
甲瑞在《人类投降派》电影中饰演B、徐锦江和假锐三个角色，这是他在演完电影中的戏剧《最后的排练》后，写下的文字，他在演出前写的文字——《人类投降派 | 这是最后的排演！是真的！都是真的！》可以配合这篇文字一起读。
演完后很多朋友来跟我说话，老高说我每次演完戏都把自己搞得很脏，Siri担心我问我心情好些没，犹德士说我怎么每次都献祭自己，好人会有好报的，泡泡羊说很喜欢演戏的我，现实里的我总让她觉得很心疼，何发说谢谢我。
我没听懂大家的话，到底哪里值得感谢，让人心疼，让人担心呢？我又怎么献祭了自己？根本意识不到。不过确实每次都搞得很脏，这倒是真的。
演出的开始是我们坐在舞台上冥想，我希望我们可以感受到有关观众的事情，可是必须承认我什么也没有感受到，这件事对我来是一个毋庸置疑的失败。
我睁着眼睛，
但是看不到任何东西。
我张开耳朵，
但是听不见任何声音。
我伸出鼻子，
但是闻不到任何味道。
我张开嘴巴，
但是说不出任何词语。
我撑着手臂，
没法举起任何重物。
我迈开双腿，
没法走去任何地方。
我是虚无，
我是空，
我的内在没有事物。
演到一半我是真的想跑，有几个观众从观众席上走出去，不知道是退场还是去厕所，把我也带走吧，我说。这里是完全的失败，我没法继续下去，把我带走吧。
彬彬确实是救了场，她在一个我们完全停滞只能不断重复的时机把这一切推了下去，吧啦吧啦演了一堆，何发冒出个脑袋说这样不好让她下场。我知道何发是在演，但我也是真的想反驳，这样很好，这样就很好。可我已经没有力气了。
我听不下去他们说的话，站也站不起来，我环视全场想要找到一种工具，刀子锤子什么的，我想把他们全杀了。
谢天谢地什么危险品都没有，不然我们或许已经上了法制新闻。我把舞台上的塑料绳解开，勒住他们的脖子，一小时之前这是我布置的道具。
掐住阿蒙、子丑、彬彬脖子的时候清醒过来了，我重新想起他们是我的朋友，原来我们是在演戏。
所以这个戏得继续下去，我们回到几天前聊好的调度，顺着剧本上的台词演下去，现在是结尾的部分了。
我要用地上的白布把大家都套起来，我们走到后场偷偷溜出去，舞台上就只剩下一个白布，而我们像消失了一样。这是一个魔术。
我们如常走到下场口，阿蒙突然抬起头问我：所以这就是你想要的吗？你想在一个没人的地方，让大家都找不到你。这是剧本之外的台词，我被问懵了，开口说：对，对。我不知道这个回答是出于想要结束这场戏，还是感觉到她真的问出了对我来说特别关键的问题，我不知道，但我用完所有的力气发泄般吼着：对，对。
昨天本来答应去跟泡泡羊讨论新剧本，起床的时候感觉嗓子剧痛浑身发昏，我是感冒了。我发去消息说感冒了不去了鸽了大家，但不去不是因为感冒，它没有这么严重。昨天在家呆了一天，突然很想谢谢大家，谢谢阿蒙子丑彬彬老高Siri犹德士泡泡羊肉片…谢谢所有人，虽然我不知道为啥想谢谢你们。
现在我要去没有人的地方，让大家都看不到我了。
点击图片
了解更多关于《人类投降派》的秘密
后记：
甲瑞出生在山东泰安，99年生，学了很多年电影，和《大象席地而坐》的导演胡波是双校友。在拍摄电影和排练的这段时间和他深入接触后，发现甲瑞真的很有才华，他有一种笃定，而这种气质很多人都很匮乏。
他常把头望向天，用那双大大的眼睛死死的盯着，在喝醉的时候，还会大骂。然后把头猛的垂下来，朝着脊椎顺下来，缩成虾米一样。他拍过一部很短的短片，讲的是求雨的故事，我第一眼就喜欢上了。
甲瑞也在群里，大家要是对她感兴趣就来一起聊聊天，聊聊电影哈

2023-09-02
外部转载与推荐
朝 圣 笔 记
朝圣笔记在上万种祈祷的方式里我钟意听你唱歌我一直听，以此揣测堕落以此抗拒解脱你唱着，我的供养是我无边的惶惑请
朝圣笔记
在上万种祈祷的方式里
我钟意听你唱歌
我一直听，以此揣测堕落
以此抗拒解脱
你唱着，我的供养是我无边的惶惑
请原谅我无力辨别灰喜鹊或乌鸦的梦境
如同我无从厘清洪水的来由：
在乎云端还是九泉？
在乎镀金的河堤
还是被践踏成齑粉的尊严？
你厚重的低音如群山一般延绵
你歌唱过的一切都会实现
比如合法地表达厌恶
比如蚁巢里升起的平等观
比如消弭充斥在此时此地的美学
比如全然的愤怒
比如春天
诗人简介
陈渐离：
写诗的原动力几经压抑和审视，趋于不可阻止。它受到古圣先贤的召唤，如今它开始准备召唤。它被戏剧点燃又点燃了戏剧。它与影像反复较量然后一起奔赴自由。它为唤醒语言而向语言绽放并消融语言的坚冰。
是的，写诗。
编辑的话
在上万种祈祷的方式终，我钟意听你唱歌。
你歌唱过的一切都将实现。
尽管我是你不称职的信徒。我虽并非无知，可我难以抵挡堕落的诱惑，正如我难以分辨好与恶、圣洁与罪恶。
若我从云端跌落，我定双唇紧闭，不向一人振臂高呼，我分不清那到底是沉沦或是解脱，更不知我心之所属。
我是如此混沌，等待你清凉歌声的点化。
悉心供养你，侧耳倾听你，我是否也因此得以升华——是否拥有僭越的勇气、超脱的渴求、击碎冥顽不灵尊严和权柄的双拳。
但在此之前，我沉默着，等待春天被你唤醒，等待第一丝绿意破茧。
同时，我们也提供该诗的翻译英语、德语、法语与西语版本，并在翻译过程中最大限度保持诗歌原有的风格与韵律。
读者在阅读时，也可感受该诗在不同语言语境下的独特与共通之处。
English Version
Pilgrim's Notes
In the realm of countless prayers, I find my solace there
Listening to your voice, singing with such flair
I've been listening all along, seeking to comprehend
The depths of my fall, resisting the urge to transcend
You sing, and I'm left in boundless disarray
Forgive me, for I can't discern without dismay
The dreams of gray magpies and crows, intertwined
Just as I struggle to fathom the flood's design
Do I care for the clouds or the depths below?
The gilded riverbanks or the trampled dignity we know?
Your deep notes resonate, like mountains so grand
Everything you sing, I believe will come to hand
To express disgust, with a legal voice so clear
To elevate equality, in an anthill we hold dear
To erase the aesthetics, that engulf this time and space
To be consumed by anger, in its entirety, embrace
And like the arrival of spring, so serene
These are the visions your songs convene
from: Pierre Bonnard
Deutsche Version
Pilgernotizen
In den zehntausend Arten des Gebets
Höre ich gerne deinen Gesang
Ich höre zu, um den Verfall zu erahnen
Um der Erlösung zu widerstehen
Du singst, meine Hingabe ist grenzenlose Verwirrung
Bitte verzeih mir, dass ich nicht unterscheiden kann
Zwischen den Träumen der grauen Elstern und der Krähen
So wie ich nicht die Ursache der Flut klären kann:
Ob es um die Wolken oder die neun Tiefen geht?
Ob es um die vergoldeten Flussufer geht oder um die zertretenen Würde?
Deine tiefe Stimme ist so schwer wie die Berge, die sich erstrecken
Alles, was du gesungen hast, wird wahr
Wie zum Beispiel der legale Ausdruck des Ekelns
Wie zum Beispiel die Gleichheit, die im Ameisenhaufen aufsteigt
Wie zum Beispiel die Ästhetik, die hier und jetzt erfüllt ist
Wie zum Beispiel die pure Wut
Wie zum Beispiel der Frühling
from: Pierre Bonnard
Version française
Journal du pèlerinage
Dans les milliers de façons de prier,
J'aime t'entendre chanter,
Je t'écoute toujours, pour deviner la décadence,
Pour résister à la délivrance.
Tu chantes, ma nourriture est mon angoisse infinie,
Pardonne-moi de ne pas pouvoir distinguer le rêve des pies et des corbeaux,
Tout comme je ne peux pas comprendre l'origine des inondations:
Est-ce les cieux ou les neuf enfers?
Est-ce les digues dorées ou la dignité piétinée en miettes?
Ta voix grave est aussi majestueuse que les montagnes,
Tout ce que tu chantes se réalisera,
Comme exprimer légalement le dégoût,
Comme l'égalité qui s'élève dans une fourmilière,
Comme éliminer l'esthétique qui imprègne cet instant et cet endroit,
Comme une colère totale,
Comme le printemps.
from: Pierre Bonnard
Versión española
Apuntes de Peregrinación
En las miles de formas de oración,
me gusta escuchar tu canto.
Lo he estado escuchando, para descifrar la caída,
para resistir la liberación.
Cantas, mi ofrenda es mi infinita confusión.
Perdóname por no poder distinguir los sueños de las grullas y los cuervos,
como no puedo discernir las razones de la inundación:
¿Importa el cielo o el más allá?
¿Importa el dique dorado o la dignidad pisoteada en polvo?
Tu voz grave es tan imponente como una cadena montañosa.
Todo lo que cantas se hará realidad,
como expresar el disgusto de manera legítima,
como el igualitarismo que surge de un hormiguero,
como eliminar la estética que impregna este tiempo y lugar,
como la ira total,
como la primavera.
from: Pierre Bonnard

Pilgrimage Notes
Pilgrimage Notes Among the tens of thousands of ways of praying, I like to listen to your singing. I always listen to it, using it to speculate on...
Pilgrimage Notes
Among the tens of thousands of ways to pray
I like to hear you sing
I keep listening to speculate on the fall
To resist liberation
You sing, my support is my boundless confusion
Please forgive me for my inability to discern the dreams of a gray magpie or a crow.
Just like I can't figure out the cause of the flood
Do you care about the clouds or the nine springs?
Mind the gilded river banks
Or was his dignity trampled to pieces?
Your thick bass stretches like mountains
Everything you sing about will come true
For example, a legitimate expression of disgust
Such as the concept of equality rising in the ant nest
For example, eliminating the aesthetics that fills the here and now
Like utter anger
such as spring
Introduction to the poet
Chen Jianli
The driving force for writing poetry has been suppressed and scrutinized several times, and it becomes unstoppable. It was summoned by the ancient saints and sages, and now it begins to prepare for the summons. It is ignited by drama and ignites drama. It battles with the image over and over again and then rushes to freedom together. It blooms into language and melts its ice in order to awaken it.
Yes, write poetry.
Editor's Note
In the end of tens of thousands of ways to pray, I love to hear you sing.
Everything you have ever sung about will come true.
Even though I am your incompetent disciple. Although I am not ignorant, it is difficult for me to resist the temptation to fall, just as it is difficult for me to distinguish between good and evil, holiness and sin.
If I fall from the clouds, my lips will be tightly closed and I will not raise my arms and shout to anyone. I can't tell whether it is sinking or liberation, let alone where my heart belongs.
I am so confused, waiting for the enlightenment of your cool singing voice.
By supporting you with all my heart and listening to you, will I be able to be sublimated? Will I have the courage to transcend, the desire to transcend, and the fists to crush stubborn dignity and authority?
But before that, I am silent, waiting for spring to be awakened by you, waiting for the first trace of green to break out of the cocoon.
At the same time, we also provide translated English, German, French and Spanish versions of the poem, and maintain the original style and rhythm of the poem to the greatest extent during the translation process.
When reading, readers can also feel the uniqueness and commonality of the poem in different language contexts.

Jia Rui played the three roles of B, Xu Jinjiang and Feng Rui in the movie "Human Surrender". This is the text he wrote after performing the drama "The Last Rehearsal" in the movie. The text he wrote before the performance - "Human Surrender | This is the final rehearsal! It's true! It's all true! 》can be read together with this text.
After the performance, many friends came to talk to me. Lao Gao said that I made myself very dirty every time after acting. Siri was worried about me and asked if I was in a better mood. Yudes said why I sacrifice myself every time. Good people will be rewarded. Paopao Sheep said that she likes me acting very much. In reality, I always make her feel distressed. He Fa said thank you to me.
I didn't understand what everyone said. What on earth is worthy of gratitude, distress, and worry? How could I sacrifice myself? Not aware of it at all. But it's true that it gets really dirty every time.
The show started with us sitting on the stage meditating. I hoped we could feel something about the audience, but I must admit that I felt nothing. This was an undoubted failure for me.
I keep my eyes open
But can't see anything.
I open my ears
But no sound could be heard.
I stick out my nose
But there is no smell.
I open my mouth
But no words came out.
I hold my arms up
Unable to lift anything heavy.
I spread my legs
Can't go anywhere.
I am nothingness
I am empty
There is nothing inside me.
In the middle of the performance, I really wanted to run away. Several audience members walked out of the auditorium. They didn't know whether to leave the show or go to the toilet. Take me with them, I said. This is complete failure, I can't go on, take me away.
Binbin really saved the scene. She pushed all of this at a time when we were completely stagnant and could only repeat it over and over again. After a lot of acting, He Fa popped up and said that it would not be good for her to end. I know He Fa is acting, but I really want to refute, this is good, this is good. But I have no strength left.
I couldn't listen to what they said, and I couldn't stand up. I looked around the whole place, trying to find a tool, a knife, a hammer or something. I wanted to kill them all.
Thank God there weren't any dangerous goods, otherwise we might have been in the legal press. I untied the plastic rope on the stage and strangled their necks. It was the prop I had set up an hour ago.
I woke up when I grabbed Amen, Zichou and Binbin by the neck. I remembered again that they were my friends and it turned out that we were acting.
So the play has to go on. We go back to the schedule we discussed a few days ago and follow the lines in the script. Now it's the end.
I would cover everyone with a white cloth on the ground. We would go to the back and sneak out. There was only a white cloth left on the stage, and we seemed to have disappeared. It's a magic trick.
We walked to the end of the field as usual, and Amon suddenly raised his head and asked me: So is this what you want? You want to be in a place where no one is around so that no one can find you. This was a line outside the script. I was confused by the question and said: Yes, yes. I don't know if this answer was out of wanting to end the scene, or if I felt that she really asked a question that was particularly critical to me. I don't know, but I used all my strength to vent and roar: Yes, yes.
Yesterday I promised to discuss the new script with Bubble Sheep. When I woke up, I felt a sharp pain in my throat and felt dizzy. I had a cold. I sent a message saying that I would not go because I had a cold, but it was not because of the cold. It was not that serious. I spent a day at home yesterday, and suddenly I wanted to thank you all, thank you Amenzi, Chou Binbin, Lao Gao, Siri, Judeshi Bubble Lamb Slices... Thank you all, although I don't know why I want to thank you.
Now I want to go to a place where there is no one, so that no one can see me.

Learn more about the secrets of Human Surrender
Postscript
Jia Rui was born in Tai'an, Shandong Province in 1999. He has studied film for many years and is a double alumnus of Hu Bo, the director of "The Elephant Sitting on the Floor". After getting in-depth contact with him during the filming and rehearsal period, I found that Jia Rui is really talented. He has a kind of determination that many people lack.
He often looked up to the sky and stared with his big eyes. When he was drunk, he would also curse. Then he dropped his head sharply, moving down his spine, shrinking into a shrimp-like shape. He made a short film about praying for rain, and I fell in love with it at first sight.
Jiarui is also in the group. If everyone is interested in her, come and chat together and talk about movies.

每一分钟皆雷霆万钧。是的,长镜头的每一处运动与停滞都浸透了绵延的诗意，他拍摄着理想的崩解，宰割与欺骗，残忍与救赎。有些人要求我们表示义愤，有些人要求我们进行悔过，还有人甚至要我们分担对乌托邦的牺牲者们的无限哀伤。贝拉•塔尔显然比较节制，他只要求我们给一些时间。跟随他的镜头走过那段漫长而又泥泞的道路。

这不是一部形式主义作品，与之相反，这是最后一部历史唯物主义电影杰作。物质与感觉轮替流换,执拗的钟声，醉鬼不断重复的一句话，酒杯被倒满又被喝干，手风琴，探戈的节奏，
和匈牙利平原上永不停歇的雨声。感觉的加强不像在塔可夫斯基或索科洛夫那里是自觉的：在精神世界中动摇我们。幽灵般的教堂里的钟是被一个傻子扣响的。悠长的固定镜头和缓慢的摄影机运动并没有把我们引入任何精神世界。它们把我们牢牢地羁留在物质现实中的为匈牙利电影观众所熟知的故事中：一个农村合作社的解体，一场关于更好生活的骗局，与一帮丧失信仰的官吏。
当贝拉·塔尔被要求阐释时,他说:“早些时候，我注意到这样一个事实：当摄影机在拍摄、整个场景都在运动的时候，每个人都开始用同样的节奏呼吸：演员、剧组成员、摄影师、每一个人。你就会全神贯注地『进入』这部电影。这是非常重要的，它创造出一种特殊的张力，一种特殊的震颤。这是某种你可以在银幕上感受到的东西。你也会成为其中的一部分。”（是不是想起了什么）
“一个月以前我又看了一遍这部电影，说实话，我一个镜头都没必要改。你如果要看清楚一样东西究竟是好是坏，二十五年的时间已经足够了。有太多的电影消失了。它们就像是卫生纸一样：你用过了，然后就把它们丢掉，这就是市场运作的方式。时间是非常残忍的，只有某些电影能够幸存下来。”

P4 Theater and You
2023-08-31
Recruitment and conversion
Film Screening and Exchange | "Satan Tango" Official Recruitment
Have you ever locked yourself in a room and read a long and endless poem.
Have you ever locked yourself in a room and read a long and endless poem.
Every minute is thunderous. Yes, every movement and stagnation of the long lens is soaked in continuous poetry. He shoots the disintegration of ideals, slaughter and deception, cruelty and redemption. Some ask us to express indignation, others to repent, and still others to share in the infinite sorrow for the victims of Utopia. Béla Tarr was apparently more restrained and asked only for some time. Follow his lens through that long and muddy road.
This is not a formalist work, on the contrary, it is the last historical materialist cinematic masterpiece. Materials and feelings alternate, the stubborn bells ring, the drunkard's repeated words, the wine glass being filled and drained, the accordion, the rhythm of the tango
and the never-ending sound of rain on the plains of Hungary. The intensification of sensation is not conscious as in Tarkovsky or Sokolov: it shakes us in the spiritual world. The bell in the ghostly church was rung by a fool. Long establishing shots and slow camera movements do not draw us into any spiritual world. They keep us firmly in the material reality of a story familiar to Hungarian film audiences: the disintegration of a rural cooperative, a scam about a better life, and a group of officials who have lost their faith.
When Béla Tarr was asked to elaborate, he said: "Early on, I noticed the fact that when the camera is filming and the whole scene is in motion, everyone starts breathing in the same rhythm: actors, crew members, cameramen, everyone. You become engrossed in the film. This is very important, it creates a special tension, a special tremor. It's something you can feel on the screen. You become a part of it."
"I watched the movie again a month ago, and to be honest, I didn't have to change a single shot. If you want to see whether something is good or bad, twenty-five years is enough time. Too many movies have disappeared. They are like toilet paper: you use it and then throw it away. That's the way the market works. Time is very cruel, and only certain movies survive."

诗人简介
陈渐离：
写诗的原动力几经压抑和审视，趋于不可阻止。它受到古圣先贤的召唤，如今它开始准备召唤。它被戏剧点燃又点燃了戏剧。它与影像反复较量然后一起奔赴自由。它为唤醒语言而向语言绽放并消融语言的坚冰。
是的，写诗。
编辑的话
神庙默不作声，其法力却如此无边，在最原始或最具强制力的森林间横行。令双耳磨出茧的神话不断传颂，年轮与世纪的威力令它有不容置疑的威力。
每一次状似虔诚的作揖、稽首、叩头，是对它威严的臣服；每一句念念有词的经文、符咒、法令，是对它显灵的恐怖。
它享受着不受质疑的供养，饱餐的大肚肥得流油冒出金光。可它却不满足于祭品的生鲜和卑微低贱的侍奉。
它需要品尝童男童女的滋味，需要生命的宰杀和年幼香甜的血液。它贪婪得无以复加，人人却对它随意抛下的只言片语言听计从。
说书人拿什么对付戒尺与镣铐。更何况人人皆自愿将自己囚缚，并将钥匙吞下肚。
同时，我们也提供该诗的翻译英语、德语与法语版本，并在翻译过程中最大限度保持诗歌原有的风格与韵律。
读者在阅读时，也可感受该诗在不同语言语境下的独特与共通之处。
English Version
The Myth of the Disqualified
What sins do temples bear?
What fault lies in tree rings clear?
Of fragrant memories, they're but tender,
Of immortality, we've heard without end.
Don't ever mock the gods unknown,
Their power can't easily be overthrown.
Enough to rule the village with no school's song,
And guarded apartments, standing strong.
Masters in crafting, oh, so profound,
Peachwood swords, human tapestries around,
And spells that time can't confound.
A god of restraint, not bound by greed,
Doesn't devour every maiden and steed.
Invited to the graveyard, under the moon's glow,
Promising a century, if I follow its echo.
But who am I in this ancient tale's flow?
How can a bard fight against chains or blow?
Ever since the hubristics were hanged in the square,
I've learnt to wear symbols, with caution and care.
Gritting my teeth, enduring our tribe's glare,
Guarding their crudeness, their raw despair.
from: Bastien-Lepage
Deutsche Version
Disqualifizierter Mythos
Was hat der Tempel falsch gemacht?
Was haben die Jahresringe verbrochen?
Erinnerungen an Gewürze sind zart,
Über Unsterblichkeit haben wir oft gesprochen.
Verachte nicht den unbekannten Gott,
Seine Macht ist grenzenlos, glaub mir.
Er regiert Dörfer ohne Schulen,
Und Wohnhäuser mit bewaffneten Wachen dabei.
Er ist ein Meister im Herstellen,
Von Pfirsichholzschwertern, menschlichen Thangkas, alten Zaubersprüchen.
Als ein gemäßigter Gott,
Verschlingt er nicht alle Jungen und Mädchen im Licht.
Er lädt mich ein, in der Vollmondnacht zu kommen,
Verspricht, dass ich aus alten Papieren starte und ein ganzes Jahrhundert rette.
Aber wer bin ich?
Was kann ein Geschichtenerzähler gegen einen Lineal oder Fußfessel tun?
Seitdem zwanzig Narzissten öffentlich auf dem Platz gehängt wurden,
Habe ich gelernt, Sterne wie David zu zeichnen,
Meine Zähne fest zusammenbeißen, geduldig das Vulgäre und das Störrische meiner Leute bewachen.
from: Rembrandt
Version française
Mythe Disqualifié
Pourquoi la faute du temple ?
Pourquoi celle des anneaux d'âge ?
Les souvenirs d'épices, ils sont doux et souples,
D'immortalité, nous en avons trop entendu à chaque étape.
Ne sous-estimez pas le dieu anonyme,
Sa puissance est vaste, sans mesure,
Dominant villages sans écoles, tours pleines de gardes armés,
Il maîtrise les épées en bois de pêcher, les thangkas en peau humaine, et les sorts qui durent.
Dieu modéré, il ne dévore pas tous les jeunes sous le soleil,
Il m'invite à goûter sa salive lors d'une nuit de pleine lune,
Promettant un retour d'un siècle, depuis un tas de vieux papiers.
Mais qui suis-je face à tout cela?
Que peut le conteur face à une règle ou un bracelet?
Depuis que vingt arrogants furent pendus en public,
J'ai appris à dessiner des symboles semblables à l'étoile de David,
Je serre les dents, défendant patiemment la grossièreté et l'obstination de ma tribu.

p4剧场和你
2023-08-30
理论与方法
《最后的排练》评论｜ 开始诉说 —— 王亚南
那些焦虑的矛盾的痛苦的疯狂的人们世界有一种巨大的剥削吞噬消费耗散无力
我在对一切都失去兴趣的时候看到了你们
那些焦虑的矛盾的痛苦的疯狂的人们世界有一种巨大的剥削吞噬消费耗散无力
我寻找一种理论来改造、超越，指导我的实践。
我曾经怀疑我一切行为的复杂动机，于是停下来，挥拳向那个浅薄的信徒，抹煞死而不僵的亡父。我曾用符号组织起密不透风的膜，许多东西被压抑郁结，我的生命凝滞，缝合开裂的缝隙使我与世界隔离。绝望地等待一种奇迹来掀翻我的存在，激发我的欲望因为存在就是要面对一切的体验，面对焦虑和痛苦，失望和绝望，那就是你，那就是生命，那就是你的一切。
我曾封死自己，去画一张地图，我终于要启程
在地图的边缘向前进。
我看到了你们
我看着p4剧场记录，我感到我就在那台记录的相机里面。
我爱一种丰富性，它对我是种奢侈和缺乏。我曾把我的欲望封闭起来，以抵抗意识形态机器的操控，我曾与世界割席，绝望的抵抗。可我终于来到这个剧场，一种回归的可能，面对敞开的渴望。
这部剧嘲讽了我，候场时闪烁的灯光挑衅
转折
与
打断
故事碎裂成无数能指的碎片，没有意义，只在比真更真的表达中挣扎着喷发。一种边界上的再组织，欲望的呼吸。
我一直很讨厌戏剧腔谁他妈会用那种腔调？虚伪的练习淫荡的诵念奴才一般的字正腔圆。一群优美的婊子。真实只能在断裂晦暗闪烁的絮语中划过，爆发时声嘶力竭的叫喊才应当被听的清楚。抛掉浅薄的限制去听，打破权力的禁锢靠近，才配听到这些幽微的诉说。没有谄媚，没有屈从，我们需要多么勇敢的诚恳来打破无穷的虚假，担负投降的绝望，逼近不可能的真实。我又一次撕开薄膜，喘息着重新存在，寻求连结与表达，期待欲望与幻灭。
我要再次回到生命面前，撕开自己，呼吸
后记：
在《最后的排练》的公演前夜，亚南突然和我说他要来看。他在精神分析的群里一路摸索到了p4剧场，他的脑子里全是数不完的理论，满口的黑话。然后，他从石家庄站了三个小时后来了北京，一路找到了刺鱼书店，看了公演，他和我说他需要欲望。我说那就从今天开始行动吧，让自己的意识弹出弹夹。

P4 Theater and You
2023-08-30
External reprints and recommendations
We have heard too much about immortality
What's wrong with a disqualified mythical temple? What's wrong with the growth rings? The memory of spices is soft. Of immortality, we hear too much. Never...
Disqualified
myth
What's wrong with temples?
What's wrong with the growth rings?
Memories of spices are soft
We have heard too much about immortality
Never despise anonymous gods
It often has unlimited mana
Enough to dominate villages without primary schools and
Apartment with gunman on guard
it masters making
Peach wood sword, human skin thangka and timeless mantra
As a temperate god
It does not devour all the boys and virgins under the sun
It invites me to go to the Shrine on a full moon night and taste its spittle
Promise me to start from the pile of old papers and save a whole life
century
But who am I?
What do storytellers use against rulers or anklets?
Since twenty megalomaniacs were publicly hanged in the square
I learned to paint signs like the Star of David
Grit your teeth and patiently guard the vulgarity and vulgarity of your tribe.
Fierce and stubborn
Introduction to the poet
Chen Jianli
The driving force for writing poetry has been suppressed and scrutinized several times, and it becomes unstoppable. It was summoned by the ancient saints and sages, and now it begins to prepare for the summons. It is ignited by drama and ignites drama. It battles with the image over and over again and then rushes to freedom together. It blooms into language and melts its ice in order to awaken it.
Yes, write poetry.
Editor's Note
The temple is silent, but its power is so boundless, running rampant in the most primitive or most coercive forests. The myth that makes the ears grind out cocoons continues to be sung, and the power of the rings and centuries makes it unquestionable.
Every devout bow, bow, and kowtow is a surrender to its majesty; every chanted scripture, spell, or decree is a fear of its manifestation.
It enjoys unquestioned nourishment, and its well-fed belly is so fat that it is dripping with oil and glowing with gold. But it is not satisfied with fresh sacrifices and humble service.
It needs to taste the taste of boys and girls, the slaughter of life and the sweet blood of young people. It is greedy beyond measure, yet everyone obeys the few words it throws out at will.
What do storytellers use against rulers and shackles? What's more, everyone voluntarily imprisons themselves and swallows the key.
At the same time, we also provide translated English, German and French versions of the poem, and maintain the original style and rhythm of the poem to the greatest extent during the translation process.
When reading, readers can also feel the uniqueness and commonality of the poem in different language contexts.
English Version
The Myth of the Disqualified
What sins do temples bear?
What fault lies in tree rings clear?
Of fragrant memories, they're but tender
Of immortality, we've heard without end.
Don't ever mock the gods unknown
Their power can't easily be overthrown.
Enough to rule the village with no school's song
And guarded apartments, standing strong.
Masters in crafting, oh, so profound
Peachwood swords, human tapestries around
And spells that time can't confound.
A god of restraint, not bound by greed
Doesn't devour every maiden and steed.
Invited to the graveyard, under the moon's glow
Promising a century, if I follow its echo.
But who am I in this ancient tale's flow?
How can a bard fight against chains or blow?
Ever since the hubristics were hanged in the square
I've learnt to wear symbols, with caution and care.
Gritting my teeth, enduring our tribe's glare
Guarding their crudeness, their raw despair.
from: Bastien-Lepage
Deutsche Version
Disqualifizierter Mythos
Was hat der Tempel falsch gemacht?
Was haben die Jahresringe verbrochen?
Erinnerungen an Gewürze sind zart
Über Unsterblichkeit haben wir oft gesprochen.
Verachte nicht den unbekannten Gott
Seine Macht ist grenzenlos, glaub mir.
Er regiert Dörfer ohne Schulen
Und Wohnhäuser mit bewaffneten Wachen dabei.
Er ist ein Meister im Herstellen
Von Pfirsichholzschwertern, menschlichen Thangkas, alten Zaubersprüchen.
Als ein gemäßigter Gott
Verschlingt er nicht alle Jungen und Mädchen im Licht.
Er lädt mich ein, in der Vollmondnacht zu kommen
Verspricht, dass ich aus alten Papieren starte und ein ganzes Jahrhundert rette.
Aber wer bin ich?
Was kann ein Geschichtenerzähler gegen einen Lineal oder Fußfessel tun?
Seitdem zwanzig Narzissten öffentlich auf dem Platz gehängt wurden
Habe ich gelernt, Sterne wie David zu zeichnen
Meine Zähne fest zusammenbeißen, geduldig das Vulgäre und das Störrische meiner Leute bewachen.
from: Rembrandt

Mythe Disqualifié
Pourquoi la faute du temple?
Pourquoi celle des anneaux d'âge?
Les souvenirs d'épices, ils sont doux et souples
D'immortalité, nous en avons trop entendu à chaque étape.
Ne sous-estimez pas le dieu anonyme
Sa puissance est vaste, sans mesure
Dominant villages sans écoles, tours pleines de gardes armés
Il maîtrise les épées en bois de pêcher, les thangkas en peau humaine, et les sorts qui durent.
Dieu modéré, il ne dévore pas tous les jeunes sous le soleil
Il m'invite à goûter sa salive lors d'une nuit de pleine lune
Promettant un retour d'un siècle, depuis un tas de vieux papiers.

Que peut le conteur face à une règle ou un bracelet?
Depuis que vingt arrogants furent pendus en public
J'ai appris à dessiner des symboles semblables à l'étoile de David
Je serre les dents, défendant patiemment la grossièreté et l'obstination de ma tribu.
