P4 Theater and You
2023-08-30
Theory and Methods
Comments on "The Last Rehearsal"｜Start telling--Wang Yanan
Those anxious, contradictory, painful, crazy people, the world has a huge exploitation, devouring consumption, dissipating powerlessness
I saw you when I lost interest in everything
Those anxious, contradictory, painful, crazy people, the world has a huge exploitation, devouring consumption, dissipating powerlessness
I am looking for a theory to transform, transcend, and guide my practice.
I once doubted the complex motives of all my actions, so I stopped, punched that shallow believer, and wiped out my dead father who was still and unyielding. I used symbols to organize an airtight membrane, many things were suppressed and knotted, my life was stagnant, and the cracked gaps separated me from the world. Desperately waiting for a miracle to overthrow my existence and stimulate my desire, because existence is to face all experiences, to face anxiety and pain, disappointment and despair, that is you, that is life, that is everything to you.
I once sealed myself to draw a map, and I am finally going to set off
Go forward at the edge of the map.
i see you
I looked at P4 Theater record and I felt like I was inside the camera that was recording.
I love a richness that is a luxury and a lack to me. I once sealed off my desires to resist the control of the ideological machine. I once cut myself off from the world and resisted desperately. But I finally came to this theater, a possibility of return, facing the desire to open up.
This show mocked me, the flashing lights in the waiting room were provocative
turning point
with
interrupt
The story shatters into countless signifier fragments, meaningless, struggling to erupt in expressions that are truer than truth. A reorganization of boundaries, the breathing of desire.
I've always hated dramatic accents. Who the hell would use that accent? Hypocritically practicing lewd chanting and speaking with perfect pronunciation like a slave. A bunch of graceful bitches. The truth can only pass through in the broken, dark and flickering whispers, and the hoarse shouts when it breaks out should be heard clearly. Only by letting go of superficial restrictions and breaking the shackles of power and approaching can you be worthy of hearing these subtle narrations. There is no flattery, no submission, how brave sincerity we need to break the endless falsehood, shoulder the despair of surrender, and approach the impossible reality. I once again tore off the film, gasping for breath to re-exist, seeking connection and expression, anticipating desire and disillusionment.
I want to come back to life again, tear myself apart and breathe
Postscript
On the eve of the performance of "The Last Rehearsal", Yanan suddenly told me that he wanted to watch it. He groped his way to P4 Theater in the psychoanalysis group, and his mind was filled with endless theories and slang. Then, after standing there for three hours from Shijiazhuang, he came to Beijing. Along the way, he found Sashimi Bookstore and watched the performance. He told me that he needed desire. I said, start taking action today and let your consciousness pop out the magazine.

理论与方法
p4终章 | 最后的排练公演 | 爱、死亡、人类投降派
警告： 这是最后的一次警告 朋友们，26号，这周六，来一起聚聚
01马斯克说宇宙可能是虚拟的，人类世界也只不过只是代码串。他要去火星，而有的人则还要去月球，不是那个阿姆斯特朗踩的那个，而是在水里的，梦里的那个。
02我今天打开电脑，插上硬盘盒，发现无法读取，那里有我本科和研究生拍的上百万张照片和成堆视频素材，生命总有这样的巧合，你积累了一辈子的东西在一秒内就格式化了。
03明天就是书写历史最后的一页了，我已经无比焦躁与厌烦。我从不去看戏，也不看电影，太无聊了，舞台上和屏幕里透出那恶心的说教味，太呛了。小时候玩捉迷藏时的兴奋劲为什么永远地消失了？
04打开手机满屏的广告让我应激，短视频里循环的背景乐直接作呕，到处都是教你赚钱保你幸福的承诺，每一天都得看着波士顿龙虾才能啃下甜美的馒头。身上的血清素化作再来一杯的豪迈，唯有醉在梦里才喘了口气。
05人类投降派，情感粉碎机，冰冷石头人，冷暖九重天。你还能感受到那个更大的东西吗？她挥舞着我的双手，就转、转起来了，整个空间都开始转起来了。最后的演奏，把想说的话讲给你听，把藏匿的伤扒给你看，把我的温度传给你，让我的爱死而复生。
06明天，是p4剧场的终章，帷幕会缓缓降落，8年的戏剧实践之路也将画上句号。成为那个人，那个独一无二的人吧，世界会因为你而不再是代码，就算虚拟也会铭刻你的永恒。
《人类投降派》之最后的排练
事件：人类投降派电影杀青的最后演出
时间：2023/8/26（星期六）19:30

门票：99元（赠送酒水一杯）
详细咨询：加机长（p4theater03）

与经历：
人类投降派 A 黄蒙——《…然后你又变成了小女孩…》
曾参与共创北风剧社《波菲利娅》、口死戏剧《绞肉机》、101剧团《黑色三重奏》、戏剧沙龙《杀死母亲》，在《最后的排练》中是表演者
人类投降派 B孙甲瑞——《这是最后的排演！是真的！都是真的》
曾发起p4剧场《共产剧本》，参与共创p4剧场《恋爱戏剧》、101剧团《黑色三重奏》、乌镇竞演《交织》，在《最后的排练》中是表演者
人类投降派 C徐帅——《让我成为鲸落吧，我拥有的太少了，太少了》
曾参与共创p4剧场《成分破浪》、《四目》，在《最后的排练》中是表演者
人类投降派 D恽剑辉——《再来一次》
曾发起p4剧场《全球私映》，参与共创p4剧场《成分破浪》、《恋爱戏剧》，在《最后的排练》中是记录者
人类投降派 R赵轩——《 “ 北京第一实验 ”》
曾发起口死戏剧《绞肉机》，参与共创p4剧场《恋爱戏剧》，在《最后的排练》中是演奏者
人类投降派 K入梦 ——《耳膜撕裂者》
曾发起p4U计划《天台上的嚎叫者》、p4X挑战《入梦工作坊》，参与紫色行动《决斗俱乐部》、北风剧社《波菲利娅》、口死戏剧《绞肉机》，在《最后的排练》中是演奏者

何发——《《人类投降派》始末——外星人还会再次降临吗？》
发起《人类投降派》电影，在《最后的排练》中作为幕后制作人
以上图片皆可点击，会跳转到每个人为演出所写文章。
Warning
这绝对不是一场戏剧，它是一次沟通，你也不是观众，是儿时的伙伴，树上的猫，邻居家的大狗。
这也不是看完就散场的电影，它总要发生点什么，在日落以后，在月亮还没被吞噬之前。
这更不会是曲终人散的悲歌，而是欢快的小调再伴着马蹄声敲打街道，夜莺在玫瑰花丛嬉笑。
《最后的排练》是一场结合戏剧表演、行为艺术、声音现场、艺术装置为一体的文化艺术交流活动，当晚的演出会持续一个小时以上。整个的过程中我们非常期待与观众的互动参与，其中还会有全程的摄影记录，并最终会被放入到《人类投降派》电影中。
8月26号的演出一生只有一次，希望我们和你可以渡过一个美妙的夜晚，一起感受艺术带给我们奇妙的生命体验。此次表演者都写在海报上，如果想了解更多信息可以关注公众号p4剧场。

P4 Theater
2023-08-25
Theory and method
Human Surrender
P4 Finale: The Last Rehearsal, Love, Death, and Human Surrender
A public entry for P4's finale, The Last Rehearsal, linking love, death, Human Surrender, and the final performance event.
01 Musk said that the universe may be virtual, and the human world is just a string of codes. He is going to Mars, and some people are going to the moon, not the one that Armstrong stepped on, but the one in the water, in the dream.
02 Today I turned on my computer and plugged in the hard disk case, and found that I couldn't read it. There were millions of photos and piles of video material taken by my undergraduate and graduate students. There is always such a coincidence in life. The things you have accumulated for a lifetime will be formatted in a second.
03Tomorrow will be the last page of writing history, and I am extremely anxious and bored. I never go to the theater or watch movies. They are too boring. There is such a disgusting preaching smell on the stage and on the screen, which is so irritating. Why did the excitement of playing hide and seek as a child disappear forever?
04 The advertisements that fill the screen of my mobile phone make me stressed. The looping background music in the short video makes me nauseous. There are promises to teach you how to make money and keep you happy everywhere. I have to watch Boston lobster every day to eat the sweet steamed buns. The serotonin in my body turned into the courage to have another drink, and I could only take a breath while drunk in my dream.
05Human Surrender, emotional crusher, cold stone man, cold and warm nine heavens. Can you still feel that bigger thing? She waved my hands and started spinning. The whole space began to spin. In the final performance, I will tell you what I want to say, show you the hidden wounds, pass on my warmth to you, and bring my love back to life.

2022年4月的某一天，恽剑辉第二次见到何发。恽剑辉.何发.曲文豪去杭州天目里附近的一个超市买东西，结账的时候何发和恽剑辉在门口，他对他说：“我最近在研究滨口龙介，他那个东西太好了。”
以下文字与音乐来自于《人类投降派》恽剑辉
2022年4月的某一天，恽剑辉第二次见到何发。恽剑辉.何发.曲文豪去杭州天目里附近的一个超市买东西，结账的时候何发和恽剑辉在门口，他对他说：“我最近在研究滨口龙介，他那个东西太好了。”
2023年1月，《滨口龙介：那些欢乐时光》出版。
2023年4月《人类投降派》开始启动，最开始的剧组一直在研究滨口龙介的《亲密》，恽剑辉觉得那是滨口最好的一部电影。
2023年7月，双胞胎把《亲密》里的台词写进《人类投降派》剧本。
2023年8月22日，恽剑辉在一个下班回家的夜里打开网盘，想随便挑一个短的电影看。于是他随手打开了《偶然与想象》。
Part3：再来一次。
“Xeron:一种利用网络协议弱点进行传播的电脑病毒，入侵电脑后，将用户硬盘内的文件随机并持续发送至既有联络邮箱，病毒也随之传播，自2019年末发现该病毒以来，病毒感染已导致大到国家小到家庭的所有‘秘密信息’惨遭泄露。因此，代理商.大型企业.学术研究机构，上至国家机关，都互相解除网络连接，依赖网络的社会运转系统彻底停滞。半年之后，人们通过重新使用邮政与电信作为通信手段回到了数十年前的状况，世界由此重建了社会运转系统，目前仍未能普及安全网络结构，网络依然被禁用。这样的状态是一时的还是永恒的，无人知晓。”

我向着人群扑去，他们的尖叫声在我的耳边回荡。 这让我感到无与伦比的快乐。
以下文字与音乐来自于《人类投降派》入梦
在梦中，我成了一个无敌的丧尸，站在城市的中心，周围是一片废墟和破碎的建筑。我的眼睛发出绿色的光芒，我可以感受到街道上每一丝微弱的动静。我发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，房屋倒塌，街道瞬间变成了混乱。
我用坚硬的指甲撕裂着建筑物的外墙，发出撕裂金属的声音。人们惊恐地奔逃，但在我的面前，一切都显得微不足道。我用强大的力量挥动着手臂，街道上的车辆被抛向空中，像玩具一样被我摧毁。我的每一步都伴随着地面的震动，大楼在我面前轰然倒塌。
我感到饥渴，需要寻找更多的人类来满足。我向着人群扑去，他们的尖叫声在我的耳边回荡。无论他们如何挣扎，都无法逃脱我的掌控。我像是无形的死神，带来毁灭和恐惧。
这让我感到无与伦比的快乐。

Since the virus was discovered at the end of 2019, virus infection has caused the leakage of all 'secret information' ranging from countries to small families. Therefore, agents, large enterprises, and academic research institutions Institutions, all the way up to state agencies, were disconnected from each other, and the social operation system that relied on the Internet was completely stagnant. Half a year later, people returned to the situation of decades ago by reusing postal and telecommunications as communication methods. The world has thus rebuilt the social operation system. At present, safe network structures have not been popularized, and the network is still disabled. No one knows whether this state is temporary or permanent. "

I threw myself at the crowd, their screams echoing in my ears. This makes me feel unparalleled happiness.
The following text and music come from "Human Surrender" Dreaming
In the dream, I became an invincible zombie, standing in the center of the city, surrounded by ruins and broken buildings. My eyes glowed green and I could feel every faint movement in the street. I let out a deafening roar, houses collapsed, and the streets instantly turned into chaos.
I tore at the exterior of the building with my hard nails, making the sound of ripping metal. People ran away in fear, but everything seemed insignificant in front of me. I waved my arms with such force that the vehicles on the street were thrown into the air and destroyed by me like toys. The ground shook with every step I took, and the building collapsed in front of me.
I felt hungry and needed to find more humans to satisfy. I threw myself at the crowd, their screams echoing in my ears. No matter how hard they struggle, they cannot escape my grasp. I am like the invisible god of death, bringing destruction and fear.
This makes me feel unparalleled joy.

盯着那个窟窿看了很久，从不认为它是无限的，从不认为自己是有限的。
以下文字来自于《人类投降派》赵轩
“投降”
只是一段
命令、口号、密钥
盯着那个窟窿看了很久，从不认为它是无限的，从不认为自己是有限的。
哪里冒出来的一连串“不要、不要、不要…！” ——至此由里面翻到外面，把外面翻进里面，有人大笑了起来。
迈步便坠入，像之前无数次一样，又回到了世界的底部。那里堆叠满了不可名状的欲望，微弱的杀生和电流，仅仅通过一只布满血丝的眼睛向外窥视着。
我真的飞行过一段吧？用烂泥一般的身体，打出光谱的颜色，我真的见到过天空吧？那一刻无数的死亡都放下了罪孽，如今他们搀扶着我，也缠绕着我，缓缓地放下我。
我醉得太厉害，听到天使吹响号角。
不可传达，不可道。在这牢笼里日复一日地打转，发狂，自残，直到对鲜血的渴求到达一种呆滞的宁静，才开始极为缓慢地挪动，似病虎。
我知道那一天将要到来：多么戏谑，多么玩闹，多么悠哉悠哉，多么自由自在。
多少生灵涂炭，当周围的空气随着我的心颤动，唯一的眼泪流干。我不再麻木，不再疼痛，我的每一根神经都变得性感好色，并且隐隐作怒。
这是我最后的形态，这是草木以一个猎手的姿态。怀着极大的胃口，贪婪的爪牙，一点一点，用春雨，吞噬人类的梦。

The following text comes from "Human Surrender" Zhao Xuan
"surrender"
Just a paragraph
Command, slogan, key
I stared at that hole for a long time, never thinking that it was infinite, never thinking that I was limited.
A series of "Don't, don't, don't...!" appeared out of nowhere - at this point, it was turned from the inside out, and the outside inside, and someone burst out laughing.
As soon as I took a step, I fell, like countless times before, back to the bottom of the world. There was a pile of indescribable desires, weak killing and electric current, just peering out through a bloodshot eye.
Did I actually fly for a while? Using a mud-like body to create the colors of the spectrum, have I really seen the sky? At that moment, countless deaths gave up their sins. Now they support me, wrap around me, and slowly let me go.
I was so drunk that I heard angels blowing trumpets.
It cannot be conveyed, it cannot be said. In this cage, he was spinning around day after day, going crazy and self-mutilating, until his thirst for blood reached a sluggish tranquility, and then he began to move extremely slowly, like a sick tiger.
I know that day is coming: how playful, how playful, how carefree, how free.
How many lives have been devastated. When the air around me trembles with my heart, my only tear dries up. I was no longer numb, no longer in pain, every nerve in me became sexy, lustful, and secretly angry.
This is my final form, this is the grass and trees in the posture of a hunter. With a huge appetite, greedy minions, bit by bit, use spring rain to devour human dreams.

以下文字来自于《人类投降派》黄蒙
此刻我终于明白我应该说点什么才导致了我一句话都说不出来，脑子里有太多太多太多毛骨悚然的丑八怪正在活动了。我常常会想起自己做的梦，奶奶去世后，我经常梦见她，有一次我躺在床上，她站在床前面对着我，我看到她背后有一道光，白色的光带有一点绿色和蓝色，很诡异也很神圣，我叫她可是她不说话眼睛死死盯着我，我想起床可身体完全不受控制。通过走廊我看见客厅里有黄色灯光，我喊叫可是一句也没说出口。奶奶还是在看着我，我快看不清她的脸了，她的脸变得好模糊，我好怕她的模样就这样消失，当我再次看清时，我看到的不再是她了，而是我的表弟，他也死死盯着我不说话，我知道他在埋怨我，我疯狂说了好多话可是一句话都没说出口，他什么也听不见，我全身变得僵硬了，我沉默了。意识 已经弹出弹夹。昨天当我再想起这个梦时，我感到害怕我对一切都充满了恐惧，包括我的家。
好了，我现在对你的记忆快要变成碎片了，我不知道我为什么要写下这些…我小时候很快乐，你也很快乐，然后你变得不说话了，他们总说你每天就坐在一个地方，死死盯着一个点也不看电视，然后大家开始每天轮流提醒你吃药，然后你就不能走路不能动不能记住你的家人…然后你又变成了小女孩…
我知道，我知道大家都很痛苦很煎熬。
昨晚看了甲瑞说的《飞向太空》，看了一半因为恐惧我关掉了手机，放了一个多小时的音乐入梦，恍恍惚惚间我看见了那个倔强极端的初中生女孩，看见了赵轩雨桐甲瑞子丑，我看见了大家。

They always say that you just sit in one place every day, staring at nothing and not watching TV, and then everyone starts taking turns reminding you to...
The following text comes from "Human Surrender" Huang Meng
At this moment, I finally understood what I should say because I couldn't say a word. There were too many creepy ugly monsters active in my mind. I often think of my dreams. After my grandma passed away, I often dreamed about her. Once I was lying on the bed and she was standing in front of the bed facing me. I saw a light behind her, a white light with a little green and blue. It was very strange and sacred. I called her but she didn't speak and stared at me. I wanted to get up but my body was completely out of control. Through the corridor I saw a yellow light in the living room. I shouted but no words came out. Grandma was still looking at me. I could hardly see her face clearly. Her face had become so blurry. I was so afraid that her appearance would disappear. When I saw it clearly again, what I saw was no longer her, but my cousin. He stared at me and said nothing. I knew he was blaming me. I said a lot of crazy words but I didn't say a word. He couldn't hear anything. My whole body became stiff and I was silent. Consciousness: The magazine has been ejected. When I thought about this dream again yesterday, I felt scared. I was terrified of everything, including my home.
Well, my memory of you is about to fall into pieces now, and I don't know why I am writing this... I was very happy when I was a child, and you were also very happy, and then you became silent. They always said that you sat in one place every day, staring at a spot without watching TV, and then everyone started taking turns reminding you to take medicine every day, and then you couldn't walk, move, or remember your family... Then you turned into a little girl again...
I know, I know everyone is in pain and suffering.
Last night I watched "Flying to Space" written by Jia Rui. Halfway through the movie, I turned off my phone out of fear and played music for more than an hour to fall asleep. In a trance, I saw that stubborn and extremely stubborn junior high school girl, I saw Zhao Xuanyu Tong Jia Ruizi Chou, and I saw everyone.

8月初刚回北京的时候，脑子是破碎的，精神萎缩，同他人隔了一层厚玻璃，喊话呀，交流都不自在极了，恍惚间感到被所有规则踢出去，孤立到一个缺氧的小盒子里，然后蜷缩在那里，内部有个大窟窿噗噗噗往外流汤，真正的核变成很小很小一个，我也不知道我这是怎么了，可能现在依然会不时感到这个，然后这个时间点何发问我要不要来拍戏，我就来了。
人类投降派总算不上是什么伟大的作品，不过是孩童的小打小闹，真真假假，半梦半醒，然后扮演那个酷酷的，独立的，人类拯救者的样貌，去记录一些过程，来异化自己，像我们每天都在问价值在哪价值在哪，那我现在说，没价值，不存在这个东西，有的只是我们，和我们之间的关系，和你的关系而已，它可能看完之后不会让你记很久，也可能看一半你就看不下去了，也可能你泪流满面，这都是好的，最好的，这就是我们人类啊。
我的病灶是在更深的地方，不是抑郁症，双向情感障碍，自闭症之类显而易见的东西，而是更深处，那个观测不到，碰不到的，得到精心伪装的某物，用它粗糙坚硬的表面慢慢打磨我的心壁，慢慢等死，死后成为鲸落，我拥有的太少了，才能啊，财富啊，爱之类的，通通少得可怜，但我却不自知，或者转移注意力，放在与我无关的外界，甚至连存在本身都是痛的，不能再忍耐，该放血了。

When I first returned to Beijing in early August, my brain was broken and my spirit was atrophied. I was separated from others by a layer of thick glass. I felt extremely uncomfortable shouting and communicating. I felt kicked out of all the rules in a daze, isolated in a small box lacking oxygen, and then curled up there. Then at this time, He Fa asked me if I wanted to come to the filming, so I came.

You may not remember it for a long time after watching it, or you may not be able to watch it until halfway through, or you may burst into tears. This is all good, the best, and this is us humans.

Even existence itself is painful. I can't bear it anymore, it's time to bleed.

我坐在黑车上，刚结束在朋友家的聚会。朋友说我应该写一篇推文，为了26号的演出。
以下文字来自于《人类投降派》孙甲瑞
我坐在黑车上，刚结束在朋友家的聚会。朋友说我应该写一篇推文，为了26号的演出。
小时候我很讨厌拍照，一种源自天然的厌恶。每当我看到照片里的自己，我总会忍不住评判他，我厌恶ta，不愿意承认ta是对于我的记录。我是什么？我并不是被转印在相片的呢个彩色影子，我也不是未被转印前站在景框内的身体。
黑车司机一路超速，在高速上左拐右拐超过每一辆走在他前面的车。
大学时要拍作业，找演员总是很困难的事情，迫不得已，我开始频繁在朋友们的作业里担任各种角色。我不喜欢电影里的自己，最简单的，我觉得被拍下的自己很丑，于是除非必要，我几乎不会回看素材，除非要担任剪辑的工作。
长时间盯着自己被拍摄下的脸是痛苦的，但我一遍又一遍出现在画面里，又一次次被破剪辑充满了“自己”的素材。这对我来说是一种苦刑。
他开得这么快，我相信他会觉得危险，我相信他同样不在意。他也是从什么地方逃过来的，他也想回到什么地方吗？
毕业后我自然而然想避免这些，但三年下来我唯一能被人需要的地方只有“扮演”，来北京后我仍然只能靠这种方法进入这里，我通过“扮演”认识大家，通过“扮演”成为大家的朋友。
这是我唯一能被需要的行动。
毫不减速的左转，我们都被向右甩去。拐过这个弯之后，就到燕郊了。
偶然的，这半年内我再次开始频繁担任演员的角色。每当有人问我要不要帮忙出演某某，我都会顺口回答“当然可以”，又在答应后惊叹自己为什么能说得如此轻易，语言脱离了我的掌握按着固定的程式倾吐出来。于是我在各种角色间流转，转到现在。
但这是最后的了，26号是我最后的演出，之后我会刻意停止下去，直到某个巨大的契机或者永远没有。
我在家里的电脑上写下这些。我是什么时候到家的？
这是残破的偏颇的文字，与真实相距甚远。我将它们组合形成了一个或许有逻辑的东西，但在现实里这些都不存在。同样的，我可以写下一段对“表演”充满热爱的段落，但它也一样与现实毫无关系。这都不重要，重要的是我为聚在一起的人们感动，我枯竭在现实里的爱，将在舞台上倾倒出来。在那一刻，我会为大家祈祷，在那一刻，所有东西都是真的，在那一刻，我的爱也终于是真的，在那一刻，我停止怀疑，于是所有所有所有所有的，都是真的。
这是最后的排演
《最后的排练》是一场结合戏剧表演、行为艺术、声音现场、艺术装置为一体的文化艺术交流活动，当晚的演出会持续一个小时以上。整个的过程中我们非常期待与观众的互动参与，其中还会有全程的摄影记录，并最终会被放入到《人类投降派》电影中。
8月26号的演出一生只有一次，希望我们和你可以渡过一个美妙的夜晚，一起感受艺术带给我们奇妙的生命体验。此次表演者都写在海报上，如果想了解更多信息可以关注公众号p4剧场。

门票：99元（赠送酒水一杯）
详细咨询：加机长（p4theater03）
购票：扫绿色二维码
四月份开始我开始梦到排练和演出，六月份开始梦到这些的频率逐渐上升了。从什么时候开始的呢？在梦里演出和现实的界限变得模糊了，是戏蔓延到生活里了，还是现实蔓延到戏中了，分不清楚。上一秒还是排练，下一秒就在舞台上了，上一秒还在演出，下一秒就是聚会了。这一切都是这么真，没有丝毫怀疑，我顺着它的时间流淌下去，一切都很自然。
我想说的不是这个，我不知道我想说什么。

The following text comes from "Human Surrender" Sun Jiarui
I was sitting in the black car and had just finished a party at a friend's house. A friend said I should write a tweet for the show on the 26th.
As a child I hated taking pictures, a natural aversion. Whenever I see myself in a photo, I can't help but judge him. I hate him and I don't want to admit that he is a record of me. What am I? I am not the colored shadow that was transferred to the photo, nor am I the body standing in the frame before being transferred.
The driver of the black car was speeding all the way, turning left and right on the highway to pass every car in front of him.
When I was in college, it was always difficult to find actors when filming assignments. As a last resort, I began to frequently play various roles in my friends' assignments. I don't like myself in the movie. The simplest thing is that I think the picture of myself is ugly, so I almost never look back at the material unless necessary, unless I have to be an editor.
It was painful to stare at my own photographed face for a long time, but I appeared in the picture again and again, and the editing was broken and filled with "myself" material again and again. It was torture for me.
I'm sure he felt it was dangerous for him to be driving so fast, and I'm sure he didn't care either. He also escaped from somewhere. Does he also want to return to somewhere?
After graduation, I naturally wanted to avoid these things, but after three years, the only place where I was needed was through "acting." After coming to Beijing, I still had to rely on this method to get in here. I got to know everyone through "acting" and became everyone's friends through "acting."
This is the only action I can take.
Turning left without slowing down, we were all thrown to the right. After turning this corner, we arrived at Yanjiao.
By chance, within the past six months I began to frequently take on the role of an actor again. Whenever someone asks me if I want to help play a certain role, I will answer "Of course", and after agreeing, I will marvel at why I can speak so easily. The language escapes my control and is poured out according to a fixed program. So I moved between various roles and moved to the present.
But this is the last. The 26th is my last performance. After that, I will deliberately stop until there is a huge opportunity or never.
I'm writing this on my computer at home. When did I get home?
This is a broken and biased text, far from the truth. I combined them into something that might make sense, but in reality none of that exists. Likewise, I could write a paragraph full of love for "performance," but it would also have nothing to do with reality. None of this is important. What is important is that I am moved by the people gathered together. The love that I have exhausted in reality will be poured out on the stage. At that moment, I will pray for everyone. At that moment, everything is true. At that moment, my love is finally true. At that moment, I stop doubting, so everything, everything, is true.
This is the final rehearsal

In the dream, the boundary between performance and reality becomes blurred. It is unclear whether the play has spread into life or reality has spread into the play. sources.text:
p4剧场和你
2023-08-18
活动与演出
艺术公演 |《人类投降派》始末——外星人还会再次降临吗？
《Last Rehearsal》演出26号，在刺鱼书店（中间剧场店），欢迎大家来玩
p4剧场成立于15年，我接触戏剧制作则是在13年，当时参与了一个朋友的戏剧叫《我可怜的马拉特》，当时我就被戏剧这个形式深深地吸引了。大学时候也看过《恋爱的犀牛》，不过印象很弱，只记得满舞台的水，和被绑着的女人，还有一条大蛇在上方盘旋，剩下全忘了。
我是一个非常内向的人，从小就是一个边缘般存在的人，不合群，也从来没当过班干部，成绩不好又不爱耍宝从来没出过什么风头。印象中只有在不写作业或是作弊被抓的时候被老师当众羞辱过几次，才明白万众瞩目的滋味。我不喜欢背诵，我讨厌翻来覆去做无意义的事情，所以爱上了绘画。还记得当时学画素描，要画球，我可以为了球的边缘线画上一整天，我一直在不断地切它，直到与我心目中的圆相吻合。
我小学四年级曾在亲戚家渡过，他们对我不错，可离开妈妈的生活还是让我感受到了一种别样的孤独，每个周末她会来看我，离别后我会趴在窗户透过铁栅栏目送她从楼道口右拐消失。有一次，我从姨夫的杂物柜里偷偷翻出了一本叫《世界未解之谜》的旧书，从来不看书的我一下子被吸了进去，从此这本书就一直在我的书包里，我反复的读它。里头讲的是各种奇人异事，关于全宇宙，关于特异功能，关于多维世界。有一天夜里，我看到窗户外有蓝色的光点忽闪忽闪，我又紧张又兴奋又恐惧，最后安慰自己可能只是玻璃的反光，就睡了。
后来，当了艺术生，进了美院，我选了摄影作为专业，一天到晚的拍，可我并拍不好人，我抬起相机的时候，对象恐惧，我也恐惧。我大学四年只把镜头对准了风景和街道，我害怕人类。一张张面具让我感到陌生与疏离，我按下的快门摄取的只有虚伪，而无真实。直到13年我和大学谈了三年的女友分手后，我才明白过来。爱是什么。
我具有了一种新的感知力，当开关开启的时刻，可以迸发或接受到各种神奇的波动。直到这个时候，我才明白了摄影是什么，才渐渐读懂了镜子后面的像，当你敞开的时候，它会向你走来。两个人的旋转，不再是一个人了，是一起转动，是一种超越言说的理解，是接受与传递变得毫无阻碍，像新生，像游泳，像魔鬼爱上天使，像龙人听见声音。
p4剧场就是这样开始的转动，欲望着实践所有的梦想，尽情在里头去与一切旋转，尝试与一切共舞，产生回荡。变奏、休止、震颤、连音、复调、乱拍、和声、切切，把一切能想到的佐料都放进去乱炖，炼成我要的未来，让梦照进现实。如今，已然8年，无数的梦被生成，无数的梦也破灭，一个个灵魂在这里找寻同伴与激荡，当然也会迎来毁灭与打击，失望、落空、遗憾、惆怅、愤怒、悲伤却越来越成为常态。“现实”总要一次次冲击这个颤巍巍的泡泡，让自恋的毒刺长的更尖，让盔甲装配的更厚，让镜子里的面具愈发的狰狞，让“我”不能输，必须成为他人的王。
泡泡很脆，维持它却费了大劲，一次梦中醒来，决定要拍一个电影，名字叫《人类投降派》，这个是我多年的愿望，而它却在梦中告知我必须去实现。电影是什么？我又是什么？而这一次，摄影机又得去往哪里呢？
犹德士从外地又回到了北京，刚下火车就要来510。恽剑辉借来了朋友的电影机，双胞胎熟练的使用ChatGPT来进行文章的翻译，我也轻松地编造了一个关于自由风的传说：她在那看着我们，关心着我们，我们的一举一动都被她所熟知。她向我们许诺，只要我们继续坚持下去，做出好作品，就会有大把大把的投资过来，到时候我们大家都会过上幸福的日子。我在装模作样的面试，而太过于拙劣的谎言也把现实衬的额外逼真。
没有钱也没有什么观众，只有自娱自乐和孤芳自赏，还有无病呻吟和故弄玄虚，对对对，再加上死气白咧和前功尽弃。这个愚蠢的想法就这么一直在奇异的摇摆中一次次滚入无尽的深渊。这就是人类投降派，只有把自己放入到自己搅拌的故事中去，一切就开始焕发生机。就像当犹德士对着镜头说下的那句话一样，这不是一个电影，这不是一个戏剧，这是一个东西。这句话仍然在激励着我继续将《人类投降派》的故事讲完。我非常强力地感受到我的命运与这个东西共转，它还在源源不断不断地召唤着一种活力，就像我一定会在26号遇见你。
《最后的排练》是一场结合戏剧表演、行为艺术、声音现场、艺术装置为一体的文化艺术交流活动，当晚的演出会持续一个小时以上。整个的过程中我们非常期待与观众的互动参与，其中还会有全程的摄影记录，并最终会被放入到《人类投降派》电影中。
8月26号的演出一生只有一次，希望我们和你可以渡过一个美妙的夜晚，一起感受艺术带给我们奇妙的生命体验。此次表演者都写在海报上，如果想了解更多信息可以关注公众号p4剧场。
《人类投降派》之最后的排练
事件：人类投降派电影杀青的最后演出
时间：2023/8/26（星期六）19:30
地点：刺鱼书店（中间剧场店）
门票：99元（赠送酒水一杯）
详细咨询：加机长（p4theater03）
购票：扫绿色二维码
当然，真正的《人类投降派》电影的拍摄与排练工作是相当精彩与惊喜的，电影也将在26号《Last Rehearsal》演出完后杀青完结。首先必须要感谢最终在26号演出《Last Rehearsal》的三位极有才华的演员，黄蒙、甲瑞和徐帅，认识他们是我做p4剧场最大的礼物，感谢他们对我的信任与支持，这种爱是超越的。还有就是摄影师恽剑辉，他是最早的发起者之一，也一直肩负摄影的重任，可惜的是拍摄后期因为工作原因错过了一些精彩的共创瞬间。周锦松和刘锦祺他们也是最早参与电影构想的两人，他们一边进行着大部分的记录任务，一边也提供创意、编写剧本，深度参与制作，年纪虽轻但极有主见，希望早日看到他们自己的作品。演员廖威因为工作调动没法参与后期的排练非常非常的可惜，期待日后与他更多的合作。入梦这次作为音乐制作人为投降派所作作品展现出了高超的专业素养，并会在26号一同进行现场声音表演。赵轩作为众多角色的幕后原形，常下场示范为我们带来灵感，此次她会用声音出席演出。向于彬彬、吴景茜、李泽阳她们在电影中饰演着各色有挑战的角色，在排练中非常能感受到他们的能量与无限的潜能。赵子毅是噪音界的新星，非常期待他的当天的现场噪音表演。当然，未来会写更多文章和剪辑视频来细述这段《人类投降派》的历史，由于这次实在是篇幅有限，还有太多人需要感谢，他们分别是，犹德士、克鲁泡泡羊、谢一鹏、曹健松、张予婷、蒋嘉麟、徐锦江、刘健、勇、小李、郭倩、大炮、芭芭拉，谢谢你，谢谢你们！最后还要感谢我们的场地方，谢谢刺鱼书店的大力支持，感谢子木与黄丽。
PS：特别要说明的是此次的电影的拍摄制作并不是以往大家所熟知的电影剧组拍摄模式，而是一种深度共创式的制作，我们之间并没有非常明确的分工与雇佣关系。大家在此次事件中所担任的职责也是经常流动与变化的，演员可以成为导演，摄影师可以成为演员，记录者也是行动者，表演者也是观察者。
日常的任何一句话都有可能就成为最精彩的台词，通过我们日常的对话将彼此沁入到彼此的内心中，去碰撞、去感知、去体验。整个剧组绝对不是那种演员一遍遍地去念台词与完成镜头，然后等“独裁”导演喊cut的呆板任务模式，而是大家一起去大自然中冒险，去探寻一种超越社会符号的深层连接，去摸索一种可以对抗未来不可测危机与变化的方法，去呼唤一种可以重新搭建信任与爱的回路。

P4 Theater and You

P4 Theater archive
Human Surrender
The Story of Human Surrender: Will the Aliens Return Again?
An introduction to The Story of Human Surrender: Will the Aliens Return Again?, connecting Human Surrender, The Last Rehearsal, P4 Theater...
P4 Theater was founded in 2015. I came into contact with drama production in 2013. At that time, I participated in a friend's play called "My Poor Marat". At that time, I was deeply attracted by the form of drama. I also watched "Rhinoceros in Love" when I was in college, but my impression was very weak. I only remember the water covering the stage, the tied woman, and a big snake circling above. I forgot all about the rest.
I am a very introverted person. I have been a marginal person since I was a child. I am not gregarious and have never been a class leader. I have poor grades and don't like to show off, and I have never been in the limelight. In my memory, I only understood what it feels like to be in the spotlight after being publicly humiliated by teachers a few times when I didn't do my homework or was caught cheating. I don't like reciting, and I hate doing meaningless things over and over again, so I fell in love with painting. I still remember that when I was learning to draw a ball, I could spend a whole day drawing the edge of the ball. I kept cutting it until it matched the circle in my mind.
I spent the fourth grade of elementary school at a relative's house, and they were kind to me, but living away from my mother still made me feel a different kind of loneliness. She would come visit me every weekend. After we left, I would lie on the window and look through the iron bars to watch her turn right at the entrance of the corridor and disappear. Once, I secretly dug out an old book called "The Unsolved Mysteries of the World" from my uncle's glove cabinet. I never read a book and was sucked in. From then on, this book has been in my school bag and I read it over and over again. It talks about all kinds of strange people and strange things, about the whole universe, about special powers, and about the multi-dimensional world. One night, I saw blue lights flashing outside the window. I was nervous, excited and scared. Finally, I comforted myself that it might just be the reflection of the glass, and fell asleep.
Later, when I became an art student and entered the Academy of Fine Arts, I chose photography as my major and took pictures all day long, but I was not good at photographing people. When I raised the camera, the subject was afraid, and so was I. During my four years in college, I only focused my camera on landscapes and streets. I was afraid of humans. Each mask made me feel strange and alienated. When I pressed the shutter, I captured only hypocrisy, not reality. It wasn't until 2013 when I broke up with my girlfriend who I'd been dating for three years in college that I finally understood. What is love.
I have a new kind of perception. When the switch is turned on, I can emit or receive various magical fluctuations. It was only then that I understood what photography was and gradually understood the image behind the mirror. When you open yourself up, it will come towards you. The rotation of two people is no longer one person, but they are rotating together. It is an understanding that transcends words. It is acceptance and transmission that become unhindered, like new life, like swimming, like a devil falling in love with an angel, like a dragon hearing a voice.
P4 Theater is the beginning of rotation, with the desire to realize all dreams, to rotate with everything in it, to try to dance with everything, and to produce reverberation. Variations, rests, tremors, legato, polyphony, random beats, harmonies, cuts, all the condiments imaginable are thrown in and stewed to create the future I want, and let the dream shine into reality. Now, it has been 8 years, countless dreams have been created and countless dreams have been shattered. Every soul is looking for companions and excitement here. Of course, it will also face destruction and blows. Disappointment, failure, regret, melancholy, anger, and sadness are becoming more and more normal. "Reality" will always hit this trembling bubble again and again, making the sting of narcissism grow sharper, making the armor thicker, making the mask in the mirror more ferocious, making "I" cannot lose and must become the king of others.
The bubble is very fragile, but it takes a lot of effort to maintain it. I woke up from a dream and decided to make a movie called "Human Surrender". This has been my wish for many years, but it told me in my dream that I must realize it. What is a movie? What am I? And this time, where does the camera have to go?
Yudes returned to Beijing from other places and had to come to the 510 office as soon as he got off the train. Yun Jianhui borrowed a friend's movie camera, and the twins skillfully used ChatGPT to translate the article. I also easily made up a legend about Free Wind: She was watching us there, caring about us, and she knew every move we made. She promised us that as long as we continue to persevere and produce good works, there will be a lot of investment, and then we will all live a happy life. I was pretending to be in the interview, and my lies that were too clumsy made reality look extra realistic.
There is no money and no audience, only self-entertainment and self-admiration, as well as idle moaning and mystique, yes, yes, plus a dead look and wasted effort. This stupid idea just keeps rolling into the endless abyss in strange swings. This is Human Surrender. Only when you put yourself into the story you stir, everything begins to come to life. Just like what Judith said to the camera, this is not a movie, this is not a drama, this is a thing. This sentence still inspires me to continue telling the story of "Human Surrender". I feel very strongly that my destiny is co-rotating with this thing, and it is still summoning a kind of vitality, just like I will definitely meet you on the 26th.
"The Last Rehearsal" is a cultural and art exchange event that combines drama performances, performance art, sound scenes, and art installations. The performance that night will last for more than an hour. We are very much looking forward to the interactive participation with the audience throughout the process, which will also be photographed and recorded throughout, and will eventually be included in the "Human Surrender" movie.
The performance on August 26th is a once-in-a-lifetime performance. I hope you and we can spend a wonderful night and experience the wonderful life experience that art brings to us. The performers this time are all written on the poster. If you want to know more information, you can follow the public account P4 Theater.
"Human Surrender"-The Last Rehearsal
Event: Human Surrender The final performance of the film
Time: 2023/8/26 (Saturday) 19:30
Location: Sticky Fish Bookstore (Middle Theater Store)
Ticket: 99 yuan (free drink)
Detailed consultation: Add the captain (p4theater03)
Purchase tickets: Scan the green QR code
Of course, the filming and rehearsal of the real "Human Surrender" movie are quite exciting and surprising, and the movie will be completed after the performance of "Last Rehearsal" on the 26th. First of all, I must thank the three extremely talented actors who finally performed "Last Rehearsal" on the 26th, Huang Meng, Jia Rui and Xu Shuai. Knowing them is the biggest gift for me as P4 Theater. Thank you for their trust and support in me. This kind of love is transcendent. There is also photographer Yun Jianhui. He is one of the earliest initiators and has always shouldered the important responsibility of photography. Unfortunately, he missed some wonderful co-created moments due to work reasons in the later stages of the shooting. Zhou Jinsong and Liu Jinqi were also the first two people to participate in the concept of the film. While they were doing most of the recording tasks, they also provided creative ideas, wrote scripts, and were deeply involved in the production. Although they are young, they are very independent. I hope to see their own works as soon as possible. It is a pity that actor Liao Wei was unable to participate in the later rehearsals due to work transfer. I look forward to more cooperation with him in the future. This time, Rumeng showed his superb professionalism as a music producer for the capitulationists, and will perform a live sound performance together on the 26th. As the behind-the-scenes prototype of many characters, Zhao Xuan often performs on stage to bring inspiration to us. This time she will attend the performance with her voice. Xiang Binbin, Wu Jingqian, and Li Zeyang play various challenging roles in the movie, and their energy and unlimited potential can be felt during the rehearsal. Zhao Ziyi is a rising star in the noise world and I am very much looking forward to his live noise performance that day. Of course, I will write more articles and edit videos to detail the history of "Human Surrender" in the future. Since the space this time is really limited, there are too many people to thank. They are, You Deshi, Kru Paoyang, Xie Yipeng, Cao Jiansong, Zhang Yuting, Jiang Jialin, Xu Jinjiang, Liu Jian, Yong, Xiao Li, Guo Qian, Dapao, Barbara, thank you, thank you! Finally, I would like to thank our venue, the Shandong Fish Bookstore for its strong support, and Zimu and Huang Li.
PS: It should be noted that the filming and production of this film is not the familiar film crew shooting model in the past, but an in-depth co-creation production. There is no very clear division of labor and employment relationship between us. Everyone's responsibilities in this incident are also constantly flowing and changing. Actors can become directors, photographers can become actors, recorders are also actors, and performers are also observers.
Any daily sentence may become the most wonderful line. Through our daily dialogue, we will penetrate each other into each other's hearts to collide, perceive and experience. The entire crew is definitely not the kind of rigid task mode where actors recite lines and complete shots over and over again, and then wait for the "dictator" director to call cut. Instead, everyone goes on adventures in nature to explore a deep connection that transcends social symbols, to explore a way to resist unpredictable crises and changes in the future, and to call for a circuit that can re-establish trust and love.

在不久的将来，人类与外星种族之间爆发了一场激烈的战争。人类的力量逐渐衰弱，而外星种族的统治日益加强。为了寻求和平解决方案，人类和外星种族达成了一项特殊的协议。根据协议，双方决定进行一场最后的谈判，以决定人类的命运。为了确保顺利进行，双方组织了一场名为 "Last Rehearsal" 的彩排，这场彩排旨在模拟谈判过程并做好准备。
然而，这场彩排背后却隐藏着一个惊天的阴谋，可能会彻底改变人类的未来。现在，一群勇敢的反抗者必须揭示真相并阻止阴谋的发生，否则人类将面临投降的命运。
我即是能指，亦是所指，主体于其中。
本质如风，吹拂陆地，又如水，
凝成雨，形成河川，汇入海洋。
被文字书写，亦成文字本身，符号载载其中。
疏离或是悲伤，或是音乐，
唱诵亦或不能唱诵。
沙砾微尘，宇宙浩瀚，边界广漠。
爱之化身，或将其叛变，抵十字架之罪人。
信仰与怀疑，信徒抑或，雕塑创立，
又将之折损。生命既有，亦或是排斥。
远足至远，回归起点，所至终归。
空虚无物，万象融合，一体包容。
是你的外延，亦为你的他者。
意识形态抑或主义，
概念支离，无逻辑之言，难成言语之形。
在此在彼，亦无所在，我即是你。
戏剧，乃是何物？
电影，又为何物？
生命，又是何者？
我唯有陈述，在这未曾经历之中，当其蜕变为未知与神秘，乃尔之诞生。
倦人类之傲慢自大。从幼受欺凌，饱受种种无端规条之束缚，以及暴力之袭。而对抗之方式乃将自身之残忍超越彼，然多半仍回归己身。我需持续否定之否定，以对抗荒谬世界之困顿，而于此同时，行径愈益不被人理解。
理性供予我兵器之构筑，情感给予我破限之勇气，熟稔操作十八般武艺，然终究沦为孤独之旅者，颠倒之超人，被忽视之蟑螂。不能为人所爱，不能为女子所爱，那梦中之情人，
我之月亮。
彼皆无法与我匹敌，吾欲质月球。
愿践松软之土，踏高飞起，陨石坑中与尔游戏。猛扑其门，瞬息可至，以最简、最激之方式，与尔相逢。
最后之排演，人类投降电影之终章，
敬请与我同临现场，共赏写下终局之快乐。
尔亦将与我同在电影中，尔之所为，
皆为 他之所感与演绎，余等同在，
岂非如此？

Theory and Methods
Last Rehearsal | Human Surrender's "The Last Rehearsal"

day
In the near future, a fierce war breaks out between humans and alien races. Humanity's power is gradually weakening, while the dominance of alien races is increasing. In order to find a peaceful solution, humans and alien races reached a special agreement. According to the agreement, the two sides decided to conduct a final negotiation to determine the fate of mankind. To ensure smooth progress, both parties organized a rehearsal called "Last Rehearsal", which was designed to simulate and prepare for the negotiation process.
However, there is a shocking conspiracy hidden behind this rehearsal that may completely change the future of mankind. Now, a group of brave rebels must uncover the truth and stop the conspiracy from happening, or else humanity will face surrender.
I am both the signifier and the signified, the subject within it.
The essence is like the wind, blowing the land, and like water
It condenses into rain, forms rivers, and flows into the ocean.
What is written by words also becomes the words themselves, and the symbols are carried in them.
Alienation or sadness or music
Singing or not being able to sing.
Gravel and dust, the universe is vast and its boundaries are vast.
The personification of love, or the sinner who betrays it and carries it to the cross.
Faith and doubt, believer or not, sculpture creation
And break it. Life is present, or it is rejected.
Hiking as far as you can, returning to your starting point, you will end up wherever you go.
Emptiness is nothing, everything is integrated, and one is all-encompassing.
It is your extension and also your other.
Ideology or doctrine
The concepts are fragmented, illogical, and difficult to put into words.
Here, there, and nowhere, I am you.
Drama, what is it?
Movie, what is it?
Life, what is it?
I can only state that in this unprecedented experience, when it transformed into unknown and mysterious, Nair was born.
Tired of human arrogance. He has been bullied since childhood, subjected to all kinds of unreasonable rules and violence. The way to fight is to surpass the cruelty of others, but most of it will still return to yourself. I need to continue to deny the negation in order to fight against the difficulties of the absurd world, and at the same time, my actions are becoming increasingly incomprehensible.
Reason provided me with the construction of weapons, emotions gave me the courage to break limits, and I was proficient in using eighteen kinds of martial arts. However, I eventually became a lonely traveler, an upside-down superman, and a neglected cockroach. Unable to be loved by men, unloved by women, the lover of dreams
My moon.
None of them can compete with me. I want to capture the moon.
I would like to step on the soft soil, fly high, and play with you in the crater. Pounce on its door and you will be there in an instant, meeting you in the simplest and most exciting way.
The final rehearsal, the final chapter of the movie of Human Surrender
Please come with me to the scene and enjoy the joy of writing the ending.
You will also be in the movie with me, and what you do
They are all his feelings and interpretations, and others are present
Isn't it so?

p4剧场和你

给 我 看 你 的 图 腾
给我看你的图腾给我看你的图腾管它繁复还是单纯为我解说藏地和尼泊尔手工艺的区分为我描述波斯细密画和阿拉伯书法的
给我看
你的图腾
给我看你的图腾
管它繁复还是单纯
为我解说藏地和尼泊尔手工艺的区分
为我描述波斯细密画和阿拉伯书法的绘制过程
为我直指大圆满和祖师禅的核心
告知我吉祥师子的出身
指引我领略般舟三昧法门
圆成我基于无知的天真
谅解我发乎好奇的本能
一百次救拔我于五阴炽盛
趁我尚未死于愚蠢
趁我无意向魔鬼输诚
给我看你的图腾
我们曾穿过水银灯下的通道潜入剧院
经历了瞬间失明后落座
就此错过了那瞬间闪光的表演
我们把呱噪的乌鸦的粪便踩进地面
一起踏入貌似棺椁的图书馆
一起浏览纪录男人以优雅的嗓音宣读律法的照片……
给我看你的图腾
信赖我绝不泄露你刺青的花纹
拭去我甲胄和灵台上的灰尘
对比我的刀痕与你的泪痕
照拂我们怜惜的人
让我照拂你一生
诗人简介
陈渐离
写诗的原动力几经压抑和审视，趋于不可阻止。它受到古圣先贤的召唤，如今它开始准备召唤。它被戏剧点燃又点燃了戏剧。它与影像反复较量然后一起奔赴自由。它为唤醒语言而向语言绽放并消融语言的坚冰。
是的，写诗。
编辑的话
给我看你的图腾，带我在你生命的星轨中穿梭，教导我，抚慰我，疗愈我，趁我还在呼吸，趁我还未向魔鬼屈膝投诚。
与我说一切话、讲一切事，我还是只会牙牙学语的孩童，还拥有单纯而不经掺染的心脏，请在我身体的容器上书写刻画，你的印记，我会永久珍藏。
时间停滞流动，光的颗粒消散下坠，书本与文字沉淀落寞，死亡的臭味开始发酵，我们仿佛倒退回文明的终点，双眼仅可见最原始的图腾，仅可见你的肌肤，和它白皙的光亮。
我向佛的心已随着蜡烛的燃尽而走向枯萎，我身体的容器也已爬满青苔，我丢失了武器，我的甲胄开始生锈，请允许我，将如此脆弱而赤裸裸的我，在你面前暴露，也请相信我，有能力照拂你的一生。
同时，我们也提供该诗的翻译英语、德语与法语版本，并在翻译过程中最大限度保持诗歌原有的风格与韵律。
读者在阅读时，也可感受该诗在不同语言语境下的独特与共通之处。
English Version
Reveal thy totem, let me see
Reveal thy totem, let me see
Be it complex or simple, show it to me
Distinguish the crafts of Tibet and Nepal
Describe the process of Persian art and Arabic calligraphy, tell it all
Guide me to the core of Zen and the Great Perfection
Tell me the tale of the auspicious lion's inception
Lead me to the Dharma of the Samadhi of the Boat
Immerse me in innocence, let ignorance devote
Forgive my curiosity, my instinct's call
Save me from the flames, a hundred times and all
Before I succumb to foolishness, before it's too late
Reveal thy totem, let me appreciate
Together we ventured through the theater's door
Blinded for a moment, then sat on the floor
Missing the fleeting brilliance of the show
Stepping on the crow's droppings, we continued to go
Entering a library, resembling a coffin's embrace
Perusing photos of men, reciting laws with grace
Show me thy totem, trust me with your ink
Wipe away the dust, let our scars interlink
Care for our cherished ones, with utmost devotion
Allow me to care for you, with unwavering emotion.
from: Paul Gauguin
Deutsche Version
Zeige mir dein Totem
Zeige mir dein Totem,
Ob komplex oder schlicht,
Erkläre mir den Unterschied zwischen tibetischen und nepalesischen Handwerkskünsten,
Beschreibe mir den Prozess der persischen Miniaturmalerei und der arabischen Kalligraphie,
Weise mich direkt auf das Wesentliche des großen Vollkommenen und der Zen-Weisheit hin,
Erzähle mir von der Herkunft des glücksverheißenden Löwen,
Führe mich in die Welt der Lotusboot-Sutra ein,
Vervollkommne meine Unschuld, die aus Unwissenheit geboren ist,
Verzeihe meine Neugierde,
Rette mich hundert Mal vor den brennenden Flammen der fünf Geistesgifte,
Nimm mich an, solange ich noch nicht dem Wahnsinn erlegen bin,
Nimm mich an, solange ich dem Teufel nicht die Treue schwöre,
Zeige mir dein Totem,
Wir sind durch die Tore des Quecksilberlichts geschritten und in das Theater eingetreten,
Wir haben den Moment des Blindseins erlebt und uns niedergelassen,
Und dadurch die schillernde Vorstellung verpasst,
Wir haben uns in den Kot der krächzenden Raben getreten,
Und sind gemeinsam in eine Bibliothek eingetreten, die wie ein Sarg aussah,
Gemeinsam haben wir Fotos betrachtet, auf denen Männer das Gesetz mit eleganter Stimme verlesen…
Zeige mir dein Totem,
Vertraue darauf, dass ich die Tätowierungsmuster nicht enthülle,
Wische den Staub von meiner Rüstung und meinem Geistaltar,
Vergleiche meine Narben mit deinen Tränen,
Kümmere dich um die Menschen, die uns nahestehen,
Lass mich dich ein Leben lang pflegen,
from: Paul Gauguin
Version française
Donne-moi à voir ton totem
Donne-moi à voir ton totem,
Que ce soit complexe ou simple,
Explique-moi la différence entre l’artisanat tibétain et népalais,
Décris-moi le processus de création des miniatures persanes et de la calligraphie arabe,
Montre-moi le cœur de la Grande Perfection et de la méditation des ancêtres,
Révèle-moi l’origine du lion de la bienveillance,
Guide-moi à travers la porte de la méditation du bateau de la sagesse,
Affermis mon innocence fondée sur l’ignorance,
Pardonne mon instinct de curiosité,
Sauve-moi cent fois des flammes des cinq agrégats,
Pendant que je ne suis pas encore mort dans ma stupidité,
Pendant que je ne me suis pas encore soumis aux démons,
Montre-moi ton totem,
Nous avons traversé le passage sous les lampes à mercure pour entrer dans le théâtre,
Nous avons été momentanément aveuglés avant de nous asseoir,
Manquant ainsi le spectacle éblouissant de l’instant,
Nous avons marché dans les excréments des corbeaux bruyants,
Ensemble, nous sommes entrés dans une bibliothèque qui ressemblait à un cercueil,
Ensemble, nous avons parcouru des photos d’hommes en train de réciter les lois avec élégance…
Montre-moi ton totem,
Je te promets de ne jamais révéler les motifs de ton tatouage,
Essuie la poussière de ma cuirasse et de mon esprit,
Compare mes cicatrices à tes larmes,
Prends soin des êtres qui nous sont chers,
Permet-moi de prendre soin de toi toute ta vie.
from: Paul Gauguin

Introduction to the poet
Chen Jianli
The driving force for writing poetry has been suppressed and scrutinized several times, and it becomes unstoppable. It was summoned by the ancient saints and sages, and now it begins to prepare for the summons. It is ignited by drama and ignites drama. It battles with the image over and over again and then rushes to freedom together. It blooms into language and melts its ice in order to awaken it.
Yes, write poetry.
Editor's Note
Show me your totem, take me through the starry path of your life, teach me, soothe me, heal me, while I'm still breathing, before I surrender to the devil.
Talk to me about anything and everything, and I will still be a child who can only babbling. I still have a simple and unadulterated heart. Please write and engrave on the container of my body. I will treasure your mark forever.
Time stops flowing, the particles of light dissipate and fall, books and words settle into loneliness, and the stench of death begins to ferment. We seem to have stepped back to the end of civilization. Only the most primitive totem can be seen with our eyes, only your skin and its white light.
My heart towards the Buddha has withered as the candles burn out, the container of my body has also been covered with moss, I have lost my weapons, and my armor has begun to rust. Please allow me to expose myself so fragile and naked in front of you, and please believe me, I have the ability to take care of your life.
At the same time, we also provide translated English, German and French versions of the poem, and maintain the original style and rhythm of the poem to the greatest extent during the translation process.
When reading, readers can also feel the uniqueness and commonality of the poem in different language contexts.

理论与方法
Last Rehearsal | 人类投降派之《最后的排练》
这不是戏剧，这不是电影，这是一个东西。8月26号，邀你共同体验。
在不久的将来，人类与外星种族之间爆发了一场激烈的战争。人类的力量逐渐衰弱，而外星种族的统治日益加强。为了寻求和平解决方案，人类和外星种族达成了一项特殊的协议。根据协议，双方决定进行一场最后的谈判，以决定人类的命运。为了确保顺利进行，双方组织了一场名为 "Last Rehearsal" 的彩排，这场彩排旨在模拟谈判过程并做好准备。
然而，这场彩排背后却隐藏着一个惊天的阴谋，可能会彻底改变人类的未来。现在，一群勇敢的反抗者必须揭示真相并阻止阴谋的发生，否则人类将面临投降的命运。
我即是能指，亦是所指，主体于其中。
本质如风，吹拂陆地，又如水，
凝成雨，形成河川，汇入海洋。
被文字书写，亦成文字本身，符号载载其中。
疏离或是悲伤，或是音乐，
唱诵亦或不能唱诵。
沙砾微尘，宇宙浩瀚，边界广漠。
爱之化身，或将其叛变，抵十字架之罪人。
信仰与怀疑，信徒抑或，雕塑创立，
又将之折损。生命既有，亦或是排斥。
远足至远，回归起点，所至终归。
空虚无物，万象融合，一体包容。
是你的外延，亦为你的他者。
意识形态抑或主义，
概念支离，无逻辑之言，难成言语之形。
在此在彼，亦无所在，我即是你。
戏剧，乃是何物？
电影，又为何物？
生命，又是何者？
我唯有陈述，在这未曾经历之中，当其蜕变为未知与神秘，乃尔之诞生。
倦人类之傲慢自大。从幼受欺凌，饱受种种无端规条之束缚，以及暴力之袭。而对抗之方式乃将自身之残忍超越彼，然多半仍回归己身。我需持续否定之否定，以对抗荒谬世界之困顿，而于此同时，行径愈益不被人理解。
理性供予我兵器之构筑，情感给予我破限之勇气，熟稔操作十八般武艺，然终究沦为孤独之旅者，颠倒之超人，被忽视之蟑螂。不能为人所爱，不能为女子所爱，那梦中之情人，
我之月亮。
彼皆无法与我匹敌，吾欲质月球。
愿践松软之土，踏高飞起，陨石坑中与尔游戏。猛扑其门，瞬息可至，以最简、最激之方式，与尔相逢。
最后之排演，人类投降电影之终章，
敬请与我同临现场，共赏写下终局之快乐。
尔亦将与我同在电影中，尔之所为，
皆为 他之所感与演绎，余等同在，
岂非如此？
《人类投降派》之最后的排练

Human Surrender
Last Rehearsal: The Last Rehearsal of Human Surrender
An introduction to Last Rehearsal: The Last Rehearsal of Human Surrender, connecting Human Surrender, The Last Rehearsal, theater, P4 Theater within the P4...
In the near future, a fierce war breaks out between humans and alien races. Humanity's power is gradually weakening, while the dominance of alien races is increasing. In order to find a peaceful solution, humans and alien races reached a special agreement. According to the agreement, the two sides decided to conduct a final negotiation to determine the fate of mankind. To ensure smooth progress, both parties organized a rehearsal called "Last Rehearsal", which was designed to simulate and prepare for the negotiation process.
However, there is a shocking conspiracy hidden behind this rehearsal that may completely change the future of mankind. Now, a group of brave rebels must uncover the truth and stop the conspiracy from happening, or else humanity will face surrender.
I am both the signifier and the signified, the subject within it.
The essence is like the wind, blowing the land, and like water
It condenses into rain, forms rivers, and flows into the ocean.
What is written by words also becomes the words themselves, and the symbols are carried in them.
Alienation or sadness or music
Singing or not being able to sing.
Gravel and dust, the universe is vast and its boundaries are vast.
The personification of love, or the sinner who betrays it and carries it to the cross.
Faith and doubt, believer or not, sculpture creation
And break it. Life is present, or it is rejected.
Hiking as far as you can, returning to your starting point, you will end up wherever you go.
Emptiness is nothing, everything is integrated, and one is all-encompassing.
It is your extension and also your other.
Ideology or doctrine
The concepts are fragmented, illogical, and difficult to put into words.
Here, there, and nowhere, I am you.
Drama, what is it?
Movie, what is it?
Life, what is it?
I can only state that in this unprecedented experience, when it transformed into unknown and mysterious, Nair was born.
Tired of human arrogance. He has been bullied since childhood, subjected to all kinds of unreasonable rules and violence. The way to fight is to surpass the cruelty of others, but most of it will still return to yourself. I need to continue to deny the negation in order to fight against the difficulties of the absurd world, and at the same time, my actions are becoming increasingly incomprehensible.
Reason provided me with the construction of weapons, emotions gave me the courage to break limits, and I was proficient in using eighteen kinds of martial arts. However, I eventually became a lonely traveler, an upside-down superman, and a neglected cockroach. Unable to be loved by men, unloved by women, the lover of dreams
My moon.
None of them can compete with me. I want to capture the moon.
I would like to step on the soft soil, fly high, and play with you in the crater. Pounce on its door and you will be there in an instant, meeting you in the simplest and most exciting way.
The final rehearsal, the final chapter of the movie of Human Surrender
Please come with me to the scene and enjoy the joy of writing the ending.
You will also be in the movie with me, and what you do
They are all his feelings and interpretations, and others are present
Isn't it so?

sources.text:
p4剧场和你
2023-06-22
理论与方法
唯一神与主人能指——拉康对摩西十诫的研究
《十诫》是《圣经》的重要文本，这部与律法相关的奠基性宗教文本是主人能指和能指链构造操作的一次绝佳实例。《十诫
《十诫》是《圣经》的重要文本，这部与律法相关的奠基性宗教文本是主人能指和能指链构造操作的一次绝佳实例。《十诫》第一诫命展示了主人能指的无意义和独断性，第二诫命则从主人能指的权威出发，涉及了镜像的生成、象征界的构造与象征界对想象性二元关系的屏蔽。
我本人并不完全赞同精神分析在神学、文学领域的“运用”，因此，应当称此类“症候式阅读”为一次比喻性的论证，在此过程中，研究者只是借助某些现成的事例来“说明”自己的理论，对该事例在其本来所处领域内的研究是没有帮助的。
在拉康贯穿几十年的精神分析研究中，他始终将西方主体性的一神论作为话语的断裂或者切割。拉康看到，些断裂继续在现代主体身上生效，而没有，像一些启蒙学者所设想的那样，随着社会的世俗化而一并废除。拉康丰富了弗洛伊德在《摩西与一神教》中强调的多神论向一神论的转变作为精神分析的根本性历史时刻的地位，认为它“不可逆转地改变了之前和之后的一切”[1]。在拉康看来，一神论支撑了主体对人格单一性、国家统一性和主体间关系的幻想，并将它们在能指秩序中沉淀下来，而唯一神自身，则为这个合法性提供了保证。但问题在于，这个保证却缺乏一个自身保证，或者说，一神论的神本身就呈现为自身担保，因此对拉康而言，这个神的一元性本身就意味着分裂：“一中总是有多…这不是希腊逻辑、数学和宇宙学的自我同一性，而是一种剧烈的断裂，它围绕着一个虚空创造了主体和他们的世界”[2]
正是出于对这个断裂的研究，拉康把目光投向了《十诫》。与《圣经》更常见的故事与神话不同，《十诫》是一份律令文件，在其绝大多数条目中，《十诫》并不为自己的律令提供理由。拉康认为，它“具有与法律结构相关的特权特征”[3]。本文将透过拉康对《十诫》的分析，阐释拉康从一元神崇拜中看到的主体被主人能指异化、以牺牲想象界偶像崇拜的二元性为代价进入言说关系的精神分析符号学。
第一节 S1能指：有且仅有一个
既然拉康将《十诫》规定为一元神的律令系统，我们就有必要首先介绍研讨班VII中对律令的讨论。拉康在研讨班VII中创造性地引入了弗洛伊德Das Ding的概念，在拉康的表述中，“在无意识经验的层面上，Das Ding总是表现为它已经订立了律令。”[4]律令Das Ding的一面，也就是律令的任性武断的这个声音，被拉康称为主体从大他者处接受的纯粹命令，“是先于任何语义内容或调节功能而对主体施加压力的行为性话语和执行决定。”[5]Das Ding是一个二重的概念，有两个可以称得上自相矛盾的功能。一方面，Das Ding的“实存”——虽然它不直接在人面前显现自己——为超越律令的原乐享受保存了空间，但恰恰是它的存在，它使人无法忍受的、无法被规定的丑闻性的身份，进一步强化了律令的暴力。因此，为了诠释这个矛盾的功能，拉康将两个同样矛盾的、相差万里的作者联系了起来：康德和萨德。拉康激进地重读了康德的《实践理性批判》，认为康德式的伦理学其实与共同道德无关，绝对命令完全不意味着公共的善与福利，而恰恰就是命令的绝对性，是“朝向命令，而不是命令外的任何东西”——以至于，拉康认为，萨德式淫秽的原乐成为了这种伦理学律令的内在限制。也就是说，是痛苦，而不是快乐，规定了伦理学：我们要坚定地、苦修地朝向“出于道德”的目的前进，任何为了其本身的快乐则是这条路途上需要惊慌躲避的对象。与对象相接触的、实在的快乐在绝对命令的象征系统内部成了痛苦，而痛苦，这个与对象相隔绝的、不能以对象为目的，而只能以一个自我设立的绝对命令的中介为目的的过程，则在这个系统里又成为了快乐。在此就可以看到，Das Ding通过自身的存在保证了一个象征系统的设立，但它自身的不可触及性有注定了这个系统的无根据性，使得对系统外之“物”的每一次接触都成为了禁忌性的原乐。
现在我们可以回到《十诫》。拉康强调，《十诫》决不能宗教社会学地理解为意味着社会的共同善的“十大好主意”，即使从社会学视角上看它似乎的确传递了一些保证人类社会的基本稳定性的条款。《十诫》应该被理解成康德式的道德律，它以它的“神言”的律令性同时保证了诫命和输出诫命者、上帝的存在。拉康曾着重强调，《十诫》中所展现的上帝下达命令的方式和内容，与我们言说的符号学结构是一致的。
《圣经》出埃及记中，上帝关于《十诫》的第一句话是：
神吩咐这一切的话说，
我是耶和华你的神，曾将你从埃及地为奴之家领出来。
除了我以外，你不可有别的神。[6]
“神吩咐这一切的话说”，首先是这一句语义稍显重复的话引起了拉康的重视。有研究者援引中世纪法国评论家Rashi的解经：“上帝用一种难以理解和可怕的话语说出了整套诫命…上帝开始一条一条地重复他们——百姓们甚至无法忍受了，他们央求摩西为他们讲解诫命，免得神那可怕的声音临到他们头上。”[7]除了《出埃及记》，《十诫》还在《申命记》中出现过一次，摩西向在沙漠里出生的新一代以色列人讲解他们在神的带领下走出埃及的故事。拉康认为，在《十诫》宣读和传递的这个场景中，律法的自身性——也就是律法的不可忍受的无根据性——立刻引起了对它进行阐释和保存的活动，也就是摩西的讲述。但正如《十诫》向我们揭示的那样，这种保存又无外乎只是对这个权威的一次申明、一次重复。
随后，拉康将目光投向了第二句话，上帝在此陈述了自己的神名。拉康指出，犹太教的传统中，普遍将对神名的陈述看作是《十诫》的开篇第一句，而不是“除了我以外，你不可有别的神”的更典型的命令语句。这就意味着，对自己名称的这个规定，这个叙述，本身就已经是一道命令。上帝对自己神名的言说是一道命令。拉康还援引了上帝在另一处对自己神名的称唤：当摩西询问上帝，究竟是谁给予他权力来解放以色列人时，上帝回应道：“我是我所是。”[8]拉康在此指认出了对上帝神名“耶和华”的部分符号化：考虑“我是我所是”的希伯来语发音“Ehyeh-Asher-Ehyeh”，显然“耶和华”发音（“YHVH”）中的“Y”与“H”被成功地发出来了，却没有被写入某种意义的确凿性——在这句听上去没有意义的同义反复中，这个对上帝神名的“部分呼唤”重复它自身，并在此同时保持能指言说对某固定意义（因此也是对上帝具体存在的固定）的悬浮。对神名的口头重复在能指的流通中就已经固定了自身的无意义性：言说行为发生了，但是没有意义被说出来。正因为此，这句话才能够成为《十诫》之首：它是没有积极或者消极的具体规定的纯粹法令——对神本身的存在的规定，即神本身是绝对流动、不悬浮于任何一种规定中，却又实实在在的。
“规定”在此是个很隐晦的词。Reinhard提醒读者注意，希伯来语的存在概念是没有进行时态的[9]，这就是说，不能简单地将“我是我所是”理解为对现状的一种描述，而应当理解为神的一个命令、一次行动：神言说神名，神的存在、神的权威就在言说的活动中同步生成了。因此，《十诫》的这个开头“既是创造性的，又是描述性的，更是一场立法…诫命根本的重要性事实上并不是信仰上帝，而是一个不可言说的词汇在一个民族的形成和宗教主体的创造中的构成性作用。”[10]对上帝的信仰，本质上，同构于对主人能指的信仰。而在拉康看来，这个信仰事实上就是对外在于杂多的“一”的信仰。这个构成性的“一”是在它对主体结构的必要性、而不是某个具体的意义上生效，拉康认为，这个“一”应该被理解为基数词1，而不是序数词1st，因为这个“一”是存在于它开创的系统之外的。正是在这个点上，拉康将神之名“YHVH”规定为主人能指“S1”，没有所指的能指。正像“我是我所是”的同义反复提示出来的那样，主人能指通过纯粹命令的自我重复的形式将主体锚定在符号秩序的特定星丛中。
拉康多次将YHVH神名作为S1能指生成的一个实例，他还谈到了犹太-基督教传统中围绕着这个能指的一系列禁令——正是这些禁令巩固了、确立了神名作为主人能指的地位。考虑《十诫》中另一个著名的条目：
不可妄称耶和华你神的名。[11]
对言说的这种限制，正是为了将神名隔离在其作为主人能指的地位上，保持它的神圣——这就是说，保持它作为原始压抑的力量、它力量的无根据性，同时也保持日常语言的纯粹性，避免这个意义的匮乏流入日常语言。这样，对神名的言说成为了拉康“半说”、“真理的言说”的一次很好的示范：它既不能被理解为对知识的言说，也不能理解为对存在的言说。因为作为知识，“我是我所是”只说出了同义反复，保持了语义内容的空洞性；而作为存在，YHVH的两个字母Y、H泄入了“我是我所是”（Ehyeh-Asher-Ehyeh）中，却仅仅起到了对存在的某种自我分裂的暗示——不可妄称耶和华你神的名，而事实情况是，在宗教主体的言说秩序中，神名在主体的符号学操作的能力意义身上“不可”被言说。
第二节 除我以外，你不可有别的神：S1→S2
在第一条诫命以霸权性的方式宣称了神名作为不可碰触的主人能指之后，第二条诫命的目的就是在主人能指的基础上塑造能指秩序的可说性。在这条诫命中，包含了象征界对想象的二元秩序的阻断，也包含了象征秩序本身的一元性对欲望目标的保证：
除了我之外，你不可有别的神。
不可为自己雕刻偶像，也不可作什么形像仿佛上天，下地，和地底下，水中的百物。
不可跪拜那些像，也不可事奉它，因为我耶和华你的神是忌邪的神。恨我的，我必追讨他的罪，自父及子，直到三四代。
爱我，守我诫命的，我必向他们发慈爱，直到千代。[12]
第二条诫命充分地实现了第一条诫命中创伤性的主人能指的力量，将上帝的独一性和他隐而不宣的神名编织成一个更广阔的宇宙——一个由上帝所造，但从根本上不与上帝相同的宇宙。这个宇宙中的一切都被认为朝向上帝、由上帝提供其稳定性与合目的性的保证，但上帝却不在这个宇宙内部的任何地方。拉康指出，第二诫命有两个分立的功能，即塑造一个能指的象征秩序，以及用这个秩序阻断想象的二元性：“直到第二条‘不可拜偶像’的诫命，上帝不仅阻断了其它神灵崇拜，更阻断了任何‘像’、任何天上地下海里的受造物在作为整体的人类知觉中的显现。简单来说，对想象界功能的屏蔽…正是由神名而发的与象征界联系的前提和条件。”[13]
在拉康精神分析的理论中，人的主体化象征化就是S1能指——透过对想象性关系的牺牲——将主体置入能指的复数序列的过程。这个序列也就是S2：能指链的能指。能指链如何能够发挥它对想象界的阻断作用，这就要依靠拉康对偶像崇拜的解读。在偶像的神灵秩序下，神不是像上帝一般没有形体、其名称不可言说的无上威能的存在，而恰恰就是某种物的当即在场。因此，偶像崇拜也就是宗教主体与物的直接接触——只要木或石制的偶像树立在面前，这个偶像就绝不仅仅是主体与神之间的中介物，而恰恰就是日常生活中神的临在，而对偶像的崇拜仪式也就是信众与神的二元性的关系。神的面孔对应上了主体的面孔。但考虑上帝的面孔，情况则完全不同。“上帝的面孔”本就是个悖论性的表达，《圣经创世纪》开篇就讲到，“渊面黑暗，神的灵运行在水面上。”[14]神只有“灵”（spirit），而没有任何形式的具象化的形体。但在《十诫》的文本中神又确实提到了“面孔”：
除了我之外，你不可有别的神。（You shall have no other gods besides me[al pnei: before my face]）[15]
在希伯来语原文中，“在我面前，你不可有别的神”才是真正的字面义。而面对由S1能指所开展出来的能指链条S2，情况也是相同：在“能指”的面前，不可有别的形象出现。能指隔绝了主体与物的直接联结，替之以象征界的普遍中介性，从此，主体唯一能够称得上“面对”的，就是神的面孔，这就是说，能指的面孔。上帝成为了一个例外：只有他，唯一一个神，才能在宗教主体面前拥有面孔。通过被排除在这个能指的链条之外，S1能指保证了S2能指的无限丰富性——任何具体的事物对人的显现，都并不是作为从神出发的推广而对人显现，也就是说，作为神的秩序的总体性的元素对人显现，而是作为“不是神”的、在那个神圣的唯一之外的东西对人显现。它的定位依赖于神的定位，而神本身，它的定位则恰恰是“我是我所是”——即我“不是任何东西”。
但是仍然不得不讨论一种形象——主体自身的形象，也就是拉康精神分析中所探讨的镜像的自我完型。这一点也是被《圣经》所明确地揭示出来的：仍然考虑创世记：
神就照着自己的形像造人，乃是照着他的形像造男造女。
神就赐福给他们，又对他们说，要生养众多，遍满地面，治理这地。也要管理海里的鱼，空中的鸟，和地上各样行动的活物。[16]
这里有两个关系，即人和自然的分离、人与上帝的相似。Reinhard谈到，考虑到上帝本身根本没有一个形象用来“相似”，人与上帝的相似，恰恰是由人与自然的必然的分离决定的，这就是说，人-主体经历了上帝的创造，成为了与自然绝对不相等同的东西。[17]而规定了这个不相等同的，就是能指。人是在其身体性上是脱离了肉欲的直接性的一种生命形式——人有男女，这是来自上帝“亲手”的分别创造，人性交的欲望也直接来自于上帝的言说。在这个意义上，人的自我形象就并不是来自于某种自我生成的直接性，而是来自于能指的话语：这也是拉康的本意，他旨在说明“一种在语言中并由语言所产生的图式关系，这种关系是通过词语的句法产生、而不是在视觉格式塔的领域中产生的。”[18]人的面孔，本就是经由上帝的言说向人传送的镜像。
但是，就在此处，我们有风险落入另一个同义反复：既然S2能指的威力与S1主人能指一道，建立了神对事物实存和个体生存的中介性，那么，主体岂不是没有接触真实事物的可能了吗？这样一来，就使得上帝“我耶和华你的神是忌邪的神”的惩罚成为了一句空话——上帝在此时放出的惩罚威胁，岂不是本身成了对自己威能的不信任，考虑到他已经在方方面面上都从本体论能力的意义上限定了人对实在的介入？在这里仍然要做动力学的考量。神的“忌邪”所忌者，显然是包括实存之物的偶像化——也就是说，与物的排外的想象性关系。而神对这种关系的忌恨，事实上也正是与神对这种关系的屏蔽一体两面的。这就是说，神作为主人能指正是为能指的无限丰富性（S2）提供基本的约束，因为这个无限变化时刻都产生一个威胁。即威胁回到已经被上帝-主人能指所废除的想象的领域。在这里，我们终于重新回到了主人能指本身的性质，也就是开篇所讨论的Das Ding上——主人能指之所以发出威胁，恰恰是因为它自身只是对自身的纯粹重复，只是能指链的往复滑动——正如对主人能指的某种直接碰面会让主体遭遇创伤，主人能指的无根据性的暴露所造成的同样的创伤。而上帝之外的偶像的现身，则完全是一个不可想象的、应当遭受世代永罚的巨大创伤。此刻我们可以说，《十诫》文本的前两条已经很充分地反映了宗教的能指操作——主人能指自身身为无意义之物的纯粹重复、对这个重复的恐惧所引发的立法要求，以及随之产生的能指链的无限丰富性的双重特征：它一方面为主人能指屏蔽想象的二元关系，确保主人能指独占的中介性地位；另一方面则在主人能指自身不可接触的创伤性的支持下，建设符号化的总体秩序。

In the kingdom of happiness, the flame of happiness has been lit.
The fire of happiness is spreading, spreading and dancing.
Why has the Happiness Stone been flashing lately?
It turns out that the increase in happy lives makes the kingdom happier and happier.

You're wearing a big mask. I am the messenger. I saw it.
No more hesitation. No more worries. No more worries. You have arrived, then you will grow forever like everything here
Your body is full of power, and the color that belongs to you will be like a flame, breaking through the shackles and coming into the sight of the world, making you shine. The color that belongs to you has long been unable to suppress the restlessness caused by excitement. Your color can't wait to be seen and breathe in the world.
This is not over yet, your colors still want to infect a space and occupy a piece of air.
When you come here, you finally no longer have to look forward and backward. You no longer have to think about the reviews you get. Finally, you no longer have to work hard and wait for your success. Your mask will be broken soon. The colors rushed out and destroyed the big mask. The big mask carries all your efforts as a social person. This effort has now turned into dregs with the big mask, turned into mote, and turned into variegated colors flying towards the sky of happiness.
I am the messenger of the Happiness Stone. I broke your mask. This action is the seed of the kingdom of happiness, we come here, we destroy the big mask.
The content of the activity is body painting. The messenger will guide the participants to use different colors on their faces to draw their true portraits and destroy the original big masks. This temporary, hedonic release of emotion is also a mild attempt to establish our identity in the realm of happiness.

Mr. Chen Jianli is a philosophical poet. His thinking is not based on false metaphysics that pretends to be audio-visual, but based on a kind of contemplation after reading the classics and the world. Therefore, his works generally combine Rilke's keen awareness and John Donne's melancholy wise temperament. This is the general thrust of his poetry creation. The collection of teacher Chen Jianli's works appears as a general image. He often uses seemingly hazy babble to hint and reveal the dark truth of civilization and history. Behind the seemingly automatic writing and post-modern word collage are actually the primordial symbols of the individual soul and subtle associations with the collective unconscious of the nation. In the artistic conception of the whole and parts, the other and the subject, reality and history, they mirror each other and question each other, there is a strange and profound aesthetic effect.

sources.text:
P4 Theater and You
2023-06-22
Theory and Methods
The Only God and Master Signifier-Lacan's Study of the Ten Commandments of Moses
The Ten Commandments is an important text in the Bible. This foundational religious text related to law is an excellent example of the construction...
The Ten Commandments is an important text in the Bible. This foundational religious text related to law is an excellent example of the construction operation of the master signifier and the signifier chain. The first commandment of the "Ten Commandments" shows the meaninglessness and arbitrary nature of the master signifier, while the second commandment starts from the authority of the master signifier and involves the generation of mirror images, the construction of the symbolic world, and the shielding of imaginary binary relationships by the symbolic world.
I personally do not fully agree with the "application" of psychoanalysis in the fields of theology and literature. Therefore, this type of "symptomatic reading" should be called a metaphorical argument. In this process, the researcher only uses some ready-made examples to "illustrate" his own theory. This example is not helpful for research in the field in which it is originally located.
In Lacan's psychoanalysis research that spans decades, he always regards the monotheism of Western subjectivity as a rupture or cut in discourse. Lacan saw these ruptures continuing to operate on the modern subject, rather than being abolished altogether with the secularization of society, as some Enlightenment scholars had imagined. Lacan enriches Freud's emphasis in Moses and Monotheism on the status of the transition from polytheism to monotheism as a fundamental historical moment, arguing that it "irrevocably changes everything that comes before and after" [1]. In Lacan's view, monotheism supports the subject's fantasy of the unity of personality, the unity of the state, and the relationship between subjects, and precipitates them in the order of signifiers, while the only God himself provides guarantee for this legitimacy. But the problem is that this guarantee lacks a self-guaranteed, or in other words, the monotheistic God itself appears as a self-guaranteed. Therefore, for Lacan, the unity of this God itself means division: "There are always many in one... This is not the self-identity of Greek logic, mathematics and cosmology, but a violent rupture that creates subjects and their world around a void" [2]
It was out of the study of this rupture that Lacan turned his attention to the Ten Commandments. Unlike the Bible's more common stories and myths, the Ten Commandments are a document of commandments that, in most of its entries, do not provide reasons for their commands. According to Lacan, it "has privileged characteristics related to legal structures" [3]. Through Lacan's analysis of the Ten Commandments, this article will explain Lacan's psychoanalysis semiotics of the subject being alienated by the master's signifier and entering into a speech relationship at the expense of the duality of idolatry in the imaginary world from the worship of the One God.
Section 1 S1 signifier: there is and only one
Since Lacan stipulates the Ten Commandments as a system of commandments for the One Spirit, it is necessary for us to first introduce the discussion of the commandments in Seminar VII. Lacan creatively introduced Freud's concept of Das Ding in Seminar VII. In Lacan's expression, "On the level of unconscious experience, Das Ding always appears as if it has established a law." [4] Law Order Das The side of Ding, that is, the willful and arbitrary voice of the command, is called by Lacan the pure command that the subject receives from the Big Other. "It is the behavioral discourse and execution decision that puts pressure on the subject before any semantic content or regulatory function." [5] Das Ding is a dual concept, with two functions that can be called self-contradictory. On the one hand, the "existence" of Das Ding - although it does not directly manifest itself in front of people - saves space for original enjoyment that transcends the rules and regulations, but it is precisely its existence, its unbearable and undefinable scandalous identity, that further intensifies the violence of the rules and regulations. Therefore, in order to interpret this contradictory function, Lacan connects two equally contradictory authors who are thousands of miles apart: Kant and Sade. Lacan radically reread Kant's "Critique of Practical Reason" and believed that Kantian ethics has nothing to do with common morality. The categorical imperative does not mean public good and welfare at all, but is precisely the absolute nature of the command, which is "toward the command, not anything outside the command" - so that, Lacan believed that Sade's obscene original music became the inherent limit of this ethical imperative. That is to say, it is pain, not pleasure, that defines ethics: we must move firmly and ascetically toward "moral" ends, and any pleasure for its own sake is an object to be feared and avoided on this road. The real pleasure that is in contact with the object becomes pain within the symbolic system of the categorical imperative, and pain, this process that is isolated from the object and cannot have the object as its purpose, but can only serve as the intermediary of a self-established categorical imperative, becomes pleasure in this system. It can be seen here that Das Ding ensures the establishment of a symbolic system through its own existence, but its own inaccessibility destined the system to be groundless, making every contact with "things" outside the system a taboo original pleasure.
Now we can return to the Ten Commandments. Lacan emphasized that the Ten Commandments must not be understood sociologically as the "ten good ideas" that mean the common good of society, even though from a sociological perspective it does seem to convey some provisions that guarantee the basic stability of human society. The Ten Commandments should be understood as a Kantian moral law, which with its imperative nature of "divine words" simultaneously guarantees the existence of the commandments and the one who gives them, God. Lacan once emphasized that the manner and content of God's commands shown in the Ten Commandments are consistent with the semiotic structure of our speech.
In the Book of Exodus in the Bible, God's first words about the Ten Commandments are
God commanded all these words, saying
I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
You shall have no other gods before me. [6]
"God commanded all these things," first of all, it was this slightly repetitive sentence that caught Lacan's attention. Some researchers quoted the interpretation of the medieval French commentator Rashi: "God spoke the entire set of commandments in an incomprehensible and terrifying word... God began to repeat them one by one - the people couldn't even bear it. They begged Moses to explain the commandments to them, lest God's terrible voice come on their heads." [7] In addition to "Exodus", the "Ten Commandments" also appeared once in "Deuteronomy". Moses explained to the new generation of Israelites born in the desert the story of their coming out of Egypt under God's leadership. Lacan believes that in this scene of the reading and delivery of the Ten Commandments, the very nature of the law-that is, the intolerable groundlessness of the law-immediately gives rise to the activity of interpreting and preserving it, that is, the narration of Moses. But as the Ten Commandments reveal to us, this preservation is nothing more than a statement and a repetition of this authority.
Lacan then turns his attention to the second sentence, where God states his divine name. Lacan pointed out that in the Jewish tradition, the statement of the name of God is generally regarded as the first sentence of the Ten Commandments, rather than the more typical command statement of "Thou shalt have no other gods before me." This means that the stipulation and description of one's own name is already an order in itself. God's utterance of His name is a command. Lacan also cited God's use of his divine name in another place: when Moses asked God who gave him the power to liberate the Israelites, God responded: "I am who I am." [8] Lacan here identifies a partial symbolization of God's divine name "Jehovah": consider the Hebrew pronunciation of "I am what I am" as "Ehyeh-Asher-Ehyeh", Apparently the "Y" and "H" in the pronunciation of "Yahweh" ("YHVH") are successfully pronounced, but are not written into the certainty of a certain meaning - in this meaningless-sounding tautology, this "partial invocation" of God's name repeats itself, and at the same time maintains the suspension of the signifier's speech to a fixed meaning (and therefore to the fixation of God's concrete existence). The verbal repetition of the divine name already fixes its own meaninglessness in the circulation of signifiers: the act of speaking occurs, but no meaning is uttered. It is precisely for this reason that this sentence can be the first of the Ten Commandments: it is a pure decree without positive or negative specific regulations - a regulation of the existence of God himself, that is, God himself is absolutely fluid, not suspended in any kind of determination, but still real.
"Provisions" is a very vague word here. Reinhard reminds readers that the Hebrew concept of existence does not have a progressive tense [9]. This means that "I am what I am" cannot simply be understood as a description of the current situation, but should be understood as a command and an action of God: God speaks God's name, and God's existence and God's authority are simultaneously generated in the activity of speaking. Therefore, the beginning of the "Ten Commandments" is "both creative and descriptive, but also a legislation...The fundamental importance of the commandments is not actually belief in God, but the constitutive role of an ineffable word in the formation of a nation and the creation of religious subjects." [10] Belief in God is, in essence, isomorphic to belief in the master's signifier. According to Lacan, this belief is actually the belief in the "one" external to the multiplicity. This constitutive "one" is effective in its necessity to the subject structure, rather than in a specific sense. Lacan believes that this "one" should be understood as the cardinal number 1, rather than the ordinal number 1st, because this "one" exists outside the system it creates. It is at this point that Lacan stipulates the name of God "YHVH" as the master signifier "S1", a signifier without a signified. As the tautology of "I am what I am" suggests, the master signifier anchors the subject in a specific constellation of symbolic order through the form of self-repetition of pure command.
Lacan repeatedly used the divine name YHVH as an example of the generation of the S1 signifier. He also talked about a series of prohibitions surrounding this signifier in the Judeo-Christian tradition - it is these prohibitions that consolidate and establish the status of the divine name as the master signifier. Consider another famous entry in the Ten Commandments
You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain. [11]
This restriction on speech is precisely to isolate the divine name in its status as master signifier, to preserve its sanctity-that is, to preserve its power as a primal repression, the unfoundedness of its power, but also to preserve the purity of ordinary language and prevent this lack of meaning from flowing into ordinary language. In this way, the utterance of God's name becomes a good example of Lacan's "half-saying" and "speech of truth": it cannot be understood as a utterance of knowledge, nor as a utterance of existence. Because as knowledge, "I am what I am" only speaks tautology, maintaining the emptiness of semantic content; and as existence, the two letters Y and H of YHVH leaked into "I am what I am" (Ehyeh-Asher-Ehyeh), but only served as a hint of some kind of self-division of existence - you cannot take the name of Jehovah your God in vain. The fact is that in the speaking order of religious subjects, the name of God "cannot" be spoken in the sense of the subject's ability to operate semiotics.
Section 2 You shall have no other gods before me: S1→S2
After the first commandment declares the name of God as the untouchable master signifier in a hegemonic way, the purpose of the second commandment is to shape the sayability of the signifier order on the basis of the master signifier. This commandment includes the symbolic world's interruption of the dualistic order of imagination, and also the guarantee of the goal of desire by the monism of the symbolic order itself
You shall have no other gods before me.
You shall not make for yourself any graven image, or any likeness of anything that is in heaven above, or on earth below, or that is under the earth, or that is in the waters under the earth.
You shall not bow down to them or serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God. I will punish the sin of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me.
I will show steadfast love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments. [12]
The second commandment fully realizes the power of the traumatic master-signifier of the first commandment, weaving the oneness of God and his tacit divine name into a wider universe-a universe made by God but not fundamentally the same as God. Everything in this universe is thought to be oriented toward God, with God providing the guarantee of its stability and purposefulness, but God is nowhere within this universe. Lacan pointed out that the second commandment has two separate functions, namely, shaping a symbolic order of signifiers, and using this order to block the duality of imagination: "Until the second commandment 'Thou shalt not worship idols', God not only blocked the worship of other gods, but also blocked the appearance of any 'image', any creation in heaven and earth in the human consciousness as a whole. To put it simply, the shielding of the function of the imaginary world... is the prerequisite and condition for the connection with the symbolic world derived from the name of God."[13]
In Lacan's psychoanalysis theory, the symbolization of human subjectification is the process in which the S1 signifier-through the sacrifice of imaginary relationships-places the subject into the plural sequence of signifiers. This sequence is also S2: the signifier of the signifier chain. How the signifier chain can exert its blocking effect on the imaginary world depends on Lacan's interpretation of idolatry. In the divine order of idols, God is not a formless and supremely powerful existence with an indescribable name like God, but rather the immediate presence of something. Therefore, idol worship is the direct contact between religious subjects and objects - as long as a wooden or stone idol is erected in front of them, this idol is not just an intermediary between the subject and God, but is precisely the presence of God in daily life, and the worship ritual of idols is also the duality of the relationship between believers and God. The face of the god corresponds to the face of the subject. But considering the face of God, it's a completely different story. "The face of God" is a paradoxical expression. The Bible Genesis says at the beginning, "Darkness is over the face of the deep, and the Spirit of God is moving on the surface of the water." [14] God only has a "spirit" and does not have any form of concrete form. But God does mention "face" in the text of the Ten Commandments
You shall have no other gods before me. (You shall have no other gods besides me[al pnei: before my face])[15]
In the original Hebrew text, "You shall have no other gods before me" is the true literal meaning. When facing the signifier chain S2 developed by the signifier S1, the situation is the same: in front of the "signifier", no other image can appear. The signifier isolates the direct connection between the subject and the object, replacing it with the universal intermediary of the symbolic world. From then on, the only thing the subject can be called "facing" is the face of God, that is, the face of the signifier. God becomes an exception: only he, the only god, can have a face before the religious subject. By being excluded from this chain of signifiers, the S1 signifier guarantees the infinite richness of the S2 signifier-any concrete thing appears to man not as a generalization from God, that is, as an element of the totality of the divine order, but as something "not God" and outside that divine One. Its positioning depends on the positioning of God, and the positioning of God itself is precisely "I am what I am" - that is, I am "not anything."
But we still have to discuss an image - the image of the subject itself, which is the self-gestalt of the mirror image discussed in Lacan psychoanalysis. This is also clearly revealed by the Bible: still consider Genesis
God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.
God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it." And have dominion over the fish in the sea, over the birds in the air, and over every living creature that moves on the earth. [16]
There are two relationships here, namely the separation between man and nature and the similarity between man and God. Reinhard said that considering that God himself does not have an image to be "similar" at all, the similarity between man and God is precisely determined by the inevitable separation of man and nature. That is to say, the human subject has experienced God's creation and has become something absolutely not identical with nature. [17] What stipulates this non-equivalence is the signifier. Man is a life form that is physically separated from the directness of carnal desires - man and woman are separate creations from God's "hands", and the desire for human intercourse also comes directly from God's words. In this sense, a person's self-image does not come from some self-generated immediacy, but from the discourse of signifiers: this is also Lacan's original intention. He aimed to illustrate "a schema relationship produced in and by language, which is produced through the syntax of words rather than in the field of visual gestalt." [18] The human face is originally a mirror image transmitted to people through God's words.
However, right here, we risk falling into another tautology: since the power of the S2 signifier, together with the S1 master signifier, establishes God's intermediary between the existence of things and individual survival, then doesn't it mean that the subject has no possibility of contacting real things? In this way, God's punishment of "I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God" becomes an empty phrase - doesn't the threat of punishment issued by God at this time itself become a distrust of his own power, considering that he has limited man's intervention in reality in the sense of ontological ability in every aspect? There are still dynamic considerations to be made here. What is tabooed by God's "jealousy" obviously includes the idolization of real things - that is, the exclusive imaginary relationship with things. In fact, God's jealousy of this relationship is exactly the same as God's shielding of this relationship. That is to say, God as the master signifier provides the basic constraint for the infinite richness of the signifier (S2), because this infinite change creates a threat at every moment. That is, the threat of returning to an imaginary realm that has been abolished by the God-Master signifier. Here, we finally return to the nature of the master signifier itself, which is the Das Ding discussed in the beginning - the reason why the master signifier threatens is precisely because it is a pure repetition of itself, just the reciprocating sliding of the signifier chain - just as a certain direct encounter with the master signifier will cause the subject to suffer trauma, the same trauma is caused by the unfounded exposure of the master signifier. The appearance of idols other than God is a completely unimaginable and huge trauma that deserves eternal punishment for generations. At this moment, we can say that the first two texts of the Ten Commandments have fully reflected the operation of religious signifiers - the pure repetition of the master signifier itself as a meaningless thing, the legislative requirements triggered by the fear of this repetition, and the dual characteristics of the infinite richness of the signifier chain: on the one hand, it shields the imaginary binary relationship for the master signifier, ensuring the exclusive intermediary status of the master signifier; on the other hand, it builds a symbolic overall order with the support of the inaccessible traumatic nature of the master signifier itself.
